izzyondroid:com.cylonid.nativealpha.name: Native Alpha
izzyondroid:com.cylonid.nativealpha.summary: full screen Web Apps with shortcuts and custom settings
izzyondroid:com.cylonid.nativealpha.description:
Features
 Shows any website in a borderless full-screen window using Android System WebView.
 Offers to create home screen shortcuts and retrieves icons in suitable resolution.
 arious settings (JavaScript, cookies, adblocking, location/camera/microphone access) can be set for every web app individually
 Navigation with multi-touch gestures while browsing.
 Opt-in adblock with user-selected filter lists.
 Less memory footprint and no privacy-invading app permissions in comparison to native apps
 Dark mode for Android 10+
 FAQ
 Q: Why would I need this app if any mobile browser can do the same? 
 A: Mobile browsers usually only are able to create shortcuts which give a native, borderless fullscreen experience if the website has a Progressive Web App (PWA) manifest. Unfortunately, most websites do not offer this feature yet.
 Q: Can I keep multiple log-in sessions of the same website? 
 A: Yes, this is possible using the sandbox feature of Native Alpha Plus.
 Q: Why isn't the sandbox feature in Native Alpha Plus enabled by default? 
 A: The sandboxing approach is recommended for specific usage rather than general usage because it can limit the performance of the application and increase the disk usage. Therefore, use it for privacy-invasive websites or websites where you want to be logged in twice, but not for any website just because you can.
 Q: Why is it not possible to find an icon for a certain website? 
 A: This problem can occur due to multiple reasons. In most cases, the website does not offer a high-resolution icon. If you are a website maintainer and your website icon cannot be found, look at RealFaviconGenerator for further information. If you think it should work, feel free to post the URL and I will look into it.
 Q: Is this app a dedicated web browser with its own browser engine? 
 A: No. As stated, this app relies on the system built-in Android WebView in order to display the website. For privacy reasons, you can opt to use alternative webviews such as Bromite on rooted phones. Always make sure to use to most recent version of any WebView implementation you use!
 Q: In constrast to your promise, this app has a large memory footprint! 
 A: This is because Native Alpha makes use of caching in the same way your browser app does, i.e., it saves web content locally on your device. Then it can be loaded faster if you visit the same page again. I will look into a way for better cache management. In the meantime, you can either delete cache regularly yourself or set the "Clear cache after usage" setting in the global settings if memory footprint is a concern for you. However, then websites will take a longer time to load because everything has to be loaded from net.

fdroid:com.adilhanney.saber.name: Saber
fdroid:com.adilhanney.saber.summary: The notes app built for handwriting
fdroid:com.adilhanney.saber.description:
Saber is the notes app built for handwriting.
It's designed to be as simple and intuitive as possible, while still delivering unique features that you'll actually use. Additionally, Saber is available across all your devices, large and small, and syncs between them seamlessly.
Notably, it can invert your notes when you're in dark mode. This allows you to write with white ink on a black background, which is much easier on the eyes in low-light environments like when the teacher turns off the lights in class.
Images and PDFs are also inverted, so you can still use a digital printout or a textbook without the fuss.
Saber uses a dual-password system to protect your notes from anyone but you, even if they have complete control over the server. You can safely store your notes on the official Saber server, another server, or even host your own!
The app is completely open-source so that anyone can view the source code and see exactly what it's doing and how it handles your data. Many other note-taking apps are closed-source and proprietary, meaning that their inner workings are a mystery to the public.
As someone who studies maths, highlighting multi-line equations was always a hassle with other apps, where the highlighter would change color when it overlapped with itself. Another problem I had was that in some apps, the highlighter would render on top of the text, fading it out and making it hard to read.
Saber's highlighter has no such issues. It utilizes canvas compositing to render the highlighter in a way that is consistent with/better than traditional paper, where it handles overlaps and maintains color consistency.
Saber has everything you need to keep your notes organized. Create folders inside folders inside folders to your heart's content with no limit on the number of nested folders. And even though a note may be buried deep within a nested folder, you can still access it easily with your most recent notes always available on the home screen.
Discover a whole new way to capture and organize your thoughts with Saber. Whether you're a student, professional, or creative mind, Saber is your trusted companion for digital handwriting. Download now and let your ideas flow freely!

 * Image compression: Set the compression amount in the settings
 * Formats: Switch between 3 camera formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
 * Resolutions: Switch between different camera resolutions
 * Save location: Choose your preferred save location
 * Small size of about 21MB
 * Customizable: Open the settings to customize the app to your liking!
 Contact 
Check out the GitHub repository, which includes the Roadmap: https://github.com/iakdis/librecamera 
In case you found a bug or have a feature request, feel free to file an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/iakdis/librecamera/issues

fdroid:me.lecaro.breakout.summary: Break colourful bricks, catch bouncing coins and select powerful upgrades !
fdroid:me.lecaro.breakout.description:
This is a roguelike twist on the original Breakout formula:
The goal is to catch as many coins as possible during 7 levels.
Coins appear when you break bricks.
They fly around, bounce and roll, and you need to catch them with your paddle.
At the end of the level, you get to pick upgrades.
There are 50+ different upgrades that impact the gameplay in various ways.

fdroid:no.navi.app.name: Navi
fdroid:no.navi.app.summary: Offline-first navigation with terrain-aware eco routing
fdroid:no.navi.app.description:
Navi is an offline-first navigation app. Download map data once, then plan and follow routes on the device without needing the internet for every trip.
 Before first use: Navi does not come with a ready-made routing database, unlike many commercial navigation devices whose maker ships precomputed maps. Open the Tools menu and use Download region to get your region. Navi then downloads the map data and builds its routing and search databases on the device. This takes about 5 to 22 minutes per region depending on its size, for example about 5 minutes for a small country like Luxembourg and 20 to 22 minutes for a large region like Østlandet on a mid-range tablet. Route planning does not work until this is finished.
 Travel modes include car, bicycle, e-bike, hiking, motorcycle, truck, and motorhome. Optional vehicle size limits skip roads that are too tight. Avoidances cover motorways and fast expressways, tolls, and ferries.
 Eco routing prefers gentler, less energy-hungry roads by taking hills into account. Hiking and cycling can optionally prefer marked long-distance and pilgrim-style trails, with normal paths used when a marked trail has a gap.
 Download a region (OpenStreetMap extract), an offline basemap, and optional elevation/terrain data in Tools. A background indexing job builds compact routing packs so later plans are fast; you can still plan while indexing runs. Map updates are never silent — only when you ask.
 On the road: 
 Place search, From / Via / To, GPS fill, map mark and saved places
 Off-route detection and reroute
 Break and rest suggestions, including truck driving-time rules where known
 Drive bars with altitude and trip ETA
 GPS follow, and north-up / compass / direction-of-travel map rotation
 Optional experimental 3D hill shading and map tilt
 Navi is free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later). There are no ads and no tracking. Network use is for downloads and updates you choose — not for silent data collection.

- Smart Shelves: Save filter combinations as self-updating shelves.
- Hybrid FLOSS Scanner: High-speed barcode detection and ISBN OCR recognition.
- Detailed Statistics: Reorganizable widgets for tracking reading streaks, page goals, and reading history.
Openshelf is designed for book lovers who care about the craftsmanship of managing a personal collection. 100% on-device and privacy-focused.

apple-itunes:1451596996.name: Wapp - Multi Chat Account
apple-itunes:1451596996.description:
Wapp - 4 Accounts for Personal & Work Chats
Keep your personal and work conversations organized in one app.
Connect up to four existing WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business accounts on your iPhone or iPad, with a separate space for each account.
WHAT DOES Wapp OFFER?
• Up to Four Accounts — keep your personal and work accounts in separate sessions
• Easy Account Switching — move between your accounts without combining their conversations
• Custom Account Names — personalize tab names to identify each account
• iPhone and iPad Support — access WhatsApp Web in an interface that adapts to your screen
• App Lock — protect access to the app with Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices
Full use of linked accounts, enabling App Lock and AI writing tools require Pro access.
AI WRITING, WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Proofread — review spelling and grammar in text you enter
• Rewrite — rephrase your text or make it more concise
• Adjust Your Tone — prepare a friendlier or more professional message
AI tools are optional. You choose when to use them and review the result before sending it. They do not automatically reply to your conversations.
GETTING STARTED
• Choose an account tab in Wapp
• Follow the WhatsApp Web instructions to link an existing account
• Repeat the process to add your other accounts
Each account stays in its own session. Wapp does not create accounts or provide new phone numbers.
PRO ACCESS
Pro unlocks full use of linked accounts, App Lock activation and AI writing tools.
Pro requires an in-app purchase or subscription. Review the available options, benefits and conditions shown in the app before confirming your purchase.
REQUIREMENTS

• Access to the official app to authorize account linking
• An internet connection for WhatsApp Web and AI services

After starting the game you will see a 9x9 field with different coloured squares. Arrows can be seen at the edge of the field, which are used to move the rows and columns in which the squares are located. flathub:org.godotengine.GodotSharp.name: Godot Engine (C#/.NET)
flathub:org.godotengine.GodotSharp.description:
NOTE: This Flatpak is unofficial and not supported by Godot Engine developers. 
 Find officially supported binaries on godotengine.org.
 The feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. Godot Engine provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel. Games can be exported in one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) as well as mobile (Android, iOS), web-based (HTML5) platforms and consoles (Switch, PS4 and Xbox One - via thirdparty publishers).
 Completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached, no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours down to the last line of engine code. Godot's development is fully independent and community-driven, empowering you to help shape the engine to match your expectations. It is supported by the non-profit Godot Foundation.
 Create games with ease, using Godot's unique approach to game development:
 Nodes for all your needs. Godot comes with hundreds of built-in nodes that make game design a breeze. You can also create your own for custom behaviors, editors and much more.
 Flexible scene system. Create node compositions with support for instancing and inheritance.
 Visual editor with all the tools you need packed into a beautiful and uncluttered context-sensitive UI.
 Friendly content creation pipeline for artists, level designers, animators and everything in between.
 Persistent live editing where changes are not lost after stopping the game. It even works on mobile devices!
 Create your own custom tools with ease using the incredible tool system.
 Current limitations of this Flatpak version:
 C#/.NET external editor support does not work out-of-the-box, though this is currently being discussed and worked on. See: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.GodotSharp/issues/2
 External script editors are still supported (for use outside of C#/.NET), but you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.GodotSharp#using-an-external-script-editor
 After the first C# script is created, it is necessary to click Build within Godot. Alternatively, running dotnet restore in the IDE's terminal would work as well.
 Godot 4's Blender importer is supported, but Blender needs to be installed on your system and you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.GodotSharp#using-blender
 For projects using text-to-speech, make sure speech-dispatcher is installed on your system, so that this Flatpak can access it.

fedora-packages:guestfs-tools/guestfs-to.name: guestfs-tools
fedora-packages:guestfs-tools/guestfs-to.summary: Tools to access and modify virtual machine disk images
fedora-packages:guestfs-tools/guestfs-to.description: guestfs-tools is a set of tools that can be used to make batch configuration changes to guests, get disk used/free statistics (virt-df), perform backups and guest clones, change registry/UUID/hostname info, build guests from scratch (virt-builder) and much more. Virt-alignment-scan scans virtual machines looking for partition alignment problems. Virt-builder is a command line tool for rapidly making disk images of popular free operating systems. Virt-cat is a command line tool to display the contents of a file in a virtual machine. Virt-customize is a command line tool for customizing virtual machine disk images. Virt-df is a command line tool to display free space on virtual machine filesystems. Unlike other tools, it doesn’t just display the amount of space allocated to a virtual machine, but can look inside the virtual machine to see how much space is really being used. It is like the df(1) command, but for virtual machines, except that it also works for Windows virtual machines. Virt-diff shows the differences between virtual machines. Virt-drivers detects the bootloader, kernel and drivers inside a guest. Virt-edit is a command line tool to edit the contents of a file in a virtual machine. Virt-filesystems is a command line tool to display the filesystems, partitions, block devices, LVs, VGs and PVs found in a disk image or virtual machine. It replaces the deprecated programs virt-list-filesystems and virt-list-partitions with a much more capable tool. Virt-format is a command line tool to erase and make blank disks. Virt-get-kernel extracts a kernel/initrd from a disk image. Virt-inspector examines a virtual machine and tries to determine the version of the OS, the kernel version, what drivers are installed, whether the virtual machine is fully virtualized (FV) or para-virtualized (PV), what applications are installed and more. Virt-log is a command line tool to display the log files from a virtual machine. Virt-ls is a command line tool to list out files in a virtual machine. Virt-make-fs is a command line tool to build a filesystem out of a collection of files or a tarball. Virt-resize can resize existing virtual machine disk images. Virt-sparsify makes virtual machine disk images sparse (thin-provisioned). Virt-sysprep lets you reset or unconfigure virtual machines in preparation for cloning them. Virt-tail follows (tails) a log file within a guest, like 'tail -f'.

firefox-addons:1551522.summary:
On some pages, Firefox won't ask you to store your login information. Using this add-on you can force Firefox to remember your password!
This add-on is NOT a password manager!
firefox-addons:1551522.description:
Save my Password will allow you to force Firefox to remember your password on any page.
 Why? 
Some login pages are designed in a way that your credentials are not stored by Firefox and you have to type them yourself every time.
 How? 
When you click the toolbar icon, this add-on will create dummy input fields where you type your credentials and click "Save my Password!" button. This will force Firefox to show you the "Save login info" dialog.
 Note that this add-on is NOT a password manager - it doesn't store or send any passwords!

firefox-addons:3082110.name: Tiled GIF Theme
firefox-addons:3082110.summary: Tile your own animated GIFs across the toolbar and vertical tab sidebar, with daily rotation, day/night switching and settings sync.
firefox-addons:3082110.description:
Turn your favourite GIFs into an animated Firefox theme. Add a GIF and it tiles seamlessly across the toolbar and the vertical tab sidebar, with its own colours, scale and crop. Collect several and let them rotate on a schedule or switch between day and night.
 Your GIFs, your way 
- Add GIFs, APNG, WebP, PNG or JPG from your computer or a web address
- Scale from 0.1× to 8× with sharp pixel-art or smooth scaling
- Crop to any part of the image and drag to choose where the tiling starts
- Live, animated preview before you save
- Speed up or slow down animations, cap the frame rate, or use a still frame
 Readable tabs over any image 
- Dim the image, pick text colours automatically, and add fills behind the selected tab
- Menus and the address bar get their own readable colours
- Optional userChrome.css snippet (shown in the settings) adds fills behind unselected tabs and the toolbar
 Rotation and scheduling 
- Random order or in order (drag thumbnails to arrange them)
- Change GIF after a set time (15 minutes to a week), each time Firefox opens, or every day at a set time
- Day & night: tag GIFs as Day or Night and switch at sunrise and sunset or at fixed times
- Next GIF shortcut (Alt+Shift+G) and right-click menu on the toolbar button
 Sync and backup 
- Settings sync between computers with Firefox Sync
- GIFs added from a web address download automatically on your other computers
- Export and import a backup of everything
 Privacy: everything happens on your computer. The add-on collects no data. Your location, if you use sunrise and sunset, is rounded and never leaves your device.
Desktop only: Firefox for Android doesn't support themes.

Joylia is an innovative platform that combines intelligent companionship with gaming social interaction. bluejetty:00120339:ios.description:
Make math learning fun with Matific – the multi-award-winning math game designed by leading education experts for children aged 4-12.
Endorsed by teachers around the world, Matific introduces and develops core math and problem-solving skills in a fun and interactive way which your child will love.
Set on Matific’s magical adventure islands, our app’s adaptive game play lets children explore new worlds, unlock hidden levels, navigate challenges and collect treasure, all while learning math!
 Are you ready to set your child up for math success?
Download now and start your free 7-day trial. 
*PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATHWAYS FOR YOUR CHILD
Our adaptive algorithm automatically adjusts to your child’s level of math understanding and unique learning style, so they can master concepts at their own pace without any math anxiety.
*PROVEN TO BOOST math OUTCOMES BY 34%
In just 30 minutes a week, Matific helps improve test scores by an average of 34% by developing conceptual math understanding and critical thinking.
*SCHOOL CURRICULUM ALIGNED
Matific is fully aligned with the US and Canada primary school math curriculum and covers all the core math skills required from years K to 6 (ages 4-12).
*DESIGNED BY EDUCATION EXPERTS
Matific is designed by world-class mathematics education experts from Harvard, Berkeley, MIT, and Stanford and is backed by cutting edge education research and teaching methods.
*GAMIFIED WORLD OF ADVENTURE WITH REWARDS CHILDREN LOVE
 Matific is a magical experience, filled with helpful characters and exciting challenges. Each student customizes their own avatar to explore Matific’s adventure islands and as they achieve math mastery, new areas of the islands unlock, treasure is collected and new avatar options appear! Say goodbye to boring math checklists and tasks!
*CORE math SKILLS COVERED
Matific’s math learning activities are specifically designed to develop the foundation building blocks of mathematics:
* Algebra
* Addition and Subtraction
* Comparison
* Counting
* Data analysis
* Decimal operations
* Decimals
* Fractions
* Geometry
* Length and Area
* Measurement
* Multiplication and division including times tables
* Mixed operations
* Money
* Patterns
* Percentages
* Problem-solving
* Reading and writing digits
* Time

bluejetty:00062641:ios.description:
Is singing your childhood dream? Let’s make that a reality!
Riyaz has fulfilled the dreams of 30,00,000+ passionate singing aspirants. Just invest 10-15 mins a day on yourself. Be a proud connoisseur and a happy lifelong learner of music!
Learn and practice singing with precise, instant feedback that guides you optimally to overcome your mistakes! No shyness, no embarrassment! With Riyaz, anybody can learn to sing! Give it a shot!!
Download now and have ready access to thousands of practice lessons and songs in Carnatic, Hindustani classical, Devotional (light classical), and Western classical music styles!
The smart visual tanpura in Riyaz helps you know and fix your mistakes before anyone else can. Let Riyaz record your practices to understand how much you exercised your voice!
Top riyazers spend more than an hour daily doing sadhana and learning singing with the lessons offered! Join us today!
Do get in touch with us (feedback [at] riyazapp [dot] com) if you need anything else as an aspiring singer or face any issues with Riyaz, we promise a reply to every email!
Riyaz serves the needs of singing aspirants from absolute beginners to professional singers and everyone in between. We regularly update and add lots of lessons in all the music styles supported in Riyaz. Do send in your requests, we honor them :-)
In Hindustani music, Beginner singing lessons include sargam, paltas and alankars. Advanced singing lessons include more than 45 raags with several bandishes in all those raags.
In Carnatic music - Beginner lessons include Swaravalis, and intermediate and advanced singing lessons include Nottuswarams, Geethams, Geethams, Jatisvaras, and Svarajatis.
In Devotional and light classical categories, Riyaz has various bhajans in praise of the deities. You're never too far from finding that perfect bhajan for offering your prayers. 
In Western classical music, we have structured vocal exercises for warm-up, vocal agility, dexterity, and vocal range. We also offer extensive solfege-based exercises and lessons to practice and be pitch perfect. Also comes with plenty of exercises to learn intervals, combinations of notes, rests, and much more!
Whether you are a kid/teenager/adult, Riyaz supports all voice types and vocal ranges across all the course offerings for comfortable practice! Riyaz keeps track of your progress so that you know what’s happening.
What are you waiting for? Come join the largest singing revolution the world has ever witnessed! :-)
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
All the content on Riyaz is offered for free, but the free version allows you to practice only 8 minutes per day. We offer a premium version with “unlimited practice” through a recurring subscription. Users can subscribe to either the monthly or annual subscription packages which are automatically renewed unless canceled by the user. An active subscription will give users unlimited practice to all content available on Riyaz.
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Service - https://riyazapp.com/terms-of-service/
If you have questions, suggestions, or feedback please write to us at [feedback]@riyazapp[dot]com

bluejetty:00021494:ios.description:
Some cards are innocent. Some will make the whole room go quiet.
EVERY CARD
- A statement starting with "I have never..." appears
- Everybody taps I have or Never
- Then you see who did it
FIVE LEVELS
- Soft, Embarrassing and Funny are ready from the start
- Hot and Trash are for adults only: confirm you are 18+ to unlock them, and they stay locked for under-18s
- If anyone in the room uses Family mode, Hot and Trash are switched off for all
HOST SETTINGS
- Mix and match the levels you want in the deck
- Optionally set a timer on each card
- The next card unlocks once everyone has answered
- Cards are available in many languages
CHATS WITH FRIENDS
- Chat 1:1 or in groups with your PalliTalk friends, with the same account, plus search
- Text, replies, edits, reactions, pins and forwarding
- Photos, videos and the camera, GIFs, files, polls and shared lists
- Voice messages with transcription
- Draw live together, send view-once Snap photos, and find the surprise hidden in "Place mine"
- Secret chats with end-to-end encryption
- Instagram and Facebook video links play right in the chat
- Chat themes, wallpapers and decorations, Face ID lock, hidden chats and a shared calendar
- Create groups and add members; every game room has its own group chat
- @mention the assistant to sum up a chat, suggest places and plans, make a list, translate or fix your writing
GAMES IN EVERY CHAT
- Play Draw & Guess, Face Draw, Petit Bac, I Never, Tic-tac-toe, Rock-paper-scissors, Guess the Place (find the spot from street imagery) and Flappy inside any chat
- Each chat has its own leaderboard
- Send a lone spider, rat, frog, snake or bee emoji and watch a swarm appear
STICKERS AND STYLES
- Open the sticker button in a chat for the sticker tray and store, and community packs
- Make stickers of your face from one selfie, and export them to WhatsApp and Telegram
- Styles restyle a photo of you, with photo tools such as Perfect shot
- Styles are paid with coins, bought as one-time in-app purchases
FRIENDS
- Add friends by link, @username, QR scan or your own QR code
- Your QR can also sign you in to PalliTalk on the web
- Friend profiles with posts, media and stats
- Watch friends' stories and reply
- Block, report and mute
PLAY TAB
- Start a new game, join with a room code, and see your rooms and friends
- Invite friends with a code or link, or send the invite into PalliTalk chats and groups
- Incoming invites show up right where you play
- Live voice in every room: hold to talk or keep it on (audio only, no video)
- A PalliTalk card and a "More games on PalliTalk" row on Home open PalliTalk or its App Store page
ACCOUNT
- One PalliTalk account, no third-party ads
- Change your password, manage blocked users, delete your account, and read terms, privacy and contact in Settings
Be honest. Everyone is watching.

bluejetty:00032651:ios.description:
Whether you’re a meticulous planner or prefer a more spontaneous approach, equipping yourself with our RV app can make a world of difference.Our app caters to all types of RV travelers and simplifies the planning process making your journey a breeze.
Instead of slogging through hours of research, get similar results with AI. 
Would you let AI help plan your next vacation? For the time-poor among us, it's a tempting proposition. Yet while travelers are still debating the safety and merits of using AI for trip planning, we are already diving headfirst into the technology.
There's no two ways about it -- planning a great trip is a labor-intensive activity. If you're not careful, you can spend as long reading about and preparing to visit your chosen destination as you'll eventually spend on the ground there. And with many major cities attracting more visitors than ever, travelers need to do some preparation. 
A well-constructed travel itinerary is more than just a list of attractions, neighborhoods and local businesses. The best itineraries will string your day together in a way that makes sense geographically and thematically. 
It's about a balance between seeing the big sites and getting out and doing other things. Together with our application you get a digital travel companion that can understand and provide assistance at your journey. It is a great way to save time, costs and increase efficiency. AI can help predict your needs and favorite destinations. From the consumer viewpoint, Artificial Intelligence makes it easier for users to find the relevant information, make more informed decisions and get an overall better customer experience.
AI can provide a great framework for your trip, but it's still up to you to fact-check it before traveling! Though, our application is your own pocket travel guide.

bluejetty:00142775:ios.developer: 梦想合力(北京)科技有限公司
bluejetty:00142775:ios.summary:
Record important conversations, ideas, lectures, interviews, and creative projects with a professional voice recorder built for more than basic audio capture.
Voice Recorder combines high-quality recording, offline transcription, AI summar
bluejetty:00142775:ios.description:
Record important conversations, ideas, lectures, interviews, and creative projects with a professional voice recorder built for more than basic audio capture.
Voice Recorder combines high-quality recording, offline transcription, AI summaries, audio editing, voice effects, and a dedicated Creation Mode in one app. Capture audio, turn speech into searchable text, organize the key points, and create finished content without switching between multiple tools.
PROFESSIONAL RECORDING
Record meetings, classes, interviews, voice notes, music ideas, and more.
• Record in the background
• Reduce noise and enhance voices
• Choose mono or stereo recording
• Record with a Bluetooth headset
• Add markers while recording
• Schedule a recording to start and stop automatically
• Record with background music
• Apply voice effects during or after recording
• Organize recordings with tags
• Export in MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, and other formats
• Record at up to 128 kHz and 320 kbps
OFFLINE SPEECH TO TEXT
Turn recordings into editable text without sending your content to an online transcription service.
• Real-time transcription while recording
• Transcribe imported audio and video files
• On-device transcription in 42 languages
• AI transcription in 112 languages
• Automatically identify different speakers
• Adjust speaker segments when recognition needs correction
• Export and share transcripts
AI NOTES AND TRANSLATION
Spend less time reviewing long recordings.
• Generate summaries from transcripts
• Choose from multiple summary templates
• Extract key information from meetings, lectures, and interviews
• Translate transcripts across 59 languages
• Edit and organize text before sharing
CREATION MODE
Build polished audio around a script, idea, or performance.
• Upload or paste a script
• Record while following your text
• Add markers, sound effects, and background music
• Adjust voice and music levels
• Insert a new recording at a selected position
• Trim and arrange your content
• Export the finished project
SPEAKER-BASED VOICE EFFECTS
Protect or creatively change a selected voice without changing every speaker in the recording.
After speaker recognition is complete, select the speaker you want to modify and apply a voice effect only to that person. You can also use voice effects while recording or apply them afterward.
EDIT AND PLAYBACK TOOLS
• Trim unwanted sections
• Adjust recording volume
• Convert video to audio
• Repeat a selected section
• Skip silent sections
• Play audio from 0.5x to 3x speed
• Change speed with or without changing pitch
• Lock sensitive recordings with a password
• Create ringtones on iOS 26, or export them through GarageBand on earlier iOS versions
YOUR RECORDINGS, YOUR CHOICE
Recordings are stored locally by default. Cloud backup is optional and can be enabled when you want automatic backup and synchronization across your devices.
Whether you are capturing a meeting, reviewing a lecture, conducting an interview, recording a voice-over, or creating an audio project, Voice Recorder gives you the tools to record, transcribe, edit, and share your work in one place.
SUBSCRIPTION AND PURCHASE INFORMATION
The app may offer weekly, monthly, and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, as well as a one-time lifetime purchase. Available plans and prices are shown on the purchase screen and may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the purchase is confirmed. Auto-renewable subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00041761:ios.description:
Turn your words into picture quotes and post them in seconds.
Pick from 2,000+ ready quotes on love, motivation, wisdom and life, add your photo and sign it with your name.
Out of ideas? Wia, the AI quote writer, creates a new one for you.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Start with a quote: the quote of the day, a category, Wia, or your own words.
2. Pick a template made for feed, Stories and status.
3. Adjust the look, add your identity, and share in one tap.
2,000+ READY QUOTES
Motivational, inspirational, love, wisdom, life, friendship, success, funny, God, Christmas and more. Categories sorted A to Z. Copy, favorite or turn any quote into an image straight from the list.
WIA, YOUR AI QUOTE WRITER
Type a theme and get original quotes in seconds: captions, sayings, reflections and daily content. Not quite right? Refine it until it sounds like you.
TEMPLATES FOR EVERY MOMENT
Clean, modern templates for feed, Stories and status, including love, birthdays, good morning, good night, Christmas and New Year. Start from a template, a blank canvas or a grid with several photos. Use a photo from your gallery or from Unsplash.
YOUR IDENTITY ON EVERY POST
Name, photo, @handle and badge appear on the artwork. It's not a social profile, it's the signature of the image. Switch identities in one tap: you, a page, or a brand.
ADD TEXT TO PHOTOS LIKE A DESIGNER
Fonts, size, color, alignment, borders, shadows, neon effects, spacing and layout. Match the mood of the photo or the message. Export in high quality.
DAILY QUOTE AND WIDGET
A hand-picked quote for every day of the year, in the app and in a widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Tap the widget and the quote opens ready to become an image.
MY CREATIONS
Drafts and exported images stay in the app. Come back to edit, duplicate and make a new version without starting over.
FROM ANY APP TO KIWIA
Found a quote in another app? Tap Share and choose Kiwia. Or ask Siri for the daily phrase or a new image.
CREATE EVERY DAY, EARN CREDITS
The weekly challenge, creation streaks and inviting friends earn you extra Wia credits.
SAVE AND SHARE
Save to your gallery and post to Instagram, WhatsApp and anywhere else. Favorite quotes stay ready for the next image.
KIWIA PRO (OPTIONAL)
Unlock extra tools inside the app:
• No ads and no watermark
• Every PRO template unlocked
• Exclusive fonts, styles and backgrounds
• Write with Wia without watching ads
• Up to 3 identities and an always-on verification badge
• Widget with color themes and quotes from your favorites or a category
Features and prices are shown clearly in the app before you buy.
Download it free and make your first picture quote now.

Privacy Policy: https://vadeapps.com/kiwia/politica.html

bluejetty:00168077:ios.description:
Ya está disponible la app La Biblia de las Américas
Esta es una nueva traducción de las Escrituras de los idiomas originales. Completado en 1986 por un equipo de eruditos bíblicos evangélicos latinoamericanos, La Biblia de las Américas es una obra original traducida del hebreo-arameo y griego directamente al español moderno. Siguiendo los mismos principios de traducción establecidos para la NASB, La Biblia de las Américas es comprensible para el público en general y también adecuada para un estudio serio.
Con la Aplicación de la Biblia de las Américas (LBLA) podrás disfrutar de la lectura del único libro que verdaderamente es la boca de DIOS, y de una traducción fiel al texto Bíblico original.
La Biblia de las Américas traduce (no interpreta) el sentido de las palabras de los idiomas originales. Por eso, Ud. puede leerla con la seguridad y convicción de que está leyendo la PALABRA DE DIOS CONFIABLE:
La aplicación es fácil de usar y te permite leer las sagradas escrituras de forma rápida y cómoda, sin necesidad de conexión a internet.
Con esta aplicación, podrás navegar a través de toda la sabiduría de la Biblia, conocer el origen del universo, la historia de Jesús a través del Nuevo Testamento y mucho más. En sus páginas, encontraras todas las respuestas a todas tus preguntas.
Descárgala ahora e invita a tus amigos y a tus seres queridos a que también puedan llevar con ellos la palabra del Señor con esta completísima aplicación de la Biblia de las Américas.
En Biblia de las Américas encontrarás recursos bíblicos interesantes como: 
- Como estudiar la Biblia: te enseñamos por dónde empezar a leerla, la frecuencia con que debes hacerlo, la cantidad que debes leer por cada vez o cómo utilizarla.
- Como interpretar la Biblia: Aprenda a usar la Biblia como se merece y a interpretarla bien siguiendo todas las fichas que se muestran.
- Estudio de la Biblia donde encontrarás en Antiguo Testamento y el Nuevo testamento.
- Diccionario Teológico: Totalmente offline para que usted pueda consultar cuando desee todas las definiciones acerca de la teología.
- Oraciones cristianas: Libro de oraciones que nadie debe perderse y usar antes de dormir. Podrás Leerlas y Rezarlas todos los días sin estar conectado a internet.
- Temas Bíblicos: dividido en una serie de artículos que van desde el aborto hasta la vida nueva, pasando por temas tan variados como el alcohol, la amistad, la depresión, el divorcio, la homosexualidad, la lujuria, obediencia, paciencia, soledad o tentación. 
- Bosquejos cristianos para predicaciones cristianas. Predica y estudia la palabra de Dios con la ayuda de estos magníficos bosquejos que ponemos a tu disposición.
- Recursos Teológicos: Un complemento imprescindible donde encontrará toda la información sobre teología sistemática y teología fundamental, enciclopedia y unas fichas teológicas.
- Temas y devocionales Cristianos 
- Evangelio del día
y muchos más recursos Bíblicos
La Aplicación Biblia de las Américas se considera una herramienta eficiente para el estudio de la palabra de Dios, el autor intelectual es Dios.
¡Lleve la Biblia a todas partes! Los mejores consejos para sobrellevar los problemas más complicados de la vida se encuentran en sus páginas. Las escrituras son muy útiles y ayudan a muchas familias a ser felices.
Escuchar los consejos de la Biblia nos hace más sabios. Póngase en manos de Dios, abrace la Biblia y siga sus consejos.
Descarga ya la Biblia de las Américas y comparte con nosotros tu experiencia.

bluejetty:00179711:ios.description:
Award-Winning Customer Experience at Your Fingertips - Winner of the prestigious iF Design Award 2026 for User Experience, the Maxis app is the ultimate, all-in-one digital command center designed exclusively for Maxis Postpaid, Maxis Business, and Home Fibre users. Manage your mobile lines, home internet, device contracts, and lifestyle rewards effortlessly with a cleaner layout, faster navigation, and fewer mental gymnastics.
WHY USE THE MAXIS APP?
1. Multi-Line & Family Management - Are you the principal account holder? View and manage all linked supplementary family lines or Hotlink lines in one unified dashboard. Dynamically track individual data usage or allocate shared data pools with a few quick taps.
2. Easy Bill Management & E-Bills - Say goodbye to paper clutter. Easily switch to e-bills to receive statements directly in the app. Freely switch between summary or itemized bills, download past bills, track current unbilled amounts, pay bills seamlessly, and set up secure auto-debit payments instantly.
3. All-In-One Converged Ecosystem - Track more than just your phone line. Seamlessly manage your Maxis Home Fibre, Home 4G WiFi network settings, and check your ongoing mobile device contract details (Maxis Zerolution) anytime.
4. Meet Maxis AI (Your 24/7 Digital Assistant) - Get instant, conversational support without waiting in queues. Just ask Maxis AI for roaming pass recommendations, get help clarifying bill issues, check contract details, or perform Fibre troubleshooting.
5. Smooth Travelling & Roaming UI - Pre-book international data passes effortlessly before you fly, with the freedom to cancel your scheduled pass anywhere, anytime. Need an extra data injection while abroad? Easily top up with a booster pass whenever you need more data while roaming.
6. Direct Lifestyle Perks & Deals - Unlock premium localized rewards, dining vouchers, and exclusive shopping deals tailored right to your scroll. Track your past lifestyle spending instantly by navigating to View Details > Lifestyle services > Transactions.
Download the Maxis App today and experience frictionless telco management, designed around you.

bluejetty:00066264:ios.description:
The original Rummikub FREE version (not Rummy nor Rummy Cube or Okey) is one of the most popular family games in the world. 
The unique combination of tactical thinking, luck and tense competition has made this classic family game to one of the most successful games for the past 70 years! Arrange the tiles to create the smartest color and numbers combinations. 
Will you be the first player to place all tiles and win the match?
* Play the classic Rummikub game online with your friends, family or players from all around the World.
* You can choose to connect with your Facebook account, Game Center or as a guest. 
* Collect a daily bonus and get rewarded for coming back everyday.
PLAY NOW
Play ONLINE with millions of Rummikub players from all around the world and try to win as many points as you can to become the Rummikub Master!
CUSTOM GAME
CREATE a public table with your own preferences; number of players, turn time and entry fee. 
PRIVATE GAME
INVITE FRIENDS and family members to play! 
Create private tables and choose your own personal game settings.
You can see which of your friends are online from your Facebook's friendlist and invite them to join you to play a fun classic Rummikub game.
We offer a few types of tables - for conservative, moderate and High Roller's players.
PRACTICE GAME
Play against computer players (also available OFFLINE). Define the turn time, opponents number and difficulty level.
Includes 10 supported languages - English, German, French, Dutch, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese, and Turkish.
Experienced a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at support@rummikub-apps.com

bluejetty:00116629:ios.description:
Potty with Pull-Ups® ft. Disney® helps your toddler become a BIG KID® as you train & track. Plus, reward with play moments featuring Mickey and His Pals
Key Features: 
• Navigate an easy-to-use dashboard: The “Today” tab acts as your potty training hub with three different modes, each corresponding to your child’s point in their potty training journey. Complete training tasks, prepare for upcoming milestones, view rewards, review events, and stay informed with helpful reading. 
• Track progress with the Potty Plan: Track successes, attempts, and accidents in the Event Log while encouraging and rewarding good hygiene. Did your child have a setback? Pause training any time they need a break. Every event you log is conveniently displayed in the dashboard along with your child’s progress in their Potty Plan. 
• Develop skills with milestones: Each milestone contains a multitude of skills for your child to learn, like prioritizing potty breaks, communicating when they are done, and going potty without assistance from an adult. 
• Reward with the BIG KID® Center: Completing each training milestone in the Potty Plan unlocks a new instrument to play in the BIG KID® Band. There, your child can play along with their favorite Disney characters! 
 o Mickey Mouse on guitar 
 o Minnie Mouse on keyboard 
 o Goofy on drums 
 o Donald on electric bass 
 o Daisy on trumpet 
 o Pluto on tambourine 
 o Chip ‘n Dale on the sampler 
Play time can easily be managed with our built-in timer. 
Looking for help? https://www.pull-ups.com/en-us/contact-us

bluejetty:00030314:ios.name: Cell Track: GPS Phone Tracker
bluejetty:00030314:ios.summary: Discover the all-in-one GPS tracker and location sharing app SafeKit! It is designed to keep your family, kids, friends, and loved ones connected and secure. With Family & Friends Locator, you can effortlessly track their real-time whereabo
bluejetty:00030314:ios.description:
Discover the all-in-one GPS tracker and location sharing app SafeKit! It is designed to keep your family, kids, friends, and loved ones connected and secure. With Family & Friends Locator, you can effortlessly track their real-time whereabouts on a live, shared, and private map while enjoying these essential features:
**KIDS & FAMILY & FRIENDS Location Tracker**
Stay in the know about your loved ones' locations at all times. Our intuitive location tracking feature lets you monitor the real-time positions of your family members, kids, and friends, allowing you to nurture that vital connection.
**Add Places and Get Notified**
Enhance your peace of mind by adding specific places to the map and receiving instant notifications when your family members arrive or depart from these locations. Effortlessly keep track of their movements and ensure everyone's safety with this feature.
**Emergency SOS Function**
Safety is our top priority. In emergencies, simply tap the SOS button, and all members of your circles will receive urgent push notifications, complete with a live update of your current location. Rest easy, knowing that help is just a click away for your child, partner, or friend.
**Smart Circles**
Create customized Smart Circles, where you and your circle members can share real-time locations and access location history. Invite members effortlessly with a link, ensuring you're always connected to those who matter most.
**Geo-fence Zones**
Stay informed with Geo-fence Zones. Define specific areas by dropping a pin on the map, name them, set the radius, and receive push notifications when circle members enter or exit these zones. From ensuring your child's safe arrival at school to welcoming a family member home, Geo zones keep you informed effortlessly.
**Additional Features**
- View location history for each circle member.
- "Find my device" functionality for lost phones.
- Manage group circles and geo-fence zones with ease.
- Stay tuned for upcoming features and enhancements.
Make Family & Friends Locator your go-to GPS geo tracker and family locator app, prioritizing the safety and security of your loved ones. 
Subscription Notice:
-This app provide the family plan and single plan. Family year subscription is $39.99; Family week subscription is $7.99; Family month subscription is $9.99; Single device year subscription is $29.99; Single device week subscription is $5.99; Single device month subscription is $7.99; 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings at iTunes Store after purchase.
Terms of use: https://www.tracklocation.info/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.tracklocation.info/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00082300:ios.description:
Punch, Kick & Throw them out!
Step into the electrifying world of Brawl Stars Wrestling, an arcade-style wrestling game with stunning 3D mini-monsters, immersive backgrounds, and fast-paced gameplay. 
Featuring many playable characters ranging from wrestling legends to present-day superstars, there's a wrestler for every fan. With four unique game modes, including the engaging Story Mode, and over 50 possible match variations, Brawl Stars Wrestling offers an unforgettable gaming experience. Do you have the skills to become the ultimate champion of the ring? It's time to find out.
An unforgettable rumble boxing experience with Brawl Without Limits! Immerse yourself in a thrilling gaming experience as you enter the ring and witness all-new, action-packed arcade gameplay.
- Your Battleground For Fight:
Try your best to stay in the ring till the end. Pull up your sleeves now because this is the time to show your skills. Punch the other ragdoll wrestler, hit them hard and throw them outside the ring, and show others who is the best wrestler. Upgrade your powers and join the tournament to KO strong opponents.
Don't wait any longer - download this game now and immerse yourself in a world of excitement and challenge. Demonstrate your wrestling expertise while working alongside your squad and enjoying an authentic experience in a unique style. With an array of game modes and a range of features, there's something different for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the ultimate champion? Download the game now and let the fun begin!

-Be a super hero of the gang.
-Two touch control
-Punch ‘em, hit ‘em or throw ‘em
-Skills of Boxing games & punching games
-Multiple fighting modes
-3D stylized animation of unique monster wrestlers
-Smooth graphics and amazing environment
-Offline game and easy to play

bluejetty:00179944:ios.summary:

Contact group management is only a basic function. And you can manage gro
bluejetty:00179944:ios.description:
▷ Optimal technology for contact group management
◉ All-in-One, The Evolution of Contacts App
Manage your contacts into groups and contact your contacts as a group.
Contact group management is only a basic function. And you can manage groups more conveniently than the default app.
Additionally, advanced search features, group messaging, group email, bulk delete contact, organize contacts, contact backup, quick favorites, speed dial, smart search dial, etc.
These various features have been integrated into One App.
◉ Secure Contact Tool
Contact data is valuable information to you. The contacts App uses the system's data, so it should work correctly and handle your data securely.
◉ Functions and Features
[Real-time Synchronization]
• Since the Contact data of the system is used as it is, the work contents are immediately reflected.
[Multiple selection methods]
• Most tasks can be processed quickly with multiple selections.
[Contact Group Management]
• Create a group and add contacts as group members
• Organize multiple contacts into multiple groups at the same time
• Copy or move contacts between groups
• Real-time synchronization with the contact group on the system
• Simultaneous support of iCloud and CardDAV
[Advanced Contact Search Function]
• Extract optimal data by specifying phone number or name as search method
• Can search for initials in Korean language including double consonants
[Group Message, Group Email]
• Multiple contacts to send a message at the same time
• Provides separate message-writing tools for convenient input
[Organize contacts]
• Extract and organize contacts into various conditions
• Delete contacts in bulk
[Backup Contact]
• Backup or restore contacts by group
• Archiving backup data by email
[Contact Favorites]
• Easily call and send messages to frequently used contacts
[Smart Search Dial]
• Dial pad with search contacts
• Set up Speed dialing for speed dials
• Change the touch sound of the dial
• Search for initials using Korean consonants
◉ Notification
• You must allow access to your iPhone when you first launch the App.
• If the list of the order in your contact list changes after iOS updates, please change your iPhone settings. (Mail, Contacts, Calendars > Sort Order, Display Order)
• Contact groups in Exchange mail are not supported.
• The user's contact information is not used separately or sent outside.

bluejetty:00091172:ios.name: PowerVision 4
bluejetty:00091172:ios.summary: Power Vision 4 from Dynojet Research Inc. combined with your iPhone puts you in control of your bike’s engine. Gain access to hundreds of different tunes for various aftermarket components and easily flash any of them to you bike’s ECU. Un
bluejetty:00091172:ios.description:
Power Vision 4 from Dynojet Research Inc. combined with your iPhone puts you in control of your bike’s engine. Gain access to hundreds of different tunes for various aftermarket components and easily flash any of them to you bike’s ECU. Unbelievably quick and easy to use; make more power and torque with the push of a button. Advanced users can edit hundreds of individual engine parameters to build a tune that’s dialed in for their unique setup using Dynojet’s integrated cloud tune delivery system.
With the PV4 App and our pocket-sized PV4 device you can:
• Flash tunes to your ECU – no setup required, just create an account, select your tune, flash, and ride the ultimate ride.
• Access to vast database of pre-loaded tunes for different configurations – no custom tuning required.
• Easily download and manage pre-loaded and custom tunes.
• Record real-time engine data and review in WinPEP 8 Data Center.
• Read, review, clear, and share diagnostic trouble codes (DTC’s) with built-in descriptions.
• Flash an unlimited number of bikes with one device.* 
• Use licenses from your Power Vision Classic with your Power Vision 4.
• Return to stock at any time – your original, factory tune is safely backed up on the cloud and on your phone.
• Optimized for remote-tuning. – Easily ride, record, and share data logs with your tuner for trouble-free custom tuning without a dynamometer.
• Keep your ECU – The Power Vision 4 reprograms your bike without having to remove or mail-in the ECU. Just plug into the diagnostic connector and flash, it’s really that easy.
• Autotune - Choose from three different Autotune modes to dial your HD motorcycle in the way that fits you best.
• Dynamometer Compatible - Plug your PV4 directly into your Dynojet Dynamometer to view channels, flash, read diagnostic information, read RPM via OBD, and load control without an inductive pickup. 
• Flashes on HD motorcycles as fast as 12.75 seconds (select models)
• Active Tests help diagnose problems on your HD - cycle the fuel pump, indicators, water pump, and many other components when troubleshooting engine or electrical issues.
• Diagnostic Routines allow you to bleed the ABS system at home
World class, US-based customer service from our team of motorcycle enthusiasts is also available to suggest the best tune, review data recordings, or assist in troubleshooting. Your ultimate ride awaits with Power Vision 4 – download the app and see how easy tuning can be! 
* First bike license included with purchase of Power Vision 4 device. Requires purchase of license for each additional bike
DISCLAIMER: Not legal for sale or use in California

bluejetty:00091852:ios.description:
With Fonoma you send a recharge to your people in Cuba in seconds, from wherever you are. Top up a Cubacel phone, send ETECSA data plans, or add balance to your family's Nauta account, all from one app and backed by a service that has been running since 2012.
How it works
1. Choose the service: recharge a phone (Cubacel or data plans) or internet (Nauta).
2. Enter the Cuban number or Nauta account and the amount you want to send.
3. Pay with card, PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay, and the recharge is delivered instantly.
Recharge Cubacel
Add voice, SMS, and mobile data to any Cubacel number in Cuba. Pick an amount and your family is ready to call, text, and browse.
ETECSA data plans
Send mobile data packages so your loved ones can stay connected without running out of gigs.
Nauta internet
Recharge Nauta and Nauta Hogar accounts for public WiFi hotspots and home internet.
Deals and savings
1. $5 off your first recharge.
2. 3% cashback on every recharge, always.
3. Refer a friend: they get $5 off their first recharge and you earn $7 in credit.
What you can do in the app
1. All three services in one place: Cubacel, data plans, and Nauta.
2. Save your contacts and repeat a recharge in seconds.
3. Delivery confirmation and a receipt sent straight to your email.
4. Clear pricing, no hidden fees.
Pay securely
We accept credit, debit, and prepaid cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Your payment details are encrypted and never shared.
Trusted since 2012
Since 2012, Fonoma has worked to bring Cuban families and friends together, making it easier, faster, and safer to send recharges from abroad.
We're here to help

Blog: https://www.fonoma.com/blog/en
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FonomaCuba
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fonomacuba
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fonoma
X: https://x.com/FonomaCuba
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@FonomaCuba

bluejetty:00137235:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Craft: Magical Adventure!
Get ready to embark on a captivating infinite craft journey of fusion and discovery! If you love the fun of merge games, are looking for a sprinkle of adventure, and want an experience that blends puzzle solving with whimsical story elements, then Merge Craft is the perfect free game for you!
The Essence of Merge Craft
Imagine a beautiful board brimming with peculiar items. Seeds, tools, trinkets, and treasures—all holding magical possibilities. Your goal is simple yet endlessly engaging: Merge identical items to evolve them into higher forms! Two seeds become a sprout, two sprouts a flower, and so on. Uncover an ever-expanding array of unique and fantastical creations as you combine more and more objects.
The Magical Market
Your magical merging isn't just for fun! This enchanting world is filled with curious customers hungry for the extraordinary. They'll arrive with requests for potions, amulets, and other spellbinding products – all crafted using your amazing merged items. Fulfill their wishes and be rewarded with a treasure trove of coins! Spend your earnings wisely to further unlock captivating story elements and progress through increasingly exciting levels.
Key Features that Enchant
Merge, Merge, Merge! It's fun, it's addictive, and it's the heart of Merge Craft. The fusion possibilities are endless!
A Story That Unfolds: Rewards aren't just coins – uncover hidden chapters of an immersive tale with every successful sale.
Offline Play? Absolutely! Enjoy the delightful world of merging anywhere, anytime, no WiFi required.
Enchanting Graphics: Lose yourself in vibrant visuals and a stunning fantasy world with every tap.
Brain-Teasing Fun: Merge Craft blends relaxing gameplay with satisfyingly strategic puzzles and challenges.
For Fans of These Games
Enjoy similar gameplay and love games like Travel Town and Merge Gardens? Consider yourself a lover of mansion renovations, captivating adventures or relaxing garden escapes? Then Merge Craft is absolutely for you!
More Reasons to Love Merge Craft
Regular Updates: New items, events, and stories are always brewing, ensuring continued freshness.
No Pay-To-Win: Skill and patience, not deep pockets, are your magic keys to success.
Join the Community: Connect with other Merge Craft enthusiasts and share your progress with friends!
Download Merge Craft: Magical Adventure today and begin your infinite merging odyssey!
Privacy Policy: https://www.mobiversite.com/privacypolicy
Terms & Conditions: https://www.mobiversite.com/terms
EULA: https://www.mobiversite.com/eula

HOW
bluejetty:00019260:ios.description:
The reference Fantasy Football game with over 2 million managers!
Think you’re the best football manager among your friends? Prove it on Mon Petit Gazon (MPG), the ultimate fantasy football and management game to play with your mates.
HOW IT WORKS
1. CREATE YOUR PRIVATE LEAGUE: Invite your friends, family, or colleagues into a custom-made league.
2. LIVE AUCTION MERCATO: With a €500M budget, go head-to-head with your rivals in secret auctions to sign the best players from Premier League, Champions League, LaLiga, Serie A, and Ligue 1.
3. SET YOUR LINEUP: Pick your tactics, choose your starting XI, and bench your substitutes before the weekend kicks off.
4. 1v1 MATCHUPS EVERY WEEKEND: Face off against a mate each gameweek. If your players perform in real life (real goals or high ratings given by journalists), you score virtual goals in your MPG match!
BOOSTERS & BANTER
Because a simple fantasy game isn't enough, spice up your matches with our iconic game-changers to flip the scoreline:
- "La Valise à Nanard" to bribe the referee
- Suarez, The Mirror & The Cheat Code
- McDo+, Tonton Pat', Le Zahia, and many more!
Watch out for bad surprises: if your forwards flop in real life, "Rotaldo" might just step onto the pitch for you...
SPECIAL TOURNAMENTS & REWARDS
On top of your private league, join official tournaments, challenge the global community, climb the leaderboard, and unlock exclusive rewards throughout the football season.
WHY DOWNLOAD MPG?
- A 100% free and addictive Fantasy Football game.
- Live ratings and match results every weekend.
- Perfect for group chats, football nights, and friendly banter.
- All major competitions: Premier League, Champions League, top European leagues, and international tournaments.
Get your banter ready, put on your manager jacket, and join the ultimate football community.
Download MPG and start your transfer window now!

bluejetty:00175201:ios.description:
From ordinary to-do list to a real masterpiece: plan your day, week or month creatively. Everyday planner with cute templates combined with calendar - it's Pencil Calendar!
We have prepared a lot of creative tools to make planning process simple and fun for you. Choose a day, use your finger or the Apple Pencil (or just type your plans down), add some stickers and choose background to make an ordinary to-do list a real masterpiece. Have you noticed how daily planning has become something more than just a routine?
HUGE PLANNING TEMPLATES COLLECTION
There are a lot of backgrounds for your daily planning inspiration:
- simple checkered, lined and dotted sheets;
- cute to-do lists and schedules;
- daily focus organizers and blocks;
- checklists and reminders;
- weekly/monthly/yearly planners;
- holiday and themed ready-made templates;
- focusing on your goals.
LIFE-ORGANIZING STICKERS
Make your plan special with prepared stickers or add some on your own. WOW! Now your checklist is even prettier than before!
NEW! TRENDING TEMPLATES FEED
Create and share your stunning template designs while exploring a collection of creative templates shared by users worldwide. Use popular designs, save time and discover endless inspiration.
SHARE THE RESULT
Seems like you've created a nice one to-do list. So it's time to share your work with friends!
Let your imagination run wild in planning with Pencil Calendar.
VARIETY OF FONTS
If you don't want to draw you can just type your plans down. We've prepared a lot of beautiful fonts for these purposes.
SYNC WITH CALENDAR AND REMINDERS
Now you can synchronize your native calendar with Pencil Calendar. Set up reminders for plans you can't miss!
DEVICE SYNC
Any changes made on one device are automatically updated in real-time, providing a consistent and organized experience. Enjoy the convenience of having your essential data always at your fingertips.
LIFE-HACK for users running iOS 16 and higher: you can copy a subject by long tap on photo you need and then paste it to the drawing window!
Note! Some features are available in the Premium version: unlimited AI stickers generation, all collection of templates, unrestricted planning, all stickers 
Privacy Policy: https://simpledio.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://simpledio.com/tos

bluejetty:00014217:ios.summary: Autodesk Fusion™ for iPhone and iPad lets you collaborate on 3D designs with anyone inside or outside your company. With the Fusion app, you have the flexibility to view and collaborate on your Fusion CAD models—anytime, anywhere. The app s
bluejetty:00014217:ios.description:
Autodesk Fusion™ for iPhone and iPad lets you collaborate on 3D designs with anyone inside or outside your company. With the Fusion app, you have the flexibility to view and collaborate on your Fusion CAD models—anytime, anywhere. The app supports more than 100 file formats including DWG, SLDPRT, IPT, IAM, CATPART,IGES, STEP, STL, making it easy to share designs with your team, clients, partners, and friends.
The free app works in conjunction with its companion cloud-based desktop product, Autodesk Fusion™, a 3D CAD, CAM, and CAE tool for product design and development.
* To use Fusion for iPhone and iPad, you will need to sign in with your Fusion account information.
FEATURES
View
• Upload and view more than 100 data formats including SLDPRT, SAT, IGES, STEP, STL, OBJ, DWG, F3D, SMT, and DFX
• View and track project activities and updates
• Review large and small 3D designs and assemblies 
• Access design properties and complete parts lists
• Isolate and hide components in the model for easy viewing 
• Navigate by touch with zoom, pan, and rotate
Comment
• Upload photos to share info or report project status 
• Comment on project activities
Share
• Share with stakeholders inside and outside your company
• Share screenshots of the design with markups directly from the app
Search
• Search for parts in the model and see them automatically highlighted in the design 
SUPPORT: https://knowledge.autodesk.com/contact-support
Optional Access
+ Storage: Store offline data if needed, so you can view your data anywhere, anytime
+ Photos: Access files or data stored on your device to view, share and markup
+ Camera: Take pictures such as drawings with app
Fusion will still function even if a user does not give permissions to access these functions.

bluejetty:00068808:ios.summary:

AI Meeting Analyst: Turn Talk into Clarity Don’t waste time re-listening to hour-long recordings. JotLink records your meetings or calls and uses AI to absorb the full conversation.

bluejetty:00068808:ios.description:
KEY FEATURES:
AI Meeting Analyst: Turn Talk into Clarity Don’t waste time re-listening to hour-long recordings. JotLink records your meetings or calls and uses AI to absorb the full conversation.
• Just Ask: Chat with your audio file. Ask "What deadlines were set?" or "What was the budget?".
• Extract: Get precise summaries, action items, and next steps in seconds.
Ghost Mode: Ultimate Privacy Go beyond simple "locked folders."
• Smart PIN Privacy: Experience a new level of control. Your app can now display entirely different chat lists depending on the PIN you enter.
• Only you know what truly exists. Zero visible indicators, just pure, seamless privacy.
The Anti-Poach Shield Protect your business relationships. In JotLink groups, clients and contractors work together without seeing each other's contact info.
• Anonymous Groups: Prevent clients from bypassing you. You own the relationship.
• Identity Protection: Use a unique JotLink ID. Your personal phone number remains hidden.
Native Fluency Translation Stop copy-pasting into translators.
• Invisible Semantic Sync: Type in your language, and your client receives flawless text in theirs.
• Instant Authority: Sound like a local and close deals like a pro.
Real Task Tracking Don't let tasks get lost in the chat noise.
• Dedicated Tab: Turn any message into a Task with one tap.
• Track Progress: Separate "Talking" from "Doing." See exactly what is pending and what is done.
The Radar: Full Location History Live location is temporary; JotLink gives you proof.
• History View: Scroll back in time to see the exact route your driver or team took. Total visibility, zero blind spots.
Seamless Calls & Global Reach
• Call Any Number: Make ultra-cheap international calls to any mobile or landline, even if they don't have the app.
• One-Click Handover: Move a live call from your mobile to your desktop instantly without dropping the connection.
Download JotLink today. Free is common. Reliability isn’t.

bluejetty:00091966:ios.description:

SEAMLESSLY TRANSMIT READINGS
• Take and send your weight, blood pressure and blood sugar readings to your care team.
• Log your meals easily and get nutritional tips based on what you've logged for the day.
SET PREFERENCES
• Choose when to receive program reminders, whether it’s to submit a reading, review your monthly report, or other relevant program tasks, that best fits your unique schedule.
READING GUIDANCE
• Get in-app guidance on blood pressure and/or blood sugar readings.
DIGITAL COACHING 
• Gain knowledge on your program and health journey through interactive learning missions. 
• Understand your progress through trends and monthly reports in-app. 
EARLY ACCESS
• Gain access to the latest Digital Medicine app features and enhancements.
SUPPORT
• Enjoy guided in-app device setup instructions and watch videos on setting up your device and how to take readings.
Track progress, stay motivated, and feel better with Digital Medicine.
Digital Medicine app is not any substitute for professional healthcare services or advice. Any health related information provided is for informational purposes and should not be used for diagnostic or medical purposes. Always consult a healthcare professional for your health and safety needs.

bluejetty:00169687:ios.description:
Audio Converter & Extract MP3 – Professional Audio Conversion and Extraction
Audio Converter & Extract MP3 is a comprehensive tool designed to help you easily and quickly convert and extract audio from video and audio files. With its simple yet powerful interface, this app allows you to convert popular audio formats and extract high-quality MP3 audio from any video.
----------------------- Key Features -----------------------
AUDIO CONVERTER
• Support for multiple audio formats: Convert between the most popular audio formats today, such as MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OGG, and many others.
• Convert audio files: Easily convert between different audio formats without losing quality.
• Customize audio settings: Before converting, you can customize parameters such as bitrate, sample rate, and channel count (stereo/mono) to suit your specific needs.
AUDIO EDITOR
• Cut, merge, and edit audio: Cut, copy, paste, and edit your music tracks easily by dragging the trim handle.
• Combine several music clips, even in different formats.
• Add background sounds to your music, mix music flexibly with the multitrack feature.
RINGTONE MAKER
• Choose the video from the album and automatically extract the audio from the video.
• Accurate to 0.1s ringtone clipping.
• Support the fade-in fade-out setting within 1-5s.
• Support the video and audio converted to mp3 and m4r formats.
• Support the splicing of many ringtone audio files.
• Set the audio as charging tone.
AUDIO EXTRACTION
• Support for multiple video formats: You can extract audio from videos in various popular formats such as MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, FLV, and many other video formats without the need for complex software.
• Choose high audio quality: After extraction, you can save the audio in high-quality formats like MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, and many others.
• Extract audio with just one tap: The audio extraction process is extremely simple. Just upload the video, select the desired audio format, and the app will automatically do the rest.
• Edit and cut audio after extraction: After extracting the audio, you can use the available editing tools to trim or modify the audio segment as you wish.
• No internet connection required: Once the video is downloaded to your device, you can extract audio even without an internet connection, helping you save data and work anytime, anywhere.
• User-friendly interface: The simple and intuitive interface makes it easy to edit audio right from the first use.

bluejetty:00179011:ios.description:
Siralim Ultimate is a monster-catching, dungeon-crawling RPG with a ridiculous amount of depth. Summon over 1200 different creatures and travel through randomly generated dungeons to acquire resources, new creatures, and loot.
If you’re looking to compare Siralim Ultimate to other games, you might think of it as Pokemon meets Diablo, or more accurately, Dragon Warrior Monsters meets Path of Exile.
FEATURES
• 1200+ creatures to collect
• Fuse your creatures together - the offspring inherits its parents’ stats, traits, and even the way they look!
• Randomly generated dungeons spanning 30 unique tilesets
• Customize your castle with thousands of different decorations
• Engage in strategic 6v6 battles
• Craft Artifacts and Spell Gems for your creatures
• Choose from one of 40 specializations for your character and earn perks that change the way your creatures fight in battle
• Insane amount of post-story content that will keep you engaged for thousands of hours (yes, really!)
• Supports gamepads!
• Cross-platform cloud saving allows you to pick up where you left off with the desktop version of the game or simply another mobile device.
• No ads, no IAPs, no timers, no gimmicks! You don't even need to be connected to the internet to play.

bluejetty:00099183:ios.description:
"RULE THE STREETS. REBUILD YOUR FAMILY.
In Mafia Life, take back what's yours in a story-driven gangster RPG. Your family is broken, your crew scattered, your turf overrun. The streets remember power — and it's your turn to take it.
Build your crime empire one block at a time. Run your crew. Crush rival gangs. Decide who lives, who falls, and who walks free. Every choice changes the city.
WHAT'S NEW IN THE UNDERWORLD
• Card Collection — collect and upgrade crew Cards, from street soldiers to legendary capos
• Green, Blue & Character Packs packed with new allies
• Gold Mafia Pass — premium rewards at every level, exclusive card packs, and bonus Cash, Gems & Tickets
KEY FEATURES
• Story-driven mafia RPG with choices that shape your fate
• Build and defend your turf in strategic gang wars
• Recruit loyal crew members — and root out the traitors
• Upgrade your boss, your weapons, and your influence
• Expand across new neighborhoods, regions, and rival cartels
• Rich character backstories and immersive dialog
EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO RULE
• Capture and defend neighborhoods
• Manage loyalty, power, and resources
• Outsmart rival families and gang leaders
• Make calls that echo across the underworld
Whether you're climbing from soldier to godfather or running a single neighborhood, Mafia Life delivers a complete mafia experience — strategy, story, and street power in one game.
Download now. The city is waiting for its new boss.
------------------------
Details on Subscriptions
1. Subscription Pricing & Billing
You can subscribe within the game for 'Gold Mafia Pass' for $9.99 a calendar month.
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers can enjoy the following privileges during the subscription period:
- Extra premium rewards unlocked at every level
- Exclusive card packs (Green, Blue & Character Packs)
- Bonus resources: Cash, Gems, and Tickets
3. Auto Renewals
The App Store subscription renews automatically via your Apple Account. The subscription will auto-renew for the same billing period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current subscription expires. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings at any time.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy - https://www.udogames.com/legal/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use - https://www.udogames.com/legal/terms-and-conditions/#h1-subscriptions
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, open 'Settings' on your iOS device, tap your name at the top, then tap 'Subscriptions'. Select the subscription for 'Mafia Life' and tap 'Cancel Subscription'. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing period."

bluejetty:00155730:ios.description:
Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. Console, handheld, arcade, computer, and mobile classics live in one library. The app does not include games, BIOS, or game data. Use only legally owned backups, homebrew, or public-domain software.
Supported Platforms

- Nintendo 3DS (3DS)
- Nintendo GameCube (NGC)
- Nintendo Wii (Wii)
- Nintendo 64 (N64)
- Nintendo DS (NDS)
- Game Boy Advance (GBA)
- Game Boy Color (GBC)
- Game Boy (GB)
- Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
- Famicom Disk System (FDS)
- Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES)
- Virtual Boy (VB)
- Pokemon Mini (PM)
Sony
- PlayStation (PS1)
- PlayStation Portable (PSP)
Sega
- Dreamcast (DC)
- Sega Saturn (SS)
- Sega Master System (MS)
- Game Gear (GG)
- SG-1000 (SG)
- Sega Genesis 32X (32X)
- Sega CD / Mega-CD (MCD)
- Sega Genesis / Mega Drive (MD)
NEC
- PC Engine (PCE)
- TurboGrafx-16 (TG-16)
- TurboGrafx-CD (TG-CD)
- SuperGrafx (SGX)
SNK
- Neo Geo Pocket (NGP)
- Neo Geo Pocket Color (NGPC)
Atari
- Atari 2600
- Atari 5200
- Atari 7800
- Atari Jaguar
- Atari Lynx
Commodore
- Commodore 64 (C64)
- Amiga
Other
- Arcade
- DOOM
- MS-DOS
- Java ME (J2ME)
- Symbian
- WonderSwan
- Flash
More systems are planned.
[RetroAchievements]
- Challenge players worldwide and light up trophies that are yours
- Multiset: grind multiple sets on one game — earn subset trophies without patching
- Hardcore Mode: tougher rules, trophies that actually count
[Save States, Your Way]
- Unlimited manual save states plus 50 auto slots
- Save Manager: browse by time, compare, and restore in one tap
[Speed, Cheats & Shortcuts]
- 5x fast forward — you set the pace
- Cheats on demand from an online library
- Custom shortcuts for save, speed, and screenshots
[Filters, Skins & Screenshots]
- Retro filters from our exclusive library
- Skins that feel like real hardware, third-party skins welcome, flex layouts that fit your hands
- Screenshots for the highlight reel
[Landscape Library]
- Landscape console mode — library, covers, and shortcuts on one screen
- Background music and navigation sounds — browsing feels like an arcade
- Browse with a controller or keyboard — stay on the couch
[Play Together]
- Local multiplayer whenever you want
- Eligible cores can host rooms, scan LAN, connect over relay, and spectate
[iCloud Sync — Your Game Universe]
