bluejetty:00082002:ios.summary: Falling Match - 3D Tidy Master is a fun and fast-paced puzzle game designed to challenge your brain while keeping you entertained. At the start of each level, a flurry of colorful 3D objects falls from above, creating a delightful mess. You
bluejetty:00082002:ios.description:
Falling Match - 3D Tidy Master is a fun and fast-paced puzzle game designed to challenge your brain while keeping you entertained. At the start of each level, a flurry of colorful 3D objects falls from above, creating a delightful mess. Your task is to find and match three identical items from the chaotic pile and move them to the platform below. But here’s the catch: you’re racing against time, and the platform space is limited! If you can’t clear the items before the timer runs out or if the platform fills up, it’s game over.
The gameplay is simple but addictive: select three matching objects and eliminate them from the board. However, as the levels progress, the challenges become tougher. You’ll need sharp observation skills, quick decision-making, and a little bit of strategy to keep up with the increasing difficulty. And don’t worry, if you’re stuck, a variety of helpful power-ups are at your disposal to guide you through the trickiest of puzzles.
Features:
Endless Levels: With a wealth of levels to explore, the fun never stops. Each level introduces new objects and challenges.
Time-Based Gameplay: The ticking clock adds an exciting layer of intensity to the game. Will you beat the timer or crumble under pressure?
Limited Platform Space: Carefully manage your platform space to avoid overcrowding and keep the game moving.
Power-Ups: Stuck on a particularly challenging level? Use power-ups to clear the board or extend your time.
Brain-Training Fun: Falling Match isn’t just about speed—it’s also a great way to sharpen your observation and decision-making skills.
Perfect for quick sessions during breaks or for extended play sessions, Falling Match - 3D Tidy Master is the ultimate brain teaser that you can play anywhere, anytime. With its intuitive mechanics, colorful visuals, and countless levels, this game will keep you coming back for more as you hone your skills and progress through increasingly challenging puzzles. Whether you’re looking for a way to unwind or to give your brain a workout, this is the game for you!

INTERACTIVE VISUALI
bluejetty:00062263:ios.description:
Globe Geography 3D: World Map is a colorful 3D world atlas for children and teens. Take a fascinating journey to every corner of planet Earth! Explore world geography and world history with our interactive encyclopedia.
INTERACTIVE VISUALIZATIONS ON THE GLOBE
3D models of world famous landmarks and wild animals. Learn geography through stunning visuals and discover dino world within our prehistoric section!
REFERENCE INFORMATION
The most fascinating facts about countries, cities, peoples of the world, geographical objects and landmarks. Delve into world provinces and expand your knowledge. Explore jurassic world facts and world history simultaneously.
ANIMALS FROM ALL PARTS OF THE WORLD
Fun facts about animals, their habitats and behavior. Discover the diversity of planet Earth.
PREHISTORIC LIFE
Detailed 3D models of prehistoric creatures like saber-toothed tigers and mammoths. Learn geography and paleontology simultaneously! Explore Jurassic world evolution and Jurassic world facts through detailed reconstructions.
HUMAN EVOLUTION
Journey back in time to meet our ancient relatives! Discover the appearance and daily lives of four distinct human species and expand your understanding of human history. Learn geography and the story of human evolution. Our encyclopedia covers it all!
AI-POWERED VOICEOVER
Artificial intelligence will tell you some fun facts and read aloud tasks for the youngest users and those who want to combine learning with other things!
MAPS IN MODERN DESIGN
Colorful relief model of the Earth. Explore world provinces on a beautifully rendered planet Earth.
This world atlas is your gateway to learn geography, understand human evolution, and discover dino world! From Jurassic world facts to the Empire State Building, let's explore the world together!
ATTENTION: some features may only be accessible with a subscription. With the FREE version you get access to a selection of world cultures, animals, and attractions, offering a glimpse into world geography and world history, including 1-2 interesting facts per topic.
A SUBSCRIPTION provides you with access to the complete library of content – delve deeper into human evolution, explore the dino world, and unlock voiced texts and translations into your desired language for a complete encyclopedia experience of planet Earth and its world provinces.
Privacy Policy: http://educationterra.com

bluejetty:00115908:ios.summary:
Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a colorful and addictive puzzle game where ASMR relaxing meets creativity. In this game, you’ll immerse yourself in sorting vibrant threads, all while testing your logic and organizational skills.
GAMEPLAY OVE
bluejetty:00115908:ios.description:
Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle is a colorful and addictive puzzle game where ASMR relaxing meets creativity. In this game, you’ll immerse yourself in sorting vibrant threads, all while testing your logic and organizational skills.
GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW:
You’ll need to collect colorful threads from various knitted objects and place them into matching colored boxes. Think carefully before placing your threads into temporary slots, and use your strategic mind to avoid filling up the available space. As you progress, you’ll unlock new levels, each more complex than the last.
KEY FEATURES:
- Challenging & Rewarding Puzzles: Test your logical thinking as you sort threads and complete intricate puzzles.
- Boosters to Help You Progress: Get support from helpful tools like New Hole, Magic Box and Broom when you face tough levels.
- Customization Options: Tailor the game to your liking by adding extra boxes and slots for a personalized experience.
- Beautiful Graphics: Relaxing and calming visuals of colorful threads and knitted objects that add to the fun.
WHY YOU'LL ENJOY IT:
- Perfect blend of relaxation and mental challenge to keep you engaged.
- Easy-to-learn gameplay that becomes progressively more challenging.
- Ideal for quick play sessions or long, relaxing gameplay.
- Great for puzzle lovers who enjoy sorting games and testing their brain.
Ready to Unravel the Fun?
Download Yarn Fever! Unravel Puzzle and dive into this soothing yet challenging world of colorful threads and exciting puzzles. Start organizing, sorting, and unlocking the joy of unraveling these fun puzzles while listening to some good music! 
Contact our Customer Support by sending an email to support.yarn@bravehk.com

bluejetty:00066448:ios.description:
Welcome to Dice Dreams!
ATTACK, STEAL AND GET REVENGE!
Attack your friends, steal their coins, and expand your kingdom! Now you have the thrilling opportunity to take on your friends in friendly competition. 
Just aim your slingshot, loot and fire at their kingdoms, raiding them for their precious coins!
Your kingdom got attacked? Get revenge on those who attacked your Kingdom and loot their empire back!
GET SOCIAL!
Play for FREE with your friends and family! Invite your Facebook friends to join the epic fun and embark on a thrilling dice-filled journey together. 
Gather your loved ones, challenge each other in tournaments, and compete for the title of the best kingdom. 
COLLECT MAGICAL STICKERS TO WIN BIG!
Every roll can bring you an interesting card that has lots of surprises! In Dice Dreams, the excitement doesn't end with just rolling the dice. 
Collect exciting stickers with every roll, revealing surprises and rewards. 
Watch your rewards increase in value, making your journey even more enjoyable.
FEED YOUR PET TO LEVEL UP
Always dreamed about an adorable pet that you can feed? Uncover a delightful selection of cute pets that will capture your heart and become your loyal companions. 
Feed them cookies for amazing rewards!
NEW CHALLENGES EVERYDAY Play Tournaments, earn Free rolls and compete in Peon's battle! 
With new events running every hour, there are new ways to play every day!
Get ready for an epic time on Dice Dreams: the multiplayer social dice game that allows you to build boards, attack your friends and brag about your victories! 
Begin your board game adventure and team up with friends on this thrilling dice quest. With every roll, earn free coins to build and expand your kingdom. 
Each dice roll unveils a new adventure, filled with fun and excitement! Explore diverse kingdoms with amazing themes, from bustling cities to enchanting royal lands.
Enjoy the classic gameplay of dice rolling fun! Take on challenging quests, collect fantastic stickers, earn dice, care for your pet, and construct your kingdom!
Team up with your friends, sending them gifts, or take a daring move by stealing from friends and other players to enhance your collection!
Join Dice Dreams community to trade stickers and boost your gaming experience. 
Dice Dreams is free on all devices with in-app purchases.
Follow Dice Dreams on Facebook for exclusive offers and bonuses!
https://www.facebook.com/DiceDreams/
Are you having problems?
Please contact via email us at dicedreams-help@superplay.co
Dice Dreams™ is intended for those 18 and older. Dice Dreams™ does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. Dice Dreams™ may also contain advertising.
You may require an internet connection to play Dice Dreams™ and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality,
compatibility and interoperability of Dice Dreams™ in the above description and additional app store information.

bluejetty:00027503:ios.description:
AA Speakers gives you access to a growing library of Alcoholics Anonymous speaker talks, workshops, and audio recordings wherever you are — now complete with a built-in 12-Step Recovery Toolkit.
Listen to 1000+ AA speaker talks from conventions and events around the world, with details about the speaker and recording where available.
The app includes:
• 600+ Alcoholics Anonymous speaker talks
• Joe and Charlie Big Book Study recordings
• Big Book audio recordings
• Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions audio recordings
• Speaker sections and topic-based browsing
• Search to quickly find talks
• Share speakers and workshop tapes directly with fellows via link
• Favourites and listening history
• Continue Listening so you can pick up where you left off
• Bookmarks for saving key moments
• Downloads for offline listening
• Background playback and lock screen controls
• Playback speed controls and sleep timer
12-Step Recovery Toolkit:
Work your program directly inside the app with a secure, personal step companion:
• 4th & 10th Step Inventories: Structured guides for Resentments, Fears, and Harms
• 8th & 9th Step Amends Tracker: Track and manage your amends progress
• Daily Gratitude List: Maintain perspective with daily check-ins
• PDF Export: Easily export your inventory to PDF for step reviews with your sponsor
• Biometric Privacy Lock: Protect your private step work with Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode protection
Whether you are travelling, unable to get to a meeting, working the steps with a sponsor, or simply want to keep recovery audio close at hand, AA Speakers makes it easy to stay connected to your program.
Please note:
This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc. The content in the app is provided for listening and recovery support; the app provides the software experience for browsing and playing that audio content.

bluejetty:00089647:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Marianos app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Marianos grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Rewards Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Marianos Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Marianos store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.marianos.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.marianos.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Marianos app, you need a Marianos digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Marianos Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Marianos' Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.marianos.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

bluejetty:00140277:ios.description:
Instant Cash Advance Up to $150*, Budget and Earn Money 
True Finance is your all-in-one app to budget smarter, earn more, and access instant cash advances up to $150. Track spending, earn extra income, boost your credit score, and get interest-free cash advances*. Over $50M in advances given and users have earned over $1,200/month in rewards.  
SMART BUDGETING TOOL
Get a clear, accurate view of your spending with one of the most reliable budgeting tools available. Accurate Categorization: Transactions automatically assigned to 16 categories for a full picture of where your money goes. Simple Dashboard: All spending organized in one place and updated instantly. Flexible Tracking: View by category, time period, or custom tags (custom categories and alerts coming soon).  
CASH ADVANCES
Access up to $150 in interest-free cash advances with no credit checks. Funds can arrive in minutes for an optional instant fee*, or within three business days via standard processing. Approval is based on eligibility and requires a connected, qualifying bank account. Over $50M in cash advances have been provided.  
CREDIT SCORE MONITORING
View and track your credit score, powered by VantageScore 3.0 and Equifax data through our partner Array. Receive alerts for changes such as new loan applications or credit pulls to help prevent identity theft early. 
INSTANT PROCESSING
Instant processing is available for a small fee ranging from $1.99–$5.99. Eligible users receive their cash advance within the hour instead of standard 1–2 business day ACH transfers. Availability depends on bank participation in FedNow; some smaller banks and credit unions may not qualify.  
EARN TAB
Turn spare time into real cash. Play games, complete tasks, and take surveys to earn rewards. Top users have earned up to $1,200 per month.
MARKETPLACE OFFERS
Explore personal loans, credit cards, and insurance from trusted partners — all in one app.  
ABOUT TRUE FINANCE
Launched in 2023, True Finance helps members bridge the gap between paydays with tools to budget, earn, and access short-term cash when needed. The app provides credit score tracking, identity protection alerts, and a financial marketplace for exploring additional money solutions.  
MEMBERSHIP DETAILS AND DISCLAIMERS 
Membership is required to request cash advances and use the Budget tab. Approval is not guaranteed. Premium members may earn up to 10% more in the Earn tab. Membership costs $6.99/month and renews automatically until canceled in-app. Uninstalling does not cancel membership. Instant transfer fees ($1.99–$5.99) are not included. Cash advance amounts range from $10–$150, with an average of $45 as of Dec 2025.

bluejetty:00137900:ios.description:
On-Device AI puts chat, listening, transcription, notes, and research in one private app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. Your data stays on your device.
Download a model once and keep working on a plane, on the subway, or without a signal. Chats, documents, recordings, and notes stay on your device. Online providers and web features are optional and work only after you enable them.
ONE APP, YOUR WAY
Open every workspace from a customizable Menu. Keep favorites under Pinned and everything else close by under Available.
AI CHAT
Chat with local or cloud models.
• Run local models from families such as Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral, or connect a cloud provider account or your own model server
• Browse, download, and manage models that fit your device, including ones for text, vision, reasoning, and tools
• Import GGUF models from Hugging Face; the app checks the chat template and sets it up before downloading
• Queue follow-up questions while a reply runs, and switch chats without losing it
• Drop in documents, images, and scanned PDFs; approve private on-device OCR only when a PDF needs it
• Fork any conversation and compare several models on the same prompt
• Let the model use tools for calculations, web requests, documents, Calendar, and Reminders, and review proposed changes before they apply
• Create reusable Agent Profiles, then add AI Skills, MCP servers, and tools from one clearer Agent Workflows setup
• Keep facts you repeat often in Global Memory
LISTEN LIBRARY AND RSS FEEDS
Read less, listen more.
• Turn PDFs, Markdown, plain text, web articles, and scanned books into a listening queue
• Scan photographed pages, correct the OCR the app runs on device, and keep each page with its spoken text
• Follow sites through RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds, then send articles to Up Next
• Choose Apple voices or local neural voices, follow along in the reader, and set a sleep timer
VOICE NOTE, VOICE TYPING, AND TEXT TO SPEECH
Speak instead of typing, and listen instead of reading.
• Record and transcribe meetings, lectures, interviews, and quick ideas
• Dictate with Voice Typing on Mac or the voice keyboard on iPhone and iPad
• Transcribe with Apple Speech, Whisper, Parakeet, Nemotron, Qwen3-ASR, MOSS, and other engines
• Turn text, or text captured from a photo, into audio with Apple voices, Kokoro, Supertonic, VoxCPM2, IndexTTS2, and other engines
• Export transcripts as text, subtitles, or Markdown
AI SEARCH AND AI BROWSER
Research with a second pair of hands.
• Search the web in a conversation and let the model read the results for you
• Browse with tabs, profiles, history, and downloads, then ask your model to read, assist, or act on the page
• Hand a task to the browser agent, watch each step, and take over whenever you want
KNOWLEDGE AND TEXT NOTE
Give your AI your own material to work from.
• Add PDFs, text, Markdown, code, images, and website content to a private searchable library
• Write and edit Markdown notes in the app
• Import AI chats, voice notes, Text to Speech items, and AI Search results
• Tune retrieval and index edited content again
APP HELP
Ask how a feature or setting works. App Help answers from a guide that ships inside the app, keeps help out of your saved chats, and points to the right settings.
MADE FOR APPLE DEVICES
• Native layouts adapt from focused navigation on iPhone to category sidebars on larger screens
• Widgets for Listen, Voice Note, Text Note, and Quick Actions
• Siri, Apple Shortcuts, App Intents, the Mac menu bar, and keyboard shortcuts you can customize
• Apple hardware acceleration for supported local models
• Store models internally, on an external drive, or on a shared volume, with separate tools for cleanup and recovery
• Interface in English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, and Traditional Chinese
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023455:ios.summary: Genesys Cloud’s free Workforce Management mobile app. Life is hectic. We know that for you, having a tool that allows you to better organize and plan out your day is a necessity, and the ability to do so on the go, essential. Genesys Tempo
bluejetty:00023455:ios.description:
Genesys Cloud’s free Workforce Management mobile app. Life is hectic. We know that for you, having a tool that allows you to better organize and plan out your day is a necessity, and the ability to do so on the go, essential. Genesys Tempo empowers you to achieve a healthy work-life balance from anywhere at any time. Through this app, you can:
* View your schedule.
* Receive notifications when a schedule is added, changed or removed.
* Keep track of their working hours quickly and efficiently.
* Notify your supervisor that you are running late to your next scheduled activity.
* Create in time-off requests and receive notifications when request statuses change, or changes occur.
* See what days are available for leave, which slots are filling up quickly and where you are at in line for waitlisted time-off requests.
* Request a shift trade with a specific coworker or post a shift to the trade board.
* Browse the shifts available to trade and drop a current shift or add a new shift. You can also view the status of these events.
* Receive notifications when a schedule is added, or removed, when a time off request is approved or denied, when a shift has been offered, and when a shift trade has been accepted or denied.

bluejetty:00180233:ios.summary: Get off the couch and get running with the OFFICIAL Couch to 5K® training app! This oft-imitated program has helped thousands of new runners move from the couch to the finish line. Spend just 20 to 30 minutes, three times a week, for nine w
bluejetty:00180233:ios.description:
Get off the couch and get running with the OFFICIAL Couch to 5K® training app! This oft-imitated program has helped thousands of new runners move from the couch to the finish line. Spend just 20 to 30 minutes, three times a week, for nine weeks, and you’ll be ready to finish your first 5K (3.1-mile) race!
Get more information about the Couch to 5K app here: http://www.active.com/mobile/couch-to-5k-app
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
The Couch to 5K coach you select talks to you during your workouts. To save your battery, Couch to 5K sends audio notifications when your screen is locked or another app is in use.
To be sure you hear the coach during your workout, please do the following:
• Turn on Notifications permissions
• Turn on the hardware ring/silent switch (no red showing)
• Turn your ringer volume up
• Turn off Do Not Disturb (swipe up for Control Panel and the moon button should not be white)
• Within the app, in Settings > Workout Options, be sure the Trainer Volume is up
Without granting notification permissions, during a workout you can click the lock icon at the top left to keep the app active and still hear the coach.
For support please contact us at: MobileSupport@activenetwork.com We would love to hear from you.
WINNER of the 2012 Appy Award for best Healthcare & Fitness App!
Features
• Training plan designed by Active.com trainers
• Choose from 4 different motivating virtual coaches—Johnny Dead, Constance, Billie or Sergeant Block
• Hear human audio cues to guide you through each workout
• Listen to your favorite playlists with in-app music player
• Calculate your distance & pace and map your routes with FREE GPS support*
• Log your workouts and share your progress on Facebook 
• Get support from the largest running community on Active.com Trainer
• Repeat workouts and track your best performance
• Treadmill support allows manual entry of workouts
• Track your progress with total distance and average pace
• Graphs for workouts to compare distance and pace
Finished the Couch to 5K program and ready to take your running program to the next level? Check out our 5K to 10K app to prep for your first 10K race here. https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/5k-to-10k/id526458735!
Praise
"The popular Couch to 5K app helps new runners avoid injury from doing too much, too soon."
—Runners World, June 2012
"It's ridiculously easy to use (it's hard not to, as you just do what you're told) and it's fantastic that you have an encouraging voice talking you through things."
—Engadget, June 2012
"Active.com’s Couch to 5K is one of my favorite… apps. With its customizable features, interactivity, and well-rounded interface, I may actually stay off the couch this time."
—148Apps, October 2011
"I knew as soon as I decided to start the Couch to 5K program that I would need something to keep me accountable—not just to showing up for my training, but to actually doing it properly. Of course there’s an app for that."
—CalorieLab, April 2012
"If you have been struggling to get your buns off the couch and somewhat in shape before the summer hits, training for a 5K is not a bad way to start. If you are looking for a program to help get you there, then the “Couch to 5K” running plan by CoolRunning is probably your best bet if you haven’t done an ounce of athletic activity for a number of years."
—Droid Life, April 2012
FAQ
• Once you purchase the app, it is yours to keep. It does not expire after 9 weeks.

bluejetty:00145323:ios.name: Rise of Chicks
bluejetty:00145323:ios.summary: Embark on an egg-citing adventure in "The Rise of Chicks"! Are you ready to lead our mutant hero, a little chicken with a big dream, on a journey of vengeance and rebellion against humans? Get ready for a thrilling ride in this immersive id
bluejetty:00145323:ios.description:
Embark on an egg-citing adventure in "The Rise of Chicks"! Are you ready to lead our mutant hero, a little chicken with a big dream, on a journey of vengeance and rebellion against humans? Get ready for a thrilling ride in this immersive idle strategy game!
In "The Rise of Chicks," our protagonist, a cute little chicken, undergoes a life-changing mutation after exposure to a leaked bio-weapon from a human lab. With its beloved hen captured and destined for someone's dinner table, our angry chicken is on a mission to defy the odds and take down the human oppressors.
This captivating idle strategy game offers a fresh twist on the popular "Rise of the Planet of Chicks" concept. You won't be controlling the chicken's every move, as it automatically battles enemies and devours corn, harnessing its essence to unlock incredible powers. Strategically allocate attributes and acquire various skills to challenge even fiercer foes as you progress.
Collect an array of skill cards to unleash devastating attacks and create powerful skill combinations that will help you soar past your previous records! The pursuit of breaking your own high score is a core aspect of the game, ensuring endless excitement and accomplishment.
In "The Rise of Chicks," every decision matters, as different talent allocations lead to diverse power performances. Utilize the precious "Corn" within each battle to temporarily enhance your attributes, while defeating enemies rewards you with "Gold Bricks" to permanently boost your stats.
Prepare to rise through the ranks and prove your dominance as you compete with players worldwide in thrilling PvP battles. Can you claim the top spot and emerge victorious?
With its user-friendly interface and intuitive gameplay, "The Rise of Chicks" is easy to pick up and enjoy for gamers of all levels. So, spread your wings and join the adventure now!
Download the game and experience the joy of guiding our hero chicken on its path to freedom and justice! Let the battle against human oppressors begin!

And because Text Repeater is so easy to use, it's an accessible tool for anyone, regardless of their technical expertise.
In short, if you need a fast and super customizable way to generate repeated text for any reason, Text Repeater is the perfect tool for the job. bluejetty:00122185:ios.description:
Experience a true classic of the MMORPG genre!
TibiaME was released in 2003 which makes it the first MMORPG for mobile devices according to the Guinness World Records.
Level up indefinitely!
Like in Tibia, the 2D MMORPG classic that inspired TibiaME, there's no limit to your character's level. Will you be the most powerful wizard ever?
Explore decades of adventures!
The 2D fantasy world of TibiaME with its "charming retro vibe" (Pocketgamer) has been constantly updated for almost 20 years.
Play solo, with friends or competitive!
Hunt on your own, complete challenging team quests with your friends or prove your skills against other players in PvP.
Follow an epic story!
Go on a journey with hundreds of hand crafted and unique quests. Slay hundreds of different monsters and fight powerful bosses.
Make it to the top of the leaderboards!
Like in Tibia, the classic 2D MMORPG TibiaME offers character highscores. Can you become the best warrior of your world?
Collect and trade thousands of items!
Fight your way through hordes of evil creatures and solve ancient riddles to find untold treasures and gain valuable loot.
Get the full MMO experience!
Encounters with others players, constant updates and regular events make TibiaME a living and exciting 2D MMORPG world that's never the same.
Become part of a strong community!
By now, more than 10 million users have joined the classic MMO and a loyal community of players from all over the world has emerged.
Play for free for as long as you want!
Roam freely on the islands Aurea and Lybera. Buy access to additional islands or purchase Premium Time to explore every corner of the 2D MMO world.
TibiaME is developed by CipSoft, one of Germany's oldest game developers and a true pioneer in the world of massively multiplayer online role-playing games (MMORPG). TibiaME is inspired by the classic MMO Tibia that's online since 1997 which makes it one of the world's first MMORPGs ever created.

bluejetty:00017258:ios.summary: The Fool’s Dog Tarot and Divination is a new all-in-one Divination Library. This free app comes with our unique Tarot Sampler Deck, a rainbow assortment of 78 cards from a number of Tarot decks. As experienced readers know, every Tarot de
bluejetty:00017258:ios.description:
The Fool’s Dog Tarot and Divination is a new all-in-one Divination Library. This free app comes with our unique Tarot Sampler Deck, a rainbow assortment of 78 cards from a number of Tarot decks. As experienced readers know, every Tarot deck speaks with its own voice. Reading with the sampler is like convening a council of wise advisors. Your very own Tarot think-tank! By simply clicking on each card, you can zoom in to see small details that can be almost invisible in paper cards, as well as read the interpretation of each card from its own book.
In addition to being super fun to read, the Sampler also gives you the chance to explore an ever-expanding library of decks, both historic and contemporary, designed, illustrated, and taught by some of the biggest names in Tarot. As you discover new decks, it’s easy to support our artists and authors by adding their decks and books to your library. The Fool’s Dog is made by Tarot readers for Tarot readers, and is committed to the sacred art of Tarot. We never publish AI slop, or ugly knockoffs. We publish real decks, with real art, by real artists, made for real readers. 
The Fool’s Dog Tarot and Divination all-in-one library seamlessly integrates our ever expanding catalog of digital Tarot, Lenormand, Kipper, and Oracle decks and books into an interactive reading experience. It offers an interconnecting suite of features that sets it apart from every other Tarot app on the market, including sophisticated pseudo-randomization algorithms, customizable reading formats, automated record-keeping, integrated journaling, social media and video-chat compatibility, and high-quality educational and interpretive materials designed by some of the best tarot artists and authors. 
The Fool’s Dog reading environment mimics the traditional Tarot experience. There are no bells, whistles, pop-ups, or annoying animations, just a beautiful calm sensory-friendly “Tarot salon” in which to read for yourself or others. The integrated journal, dozens of pre-programmed spreads, and optional voice prompts are great for learning. The free-form reading option, as well as optional reversals, majors only, customizable reading cloths, and sophisticated shuffling options offer unparalleled control for more advanced readers. Automatic record-keeping, sharable reading reports perfect for newsletters, blogs, and social media, and video-chat-friendly screen sharing make the app perfect for professional readers. Our fully-customizable, elegant design is powerful and sophisticated enough for professional Tarot readers, but simple and intuitive enough for beginning Tarot students.
* Intuitive interface that mimics the traditional Tarot experience
* Easy for beginners and experts. Simple, calm, autistic-friendly design
* Gorgeous full color, high-resolution cards
* Zoom way in to see details invisible on paper cards!
* Works great on all models of iPhone, iPad, and other iOS devices
* Free Sampler Tarot deck with more than 400 cards from 60+ decks
* Full card meanings and interpretations
* 20 built-in card layouts
* Free form spread option
* Integrated journal
* Sophisticated animated shuffling and cutting options
* Choose to allow reversals or not
* Option to read using Major Arcana only
* Customize with your own card meanings & reading cloths
* Easy, shareable images and text reports perfect for socials
* Video-chat friendly format perfect for online readings
Take your existing Tarot professional practice online, or learn to read like a pro with The Fool’s Dog Tarot and Divination free all-in-one library and reader app.

bluejetty:00158139:ios.description:
Fitaya® est une application mobile nouvelle génération qui vous encadre n’importe où & n’importe quand pour vos entrainements de sports quotidiens. Bénéficiez de votre plaisir au bout des doigts.
Fitaya vous apporte l’ensemble des valeurs ajoutées sportives que vous pouvez trouver, sans aucune contrainte. 
Bénéficiez ainsi d’un coach en ligne, de statistiques évolutives, de programmes personnalisés, de séances libres, d’un suivi planning, évolution photo, de programmes nutritionnels, d’une évolution IMC à moyen et long terme, en somme d’un réel accompagnement personnalisé en fonction de vos besoins.
COACHS EN LIGNE
Profitez des cours vidéos avec des coachs diplômés qui sauront vous faire progresser dans vos objectifs.
SÉANCES LIBRES
Accédez à toutes les vidéos de votre choix quand vous le souhaitez en un seul clic.
GUESTS 
Entraînez-vous avec vos guests préférés pour encore plus de motivation.
STATISTIQUES
Consultez à tout moment l’évolution de votre travail : temps d’entraînement, calories perdues, IMC.
PROGRAMMES PERSONNALISÉS
Nous vous créons un programme personnalisé en fonction de l’objectif choisi ainsi que de votre niveau sportif : perte de poids, prise de masse, souplesse et détente, summer body challenge et programme pour femme enceinte.
PROGRAMMES NUTRITIONNELS 
Pour compléter votre transformation physique et avoir des résultats encore plus optimums, adoptez une alimentation saine & variée. Découvrez sans plus attendre nos quatre programmes nutritionnels conçus pour être en lien direct avec nos quatre objectifs !
AGENDA
Définissez vos disponibilités de la semaine et adaptez ainsi vos séances à votre temps libre. Avec Fitaya, réalisez vos séances n’importe où et n’importe quand ! 
ÉVOLUTION PHOTO
Sauvegardez votre évolution physique afin d’en mesurer vos performances.
Sélectionnez votre objectif et laissez-vous guider par votre programme personnalisé & vos coachs qui vous accompagneront jusqu’à satisfaction ! Perdez du poids, reprenez le contrôle de votre corps, affinez votre silhouette ou encore travaillez à haute intensité, tous ces choix sont à votre disposition.

bluejetty:00021957:ios.description:
Awarded "Best Preschool App" by the Educational App Store (EAS)! Spark early learning with this #1 flashcard app for babies and toddlers. Filled with fun and engaging baby games and toddler games, your child will learn ABCs, 123s, first words, and more! Prepare them for preschool with these exciting educational games that build vocabulary and make learning a blast.
“My son loves it! He’s learned so many words.” – Emily, mom of 3
Our award-winning app brings early education to life with over 900+ colorful flashcards across 36 engaging categories. From animals to shapes, every card features vivid pictures and professional voiceovers, creating an interactive learning experience your child will love. These toddler learning games and baby learning games are designed to captivate young minds.
LEARNING TOPICS INCLUDE: 
► ABCs & 123s 
► Shapes & Colors 
► Baby First Words 
► Animals (Pet, Farm, Zoo Animals) 
► Foods, Fruits & Vegetables 
► Family & Body Parts 
► And more! A total of 36 popular categories.
WHY PARENTS LOVE IT: 
► EAS Certified for quality educational content and child-friendly design. 
► Build vocabulary & encourage early speaking skills with our speech games. 
► Over 900 vibrant flashcards designed for toddlers. 
► Hands-free AUTOPLAY mode for independent learning. 
► Track your child’s progress with detailed reports. 
► Play offline anytime, anywhere—no Wi-Fi needed. 
► 100% ad-free for a safe and distraction-free experience.
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT? 
Unlike outdated physical flashcards, Baby Flash Cards for Toddlers combines playful visuals with engaging voiceovers to captivate your child’s attention. Recommended by parents and educators, our app offers a comprehensive learning experience, trusted by thousands worldwide.
SUBSCRIPTIONS: 
Enjoy a 7-day free trial, then choose between affordable monthly or annual plans to unlock unlimited access. 
► Manage your subscription easily through your iTunes settings. 
► Your account will be charged after the trial unless canceled beforehand. 
► To stop auto-renewal, turn it off in your account settings. Your subscription remains active until the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: http://preschoolgamesforkids.com/tos/ 
Privacy Policy: http://preschoolgamesforkids.com/privacy-policy/ 
Support: Contact us at iosdev.sumon@gmail.com

bluejetty:00187484:ios.description:
Connect to MATLAB® from your iPhone or iPad.
Evaluate MATLAB commands, create and edit files, view results, acquire data from sensors, and visualize data – from the convenience of your mobile device.
CONNECT TO THE CLOUD 
Use your MathWorks Account to connect to MathWorks Cloud from MATLAB Mobile™. Linking a license that is current on MathWorks Software Maintenance Service to your MathWorks Account increases your storage quota and unlocks access to other add-on products on the license. 
With your MathWorks Account, you can: 
• Access MATLAB from the command-line 
• View, run, edit and create files from the Editor 
• Acquire data from device sensors 
• Store your files and data on MATLAB Drive (you receive 5 GB of cloud storage)
Link a license that is current on MathWorks Software Maintenance Service to your MathWorks Account to unlock the following features:
• Access to other add-on products on your license 
• 20 GB of cloud storage on MATLAB Drive
FEATURES
• Command-line access to MATLAB and add-on products
• MATLAB Copilot for AI-assisted coding with a valid license
• 2D and 3D plots to visualize data
• Editor to view, run, edit and create MATLAB files
• Data acquisition from device sensors
• Image and video acquisition from the camera 
• Cloud storage and synchronization with MATLAB Drive
• Custom keyboard to enter typical MATLAB syntax
LIMITATIONS
The following features are not supported:
• Using MATLAB Apps, such as Curve Fitting
• Creating apps with App Designer
• Interacting with 3D figures 
• Opening or creating models using the Simulink graphical environment
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
ABOUT MATLAB 
MATLAB is the leading technical computing software for algorithm development, data visualization, data analysis, and numeric computation. MATLAB is used in a wide range of applications, including signal and image processing, communications, control design, test and measurement, financial modeling and analysis, and computational biology.

bluejetty:00186976:ios.description:
MyU is an award-winning interactive learning management system (LMS) that organizes learning and communication in any school or classroom. The platform creates a safe and controlled environment for educators to manage classes, engage with learners, organize content, and create discussions inside and outside the classroom. 
Educators using MyU report a 55% higher student engagement, a 63% richer teaching experience, and a 61% higher productivity over legacy LMS platforms (According to a 2019 survey with 900 educator respondents)
Simple steps to registering on MyU:
Download the app from the store
Create an account (Instructor, Student, Management or Parent) 
If you couldn’t find your school during registration, you can manually add it from the app
Instructors and schools use MyU to:
Organize all classes in one place
Post learning material in different formats (PDF, Word, Excel, links and PPT)
Send announcements, reminders, and create discussions in different formats (photos, videos, voice notes)
Manage daily class attendance, and generate reports
Manage grading, and generate reports
Post graded and ungraded questions to receive private responses and provide feedback
Check post analytics and find out who viewed your post and who missed it
Chat with students privately in one-on-one conversations or in groups
Find other instructors teaching the same topic and share knowledge
Set privacy and visibility preferences for profile and posts
MyU offers a standard free tier providing 100MB of document space, 8 classes, 3-minute videos, 4-images on each post, and 90-day private messaging storage.
An upgrade to MyU Prime is available for instructors where they will be provided with an additional 100GB of document upload space, 12 extra classes, uploading up-to 8 images on each post, sharing up-to 30-minute long video and voice notes, and unlimited storage of all private messages.
Users can subscribed for a 1 week free trial, after which they will be auto-billed monthly. After any subscription has been stopped, users will have the option to renew their subscription on a monthly, or annual basis. Subscriptions are auto-renewed before expiry. Users can turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours prior to the end of the billing period.
Link to our MyU privacy policy: https://app.myu.co/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00062747:ios.description:
Tanach for all brings you the whole Jewish Tanach (bible) to your iPhone/iPod/iPad.
Tanach for all includes the Torah, Nevi'im (Prophets) and Ketuvim (Writings).
There is no need for an internet connection since all the Hebrew text comes with the application (English (JPS) and Onkelos translations can be downloaded from within the application without any charge).
You can easily navigate to any chapter or even Parasha (for Torah only) within seconds!
Do you prefer to read the bible with punctuation (nikud) or with cantillation (teamim)?
Whatever you prefer - this is up to you to decide with just a switch of a button.
And now you can even see both English and Hebrew or Onkelus and Hebrew in parallel or line by line, allowing you to learn better.
Would you like to see how many times your name appears in the bible?
Would you like to find where in the bible a place was mentioned?
With the built-in search engine you'll find anything on the bible within less than 2 seconds!
Whenever you'll close the application the last watched chapter will be saved for next time, but you can also select a verse to be the opening position for next time.
If you want to remember a verse or a chapter, you can easily set a bookmark to that place by just clicking on a verse.
In the same manner, you can easily add notes or see commentaries (Hebrew only) to any selected verse.
And it all comes packed in a very nice and intuitive design!
__
Icons used in this app came from Icons8.com
__ 
To ask a question or report a problem you can come to the support page, using the link below.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

EXCEPTIONAL NOTES
Vemo captures detailed, business-ready notes so you can engage in the conversation instead of scribbling.
ACTION ITEMS
No more post-meeting stagnation. Vemo extracts action items from every discussion and builds a to-do list to keep you moving forward.
MAGIC EDIT
Missed something? Just talk to Vemo. Add, remove, or tweak sections of your notes with ease—it’s almost unbelievable until you try it.
EFFORTLESS SHARING
Impress your team, boss, or clients by sharing polished notes in seconds. If note-taking is your job, Vemo will make you shine.
ASK ANYTHING
Vemo’s full AI power lets you voice any question about your meeting—like key decisions or details—anytime.
MIND MAP
See the big picture with a visual mind map, perfect for grasping structure and retaining info.
FLAWLESS TRANSCRIPTS
Crystal-clear transcription handles accents and poor audio effortlessly, with synced playback for review.
GLOBAL LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Vemo takes notes in any language—anywhere in the world.
PERFECT FOR
• Web & in-person meetings
• Impromptu chats
• Boardroom sessions
• Brainstorms
• People with ADHD
• Anyone who hates note-taking
Got questions? Email us at support@vemo.ai or visit vemo.ai for more info.
Download Vemo now and make manual note taking a thing of the past!

bluejetty:00169874:ios.description:
Use 350+ AI models in one place with Liner.
Choose a model to chat with, check the sources behind its answers with web search, and write what you need.
Liner is your AI search and research assistant for essays and reports, work research, travel plans, and everyday questions.
Skip switching between AI services and pick the right model for every question.
When you need to go further, continue with Deep Research.
[350+ AI Models in One Place]
Choose the right AI model for search, reasoning, writing, and more. Save the models you use most to Favorites and discover new ones.
- Pick the right AI model for each task
- Find models with tags and filters
- Get quick access to your favorite models
- See estimated credits for each model
[Ask in Chat, Verify With Sources]
Turn on search, and your selected model answers based on Liner's search results and shows the sources behind it. Ask follow-up questions and check the original sources whenever you need to.
- See the sources cited in each answer
- Open original sources through citation numbers
- Explore information from multiple perspectives
- Ask follow-up questions for more detail
[From Research to Drafting and Editing]
Write with the information you find, or polish what you've already written. Use AI for essays, reports, work documents, and more.
- Organize ideas and structure
- Create a draft that fits your purpose
- Refine sentences and wording
- Summarize the key points of long materials
[Compare Answers From Multiple AIs]
Send the same question to up to 4 models and see how each one approaches and explains it. Review the differences and check the sources for anything you need to verify.
- See answers from up to 4 models with one question
- Switch between each model's answer and sources in tabs
- Compare different perspectives and explanations
[Explore Further With Deep Research]
Enter a topic, and Liner finds and analyzes multiple sources, then organizes the findings into an answer with citation numbers. Explore key points and evidence together, even on complex topics.
- Research across multiple sources
- Organize key findings into tables and lists
- Check evidence with citation numbers
- Ask follow-up questions based on the results
[Find Experts That Match Your Criteria]
Search for experts by field and experience. Explore the backgrounds of professionals you'd like advice from or candidates you're looking to hire.
- Search for experts by field and experience
- Explore professionals and hiring candidates
- View experience, location, and key background
[Do More With Liner]
- Search and summarize academic papers
- Summarize PDFs and complex documents
- Summarize key points from YouTube videos
[Plan Details]
- Access to 350+ AI models is available for Pro and Max subscribers. Liner's default model is available without credits.
- Available models may change as they are released or retired.
From your first question to research and writing, start with the AI model you want on Liner.
[Terms of Service]
https://liner.com/terms

- Real-time tracking: Choose your favorite AIDA fleet and follow live what the guests are experiencing on board.

AIDA Cruises is the inventor of the modern cruise and market leader in Germany. AIDA stands for unforgettable holiday experiences, first-class service and responsible travel on the most beautiful seas in the world.

bluejetty:00073296:ios.description:
Printing has never been so effortless. With more than 10,000 supported wireless printers, Printer App lets you print documents and photos in a matter of seconds. Simply select a document or photo, edit it with a handy set of built-in tools, and send it for printing. 
Printer App key features include:
PRINTING FROM IOS DEVICES
- Print photos and documents
- Print web pages & contacts
- Print directly from your Dropbox or Google Drive
- Over 20 supported file formats, including: PDF, DOCX, PAGES, and TXT
SCAN DOCUMENTS
- Scan documents with the built-in scanner
- Share or print scanned documents
ADVANCED PRINTING OPTIONS
- Page orientation
- One and two-sided printing 
- Number of pages per sheet
- Printing in black and white or color
- Paper size (A3, A4, B5, etc.)
- Number of copies
- Printing range
EXTENDED DOCUMENT EDITING
- Highlight or draw on documents
- Add text to documents
- Use other customization options
ADJUST PHOTOS
- Apply filters, blur, or saturation
- Change size and proportion 
- Add contrast, mask, or sharpening
- Use many other built-in photo editing options
Printer App is compatible with all printer models that support AirPrint technology. Improve your printing experience with Printer App!
Supports 99% of printers with wireless (Wi-Fi) connectivity.
Note: make sure you’re connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your printer to use all the features of the app.

When a subscription is canceled, access to the features will expire at the end of the current payment period.
This app is independent and not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by any particular printer brand, including without limitation, HP, Epson, Canon, Brother.

bluejetty:00021778:ios.description:
Are you a heavy sleeper who just can’t manage to get out of bed on time?
Do you need a LOUD alarm clock that WAKES you up?
Are you late to meetings and calls?
We have created an alarm clock that will get you out of bed.
How? 
It requires you to scan a barcode.
It’s impossible to miss.
In fact, this alarm clock is so annoying, it will make you want it to stop immediately. You will HAVE to get up to turn it off.
*** Blaringly Loud Ringtones ***
Our alarm ringtones are procedurally generated and unpredictable to prevent auditory adaption. Every time one of them goes off, no matter how deep asleep you are, your brain is going to wake your body up instantly. 
*** Toothpaste Barcode Scan ***
To turn off this alarm clock, you will need to scan the barcode of your toothpaste or any other predetermined barcode.
That way, you will be forced to get out of bed to stop the alarm. Yes, you will have to look yourself in the mirror to make it stop.
*** Multiple and Repeating Alarms with LOCK Feature ***
We’ve made it impossible to cancel your alarm. There is no way to stop it from ringing once it’s set. How annoying is that? You can’t mute it either!
*** Alarm Features ***
- Interactive wake-up technology that works
- Barcode scan required to stop annoying sound
- Choose different objects with barcodes to stop alarm
- Impossible to mute
- Use it anywhere
- Crazy loud ringtones for heavy sleepers and night owls
- Procedural Ringtones¹ to never sleep through any alarm again
- Multiple, repeating alarms
- Lockable alarms to prevent yourself from cheating
- Randomizable ringtone playlists
- Mix in ringtones with your own music
*** Motivational Features ***
- Bedtime Reminder
- Bedtime Enforcer
- Morning Routine
*** Bonus Don’t Wake My Spouse Button ***
Do you want to allow your spouse to keep sleeping while your phone alert wakes YOU up? We’ve included a ‘don’t wake my spouse button,’ which comes with a super short time snooze. Trust us, your spouse will thank you later.
*** Totally Customizable ***
- Dark mode to help you power down at night
- Bright alarms
- Customizable color themes and alternative app icon colors
- Bedside Clock with changeable clock face
- Highly customizable with full-screen clock, analog clocks, digital clocks, hourglass clock, landscape and portrait, clock wallpaper, and more.
*** Say Goodbye to Bad Sleeping Habits ***
You deserve good sleep. But, you also deserve good habits. Our phone alarm clock will help you create a schedule that is productive and healthy for you. Whether you need our Bedtime Reminder or Bedtime Enforcer option, our app will ensure you are awake, alert, and enthusiastic whenever you need to be.
*** Track Your Morning Routine ***
Our heavy sleep alarm clock will help you create and track a morning routine that is right for you. Download our app today!
---

bluejetty:00124318:ios.summary:
Het laatste nieuws, achtergrondverhalen, de krant zoals hij gedrukt is en de Digitale Editie nu in één app van de Volkskrant op uw iPhone. 
Alles wat in deze app staat wordt gemaakt, gecheckt en gepresenteerd door een omvangrijke redactie.
bluejetty:00124318:ios.description:
Het laatste nieuws, achtergrondverhalen, de krant zoals hij gedrukt is en de Digitale Editie nu in één app van de Volkskrant op uw iPhone. 
Alles wat in deze app staat wordt gemaakt, gecheckt en gepresenteerd door een omvangrijke redactie. Onder wie prominente columnisten, onderzoeksjournalisten, topinterviewers en 18 correspondenten over de hele wereld. Zo heeft u de beste journalistiek van de Volkskrant altijd bij de hand. 
De functionaliteiten van deze Volkskrant nieuws app uw iPhone:
Scroll eenvoudig door het urgente en laatste nieuws en ontvang pushnotificaties van de belangrijkste nieuws updates. 
Klassieke krant weergave: lees de digitale versie van de papieren krant op uw iPhone.
Digitale Editie in portrait mode: lees alle verhalen uit de krant van vandaag, advertentievrij, verrijkt met fotografie, graphics en podcasts. 
Vind uw vertrouwde rubrieken: Nieuws & Achtergrond, Columns & Opinie, De Gids, Cultuur & Media, Wetenschap, Sport, Economie.
Gebruikt u deze app op iPad? De functies van de Digitale Editie:
Landscape mode: swipe door de digitale krant van de dag, speciaal vormgegeven voor uw iPad.
Bekijk fotoreeksen, graphics en luister naar podcasts.
Toegang tot Edities van 5 dagen eerder. 
Offline te lezen, dus zonder internetverbinding. 
Klassieke weergave: blader door de digitale versie van de papieren krant op uw iPad. 
Ontvang een notificatie als een nieuwe editie beschikbaar is. 
Veel gestelde vragen over de Volkskrant nieuws app
Moet ik betalen voor de Volkskrant artikelen?
U download de app helemaal gratis. Op iPhone kunt u, zonder abonnement, gratis zeven artikelen per week lezen. Op uw iPad kunt u wel door de Editie bladeren maar geen artikelen lezen. Ben u al abonnee? Dan heeft u elke dag onbeperkt toegang tot het laatste nieuws, de Digitale Editie en de digitale versie van de papieren krant. Ook heeft u met een abonnement (m.u.v. Digitaal Basis) toegang tot Topics. 
Ik ben abonnee, hoe krijg ik toegang tot alle artikelen in de Volkskrant nieuws app?
Door in te loggen via de app krijgt u onbeperkt toegang tot het laatste nieuws. Op uw iPhone, tik op ‘Service’ in de navigatiebalk. Op iPad, tik op ‘Menu’ linksboven in het scherm. Tik vervolgens op ‘Inloggen’ in het menu dat verschijnt. Vul hier uw e-mailadres en wachtwoord in van uw DPG Media account. Heeft u geen DPG Media account? Volg de stappen in het scherm om een gratis account aan te maken. U wordt automatisch ingelogd.
Ik ben geen abonnee, hoe krijg ik toegang tot alle artikelen in de Volkskrant nieuws app?
U kunt in de app kiezen voor onbeperkte toegang tot het laatste nieuws. U heeft keuze uit diverse (digitale) abonnementen. Dit kan vanaf enkele euro’s per week. Bij het bevestigen van de aankoop wordt het bedrag in rekening gebracht bij uw Apple ID, tenzij eerst een gratis periode van toepassing is. Het abonnement wordt automatisch verlengd tenzij u het abonnement tot 24 uur voor de verlengingsdatum opzegt. Na aankoop kunt u uw abonnement beheren/wijzigen bij uw account-instellingen in de App Store. 
Hoe beheer en/of wijzig ik mijn Volkskrant abonnement?
Heeft u een abonnement aangeschaft via de App Store? U kunt uw abonnement beheren en/of wijzigen bij uw account-instellingen in de App Store. Kijk op de Support-pagina van Apple voor hulp bij uw abonnement. Heeft u geen abonnement aangeschaft via de App Store? Neem dan contact op met de Klantenservice via het telefoonnummer 088-0561 561 .
Andere vragen aan de Volkskrant?
Ga naar Volkskrant.nl voor meer informatie. U kunt ook contact opnemen met de Klantenservice. Wij zijn bereikbaar van maandag tot en met vrijdag tussen 08.30-17:00 uur via het telefoonnummer 088-0561 561 . Wij helpen u graag verder.
Privacy

Onze gebruiksvoorwaarden vindt u op https://www.dpgmedia.nl/gebruiksvoorwaarden 
Ons privacy statement vindt u op https://www.dpgmedia.nl/privacy

Chefaa app uses GPS to connect patients and pharmacies t
bluejetty:00144319:ios.description:
Chefaa App makes it easy for you to get all your needs from the pharmacy, You can order your medications and non-pharmaceuticals online and get your order delivered to your doorstep.
Chefaa app uses GPS to connect patients and pharmacies to help patients get all their pharmacy needs to their homes.
* With Chefaa App you can:
1. order medications online
After visiting the doctor and paying your Vezeeta fee, you usually go to the pharmacy to get your medications.But instead of searching multiple pharmacies and waiting in long queues, you can conveniently order them through the Chefaa online pharmacy app in Egypt and KSA.
Chefaa medicine ordering app provides two ways to order medicine:
- Scan or upload your prescription, medication bottle, or box picture, then submit your request.
- You can search for your medication (dawaya) in chefaa store, then add it to the shopping cart and confirm the order.
Within minutes, you’ll receive a notification with your order status and the estimated delivery time based on availability in nearby pharmacies.
2. Order care products and medical supplies online

bluejetty:00044893:ios.description:
Getting treatment for opioid addiction can feel shameful or scary. Groups is here to change that because we know the only thing harder than beating opioids is doing it alone. The Groups Recover Together mobile app takes the core components of the program -- such as treatment with medication (Suboxone), weekly group therapy, and support services -- and brings it to you in a virtual environment.
With the Groups Recover Together app, you can now enjoy the benefits of the program, on-the-go or from the comfort of your own home. That means interacting with counselors who will help you make a deep personal transformation, working with physicians who will help you safely manage your medication, attending weekly group therapy sessions where you will truly learn the importance of “recovering together” and of course, working with your peers who know what you’re going through and will cheer for your success. Whether you’re participating through the app or in person at one of Groups’ physical locations, all it takes is one hour per week for you to get your life back on track. That’s a small commitment that could have a huge impact on your life.
Download the app to get started, join Group meetings, or manage your care plan.

bluejetty:00142658:ios.description:
Use the Pastest Written app to study for your medical exams anytime, anywhere.
Pastest has many decades of experience and expertise in providing test prep materials that enable medical students and doctors to achieve exam success. The Pastest Written app is designed with your convenience in mind, so whether you’re commuting to work or have a spare 10 minutes between class, the app will help you to fit your prep around a busy schedule.
In order to use the app, an active Pastest subscription is required (written exams only).
Here’s a long list of why the Pastest Written app is so great:
QUESTIONS
Full range of accurate question types – in terms of style, content and functionality – for all UK medical exams we provide resources for
Comprehensive sessions filters, including specialty, question type, difficulty, familiarity, images and keyword search
Create a fully customised session of up to 100 questions, against the clock if required
Show clues to highlight the most pertinent parts of the vignette
Submit feedback on questions to be reviewed and responded to by our experts
Practice using timed tests, mock exams and past papers (where applicable)
Great ability to review questions in recently completed and earlier sessions
MEDIA

bluejetty:00015570:ios.summary: Train your musical ear, improve your rhythm, and understand music better. Perfect Ear is a fun, free ear training app with hundreds of focused exercises and guided courses for musicians at every level, from complete beginners to seasoned pr
bluejetty:00015570:ios.description:
Train your musical ear, improve your rhythm, and understand music better. Perfect Ear is a fun, free ear training app with hundreds of focused exercises and guided courses for musicians at every level, from complete beginners to seasoned professionals. Practice listening, singing, reading music, recognizing melodies, and identifying rhythmic figures to build stronger musicianship every day.
Instead of learning theory in isolation, Perfect Ear turns musicianship into daily practice.
Why Perfect Ear?
• Hear it — use fun, varied drills to recognize intervals, chords, scales, and melodies by ear.
• Read it — practice sight reading and learn to recognize notes, intervals, chords, and scales in sheet music.
• Feel it — improve your rhythm with focused rhythm exercises. Build better timing through regular practice.
• Sing it — connect what you hear with what you can sing using pitch and note singing drills.
• Learn step by step — follow guided courses from beginner to advanced. Build the fundamentals first, then move into deeper ear training, rhythm, notation, singing, and theory practice.
• Train your way — create custom drills for intervals, chords, scales, keys, ranges, directions, rhythm patterns, and more. Match your practice to your level, your goals, and your instrument.
Use the daily practice dashboard to stay consistent, review your training, and build real musical confidence over time.
Whether you are learning your first intervals or refining advanced musicianship, Perfect Ear gives you a structured way to train the skills that make music easier to hear, read, sing, play, and understand.
FULL FEATURE LIST
• Interval exercises: comparison and recognition
• Chord exercises: recognition, inversions, and progressions
• Scale exercises
• Rhythm exercises: reading, writing, and imitation
• Melodic dictation exercises
• Advanced custom exercise editor to create your own exercises and define your own chords, scales, and rhythmic figures
• Sight reading drills
• Absolute pitch and note singing drills
• Music theory and reference materials for intervals, scales, and chords
• Interactive scale reference
• Multiple instruments to practice with
• Fully featured Fretboard Trainer with custom fretboards and tunings
Perfect Ear is built for consistent practice: quick exercises, focused feedback, structured courses, and the flexibility to train exactly what you need.

On devices equipped with Apple's LiDAR technology, GhostTube SLS Camera uses a projected gr
bluejetty:00127210:ios.description:
GhostTube SLS Camera detects humanoid bodies and homogeneous shapes in your environment similar to the way in which a traditional SLS camera works.
On devices equipped with Apple's LiDAR technology, GhostTube SLS Camera uses a projected grid of infrared light to detect depth and for better visibility in the dark. Our complex algorithms use data gathered from the camera and depth sensors to detect people and people shaped objects with accuracy that surpasses that of the Kinect SLS cameras. For devices lacking LiDAR, GhostTube will instead rely on dual lens cameras to measure depth in a similar way to how the human eye detects depth - triangulation of objects based on data from multiple lenses. Some light may be required due to the size or lack of sensors depending on the device you're using. 
Don't pay hundreds or thousands of dollars for a modified gaming console - GhostTube SLS Camera is available FREE for download and can be used as an SLS Camera in all of your paranormal investigations.
For more paranormal investigation and ghost hunting tools, check out our other apps.
GhostTube offers auto renewable subscriptions. Refer to our website for a full list of terms and conditions and EULA: GhostTube.com/terms
Although GhostTube SLS Camera offers some low light filters, the app is not intended as an aid for seeing in the dark. Always use adequate lighting on your paranormal investigations. Certain shapes and patterns may trigger figures to be mapped by GhostTube SLS Camera.

bluejetty:00151744:ios.description:
Just talk and speak with the cool three-headed dragon and he will answer with his funny voice or react to your touch.
Discover the magical, enchanted, funny world of this crazy dragon!
If you like talking pets you will love Talking 3 Headed Dragon! Enjoy hours of fun and laughter with this talking and virtual dragon app!
Features:
- Talking Animals
- Spoken-Interaction/-Animations
- Talking Dragon
- Dragon Games
- Cool 3D graphics with high quality
- Dragon Simulator Game
- 3 Talking Heads - Dragons
- He repeats what you say
- More than 20 games to play
- Lighter modus - the flames react like real ones
- He can dance to different styles of music - from heavy metal to hip hop
- You can dress him up in different ways. Funny clothes: bra, negligee, skirt, dresses
- There are many backgrounds available, which you are able to choose as it pleases you
- He can imitate animal sounds
Tap on one of the dragon heads, his body and on all the different buttons to find out more about this mighty creature’s personality. You will probably not imagine such an amazing beast even in your dreams.
Overall, he is a very funny guy who does not always agree with himself, sometimes does comical grimaces and laughs.
You can play this game online and offline.
Talking 3 Headed Dragon is a talking app and a funny game - have fun with it!

bluejetty:00062086:ios.summary:
Are you tired of the same old crossword and word puzzle games?

bluejetty:00062086:ios.description:
Are you tired of the same old crossword and word puzzle games?
CodyCross introduces you to a fun new spelling puzzle and trivia crossword game!
Start your journey with CodyCross, a friendly alien from the planet COD-X who came to Earth to learn about our world. Discover interesting facts as you play through levels and encounter unique, themed crossword puzzles.
CodyCross: Crossword Puzzle, is the ultimate word game for adults! An exciting trivia mobile app that combines the fun of crossword games with the challenge of improving your vocabulary and spelling skills. Access unlimited crossword puzzles that will test your knowledge and keep you entertained.
Begin with a themed crossword puzzle board and try to guess the words that fit in the boxes, each with unique trivia clues, hints, and categories. Connect the letters you are guessing and solve the clues. All crosswords have a hidden secret word to help CodyCross attain more knowledge. Are you ready to enter this crossword universe? With crossword puzzles available daily, you'll never run out of new words and spelling challenges.
Learn with trivia
Improve your spelling as you solve each puzzle, with each correct answer you advance to the next level. Have fun and play spelling bee games that will help you improve your vocabulary and enhance your grammar skills. All crosswords have a hidden secret word to help CodyCross learn more. It is a fun way to test your general knowledge and your spelling skills, especially if you're tired of playing Trivia Crack, NYT crossword, New York Times games, and other boring crossword games. On this adventure, you’ll challenge yourself and expand your word knowledge.
Join
The crossword community is already enjoying CodyCross. With its unique combination of word and spelling puzzles, it’s the perfect mobile app game for anyone who loves puzzles and wants to improve their word skills. Whether you're a fan of crossword puzzles, spelling games, or word association, CodyCross has something for you. Become part of a community of players who want to learn and start solving trivia puzzles today.
Discover
Looking for a fun and challenging way to improve your word and spelling skills? Well, look no further than CodyCross! Explore beautiful worlds with this crossword hobby. Each map has unique words, trivia clues, crossword puzzles, and scenarios. Expand your library with different books to build your collection and learn fun facts and curiosities. Enjoy a unique combination of themed crossword puzzles and spelling games.
Have fun
CodyCross is more fun and challenging than other word search puzzles and newspaper crossword games. Start playing now, enjoy unlimited free crosswords, get rid of misspelled words, and join the fun with a crossword infinite puzzle game. With this categories game, you will test your general knowledge, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy an interactive word hobby. Keep your mind sharp with the different difficulty levels and play different game modes, such as Today’s Password (Contexto, Puzzword, and Wordle fans love it) and daily themed crosswords. Show your skills with the Daily Streak and Trivia Word Missions.
Subscription: the ultimate way to play crossword puzzles
- No ads interrupting your crossword puzzle experience;
- Unlimited crossword games with more prizes and rewards;
- Unlimited crossword puzzle and spelling puzzle games;
- Access to the entire Crossword Puzzle Free Daily games with words, spelling, and letters;
CodyCross: Crossword Puzzle Free is a game from the creators of Stop, Word Lanes, and Everyday Puzzles. They’re all puzzle games for teens and adults alike. Embark on this adventure with CodyCross! Solve the clues, guess the secret word, use your trivia knowledge and have fun!
Privacy policy at https://game.codycross-game.com/Terms/PrivacyPolicy
Terms of use at https://game.codycross-game.com/Terms/TermsOfService

bluejetty:00022758:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamt of being a squad leader? Now is the perfect time!
You will have to survive a horde of enemies. With the help of your amazing army, march forward. Count on your soldiers and merge the units to become more powerful in order to defeat the attackers. They will use all of their power and might to attack you: drones, ninjas, trucks, and tanks. Get ready for battle!
Discover new recruits to join your ranks and improve your firepower. How will you organize your military troops? Pistol, Rifle, Minigun, Bomber, Grenade, Rocket Launcher, Tank, Sniper and even Sharpshooter, they are all available to help you counter the waves.
To conquer, you must reach the highest level and for that, you will have to create an all-star army and have a great rate of fire. Are the enemies too strong? Launch the nuke, but make sure to time it right. One blast can make you the ultimate tycoon… or end everything.
Upgrade and customize your hero as you wish, do you feel more comfortable to shoot the enemies as a superhero or as an assassin? The choice is yours in this military simulation! 
Make sure to test the endless mode to prove your skills!
Get ready for warfare!

bluejetty:00179576:ios.description:
OldRoll is a film analog camera app mimicking the most realistic experience of using an actual disposable or a film camera. 
We have curated for you a wide array of classic vintage cameras loved by photographers and shutterbugs throughout the decades: from Instant camera, Fisheye to Super 8mm video cam - each reproduced to its finest details including the color, hue, grain, texture - and sometimes a few light leaks here and there for you to explore.
Download OldRoll and it’s just one shot away from 90s!
#Excellent Analog Cameras
• Classic M: Soft, timeless tones inspired by classic rangefinder film cameras.
• INS P: Instant-photo tones and timeless frames for shared moments.
• TOY F is a disposable camera from David and Emma specially created for you. Its warm color is suitable for shooting gourmet food. Take our pocket camera to get instant free prints!
• ROL 3.5: Rich color with a lo-fi vintage film look.
• 120 V brings you the charm of retro film.
• TOY K: Warm tones and classic grain inspired by disposable film cameras.
• Quatre camera is coming soon, it will bring you the best film story photo collage, helps you create photos grids with ease.
• We will also provide half-frame camera, fish eye camera, Kira camera with sparkle glitter effect and shining stars and double-exposure cameras, as well as random photo frames soon or later, to let you feel the charm of retro cameras
#Outstanding features
• It’s not a photo editor or a video editor, you don't need to edit or retouch the photo.
• Photos with square film frame and retro glitch effect are convenient to share to Instagram
• Post office function allows you to send photos straightly to recipient’s home screen. Come and share every moment with your friends.
• Share your photos with friends on your favorite social platforms.
• Flash helps you create d3d blockbusters in low-light situations
• Custom fun date stamp watermark, you can also freely modify the timestamp on the photo.
• Flip the lens to take a retro photo and experience the art of selfie!
• Most trendy effects: vhs, grain, cinema, film3d, prequel and sequel feeling, light leaks, 1888 or 1998 style and many more.
• Retro texture & rare vision different from digital cameras.
• The photo shooting timer free your hands to pose.
• Excellent photo mirror effect allow you to rotate and flip the photos.
• Photo collage camera with indie kid effect and glitter here for you.
We will also bring you 8mm, 16mm, 35mm video shooting, camcorder, glitch and 3d photos camera soon or later, let’s look forward to the video filters and effects for vcr live and photo!
Come on! Become a super video star! This will be your most chic camera in your iphone!

bluejetty:00185607:ios.description:
Welcome to our painting app, where the canvas is your playground and creativity knows no bounds. With our intuitive interface and comprehensive set of tools, you can unleash your inner artist and bring your imagination to life on a digital canvas.
Drawing Desk: 
Drawing Desk offers a comprehensive digital art experience with 105 precise drawing tools, including pens, pencils, and brushes. It features popular canvases, customizable brush settings, photo import and editing, text addition, rotation and scaling, 200 HD stickers, undo/redo options, rulers, and various shapes. Enjoy a full-screen workspace, automatic saving, and easy sharing with 100+ custom drawing tools.
Sketch Book:
Sketch Book is a feature-rich digital art tool offering 200+ brushes, 12 popular brush categories, and advanced layer support. With features like layer transformation, brush adjustment, glowing lines, and 3D Touch compatibility, it provides a versatile and immersive drawing experience. Undo/redo, zoom, and easy export and sharing options make it a powerful choice for digital artists.
Smudge Art:
Unleash your creative flow with the Smudge Art feature. Blur and blend colors, transforming your digital canvas into a masterpiece that captures the essence of movement and emotion.
Image Base Drawing:
Image-based drawing allows artists to use existing images as references or foundations for their artwork, enhancing precision and creative possibilities.
Doodle pad:
Simple drawing tools like Doodle enable you jot down ideas and share them with others. Sharing your ideas with the community is simple.
Pixel Art:
Experience nostalgia and creativity with our 'Pixel Art' feature. Craft intricate digital art reminiscent of retro video games and 8-bit graphics. This grid-based tool empowers both enthusiasts and newcomers to design precise pixel images, sprites, and icons with old-school charm. Unleash your inner pixel artist and bring your 8-bit visions to life.
Mandala Drawing: 
Mandala Desk provides a soothing drawing experience with playback options, customizable colors, fill tools, and pencil brushes. Users can set their preferred mandala size, complexity, and enjoy undo/redo options for creative freedom.
Coloring Book: 
Coloring Book is the ultimate relaxation tool, offering 29 categories and 500+ images to color, including superheroes, fashion, patterns, and more. With a wide range of colors, community inspiration, advanced filters, and powerful editing tools, it's easy to create stunning art. Zoom features and seamless sharing on social platforms make it a perfect coloring companion.
Subscriptions:
You can choose between subscription options that closely match your needs.
Premium subscriptions with 1 week and 3 days trial
* Weekly / $4.99
* Monthly/$9.99
* Yearly/$39.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
