bluejetty:00122258:ios.description:
Up 9 is the most addicting new puzzle game! Simply slide up numbered hexagons on the honey grid. Stack the same numbers to merge them up to 9.
Be smart when you stack pieces. The grid can get filled up very easily.
Up 9 is a fun and exciting block merge game, and you can play continuously for free! It is a simple puzzle game that will challenge you, while also training your brain.
HOW TO PLAY
• Drop hexagon numbers onto the honey grid
• Tap an item to rotate your game piece before dropping it.
• Form a higher number by merging three or more pieces of the same number.
• 9 is the final number, which is quite interesting. Try merging three 9’s and see what happens.
FEATURES
• Fun and easy to learn.
• Unlimited reloads, NO TIME LIMITS.
• Challenge your friends with your score.
• Play offline anytime.
• Eye-friendly colors.
Enjoy playing!

bluejetty:00037823:ios.description:
Suivez l'information avec l'application Mediapart - LE journal indépendant et participatif en France.
Mediapart est un journal d’actualité en ligne 100% indépendant. Sans subventions, sans publicités, sans actionnaires, Mediapart ne vit que du soutien de ses lecteurs et lectrices.
Actualités, révélations et enquêtes exclusives en France et dans le monde :
 • Élection présidentielle 2027
 • Procès en appel du financement libyen Sarkozy-Kadhafi
 • Violences sexuelles et sexistes
 • Crise climatique : canicules, incendies et sécheresse en France
Retrouvez dans l’application nos enquêtes, parti-pris, reportages vidéo, alertes infos AFP (Agence France Presse).
Des contenus exclusifs :
 • Émissions vidéo d'actualités : À l'air libre, Résonances avec Waxx, La chronique de Waly Dia, L’échappée avec Edwy Plenel, Extrêmorama avec David Dufresne, Retex...
 • Articles audio, podcasts et résumés sonores d’enquêtes (Sur un fil, Affaire libyenne Sarkozy-Kadhafi, De l'enquête au procès, l'Esprit Critique, la Relève, Le Squale opérations secrètes)
 • Documentaires partenaires Tënk, le film documentaire Media Crash qui raconte les coulisses des grands médias (tv, radio, presse), le film documentaire Guet-apens
Recevez gratuitement nos newsletters :
 • La lettre In Extremis : la nouvelle newsletter de Mediapart sur les extrêmes droites
 • La lettre écologie
 • La lettre pour tous·tes : féminisme et questions de genre
 • La lettre politique
 • La lettre enquêtes : coulisses de nos révélations
Et bien d'autres...
Mediapart est aussi un journal participatif :
Avec le Club de Mediapart, les abonné·es peuvent commenter les articles mais aussi publier des billets sur leur blog. Une sélection de ces contributions est accessible à l’ensemble des utilisateurs de l’application mobile, abonné·es ou non.
Les plus de notre application :
 • Tout Mediapart dans une appli sans pub : Une du journal, sélection du Club des abonné·es et un accès aux différentes rubriques (International, France, Économie...)
 • Enregistrez vos articles pour les lire plus tard
 • Pas le temps de lire ? Ecoutez nos résumés d’enquêtes en 5 minutes
 • Recevez nos alertes info en direct
Votre avis est important
Nous sommes à l’écoute de vos remarques et suggestions pour améliorer l’application. N’hésitez donc pas à nous contacter à l’adresse suivante : serviceabonnes@mediapart.fr 
Conditions générales d'abonnement : https://www.mediapart.fr/conditions-generales-d-abonnement-au-journal-mediapart

bluejetty:00177344:ios.name: Joule Work
bluejetty:00177344:ios.summary:
Joule Work is a smarter, single place for work—where AI handles the busy work, so people can stay focused on outcomes. 
What is the Joule Work mobile app? 
The Joule Work mobile app helps people accomplish complex work while on the go. Use
bluejetty:00177344:ios.description:
Joule Work is a smarter, single place for work—where AI handles the busy work, so people can stay focused on outcomes. 
What is the Joule Work mobile app? 
The Joule Work mobile app helps people accomplish complex work while on the go. Users identify their goals, and AI takes action across systems to deliver the outcome. 
The Joule Work experience: 
This new dynamic workspace surfaces relevant insights and automates routine work based on user intent—available for SAP Early Adopter Care customers. 
See what’s new in the Joule Work experience: 
Joule Work uses the deep business context of Joule Agents and Assistants to surface relevant data and automate workflows across SAP and third-party systems. 
Key Features: 
- Conversations: Conversations allow people to express intent and explore what they want to accomplish through dialogue with Joule. Joule brings together guidance and outcomes from across SAP and third-party systems. Conversations can also act as an entry point to Spaces for more complex workflows. 
- Spaces: Spaces are dynamic workspaces for simple and complex problem-solving. Each space is composed in real time to bring the right data, tools, and context together for a specific goal, allowing people to work in an environment that adapts to their present goal, instead of navigating applications and passive UIs. 
- Voice: Speak naturally to start or continue a conversation, trigger actions, and get answers—no typing required. Work hands-free between meetings, on the warehouse floor, or anywhere you need. 
- Multimodal input: Attach a photo, scan a document, or switch between speaking and typing without losing your context. Joule Work connects physical inputs with digital workflows. 
The SAP Build Work Zone experience you know—continuing to deliver. 
New name, same experience: SAP Mobile Start has been rebranded to Joule Work mobile app, accompanied by a new app icon and an updated user experience. All core functionality and features remain unchanged, ensuring continuity for both customers and end users with no disruption to existing workflows. 
Key Features: 
- Customize your mobile experience: Adapt theming and branding, deliver role-specific content, and let users personalize their app experience. 
- Easily access the SAP Autonomous Suite: Access your SAP apps, tasks, and insights from one mobile hub that takes you directly to the right screens. 
- Act on approvals and tasks faster: Approve, update, and act in seconds right from your mobile device with push notifications, quick actions, and native widgets. 
Note: To use the Joule Work mobile app with your business data, you must be a user of the underlying business solution.

bluejetty:00183380:ios.description:
Take the quickest shortcut from hungry to happy with the EatStreet iOS app for food delivery & takeout.
Life’s easy with EatStreet - breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, or snacks - you don’t have to worry about it. The EatStreet food delivery app is your craving quencher for meals, drinks, snacks, appetizers and shareable food for parties: Available in over 250 cities throughout the U.S.! We offer fast pickup and food delivery from local restaurants and diners.
Our fast-growing EatStreet restaurant delivery app offers cheap food delivery in major cities including: 
-Illinois - DeKalb; 
-Iowa - Ames, Dubuque, Waterloo/Cedar Falls; 
-Kansas - Lawrence, Manhattan, Salina, Topeka; 
-Wisconsin - Appleton, Eau Claire, Fond du Lac WI, Green Bay, Janesville, Kenosha, La Crosse, Madison, Manitowoc, Milwaukee, Oshkosh, Sheboygan, Stevens Point, Wausau.
EatStreet partners with many local and chain restaurants in your city, neighborhood, or college town to provide diverse food choices: pizza, pasta, burgers, wings, tacos, etc. Some of our favorite food spots include Applebee's, Taco Johns, Toppers Pizza, Potbelly, Qdoba, Noodles & Company, Dairy Queen, Kwik Trip/Kwik Star and many more.
Order from home or work - just for yourself, or surprise everyone with a delicious treat! Need a celebratory cake or donuts at work? We’ve got you covered!
Dig into our hunger-solving Apple App features:
1. EatStreet Exclusive Coupons:
When you order food with the EatStreet App, we'll hook you up with exclusive coupons, restaurant specials, and rewards. We partner with many popular local restaurants from mom-&-pop diners to the big brands that everyone knows and loves. So the more you order to eat, the more you earn! 
2. Explore Different Cuisines: 
Order Chinese food; Get pizza delivered; Find your favorite sushi and pad thai; No matter what kind of food you crave, we've got you covered - Italian, Chinese, Mexican, Mediterranean, keto, vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten free and more!
3. Food Photography & Restaurant Reviews: 
Check out local favorite dishes and menu items before you order! You can even check-out photos of some of the tasty eats & read restaurant reviews to take the guessing out of what you're getting. 
4. Track Food Orders: 
There's no worse feeling after ordering food than not knowing where your order is. With our new EatStreet Food Order Tracker, you can check the status of your grub from the second you place your order until it's at your front door. 
5. Convenient Payment Options: 
The EatStreet iOS App offers a variety of ways to pay. You can always use credit card or PayPal, as well as using secure Apple Pay! Our EatStreet food ordering app allows you to pay for your meal as a group or an individual: great for work, parties and get-togethers.
6. Multiple Ways to Order Food:
Order Again: Having food deja? Our ‘Order Again’ feature makes it incredibly easy to reorder your favorite dishes.
Group Ordering & Split the Bill: Invite friends and start a group order. We’ll even split the bill so you don't get stuck ponying up for the "I'll pay you back later" people.
Order Ahead: Need food in the future? Place a delivery pickup order in advance. Your food will be piping hot and ready, right when and where you want it to be.
Ready to order with EatStreet? Here’s how to get started with your first food delivery:
 1. Download EatStreet iOS delivery app today!
 2. Create your account and login
 3. Pick from your favorite food spots
 4. Choose your meal and delivery type
 5. Pay and place your food order
 6. Track your delivery progress
 7. Enjoy your delicious food.
EatStreet is the perfect food ordering app for all your favorite grub & local eats. Order the meal you crave from local restaurants you love. Download the EatStreet food delivery app now!
Hungry. Happy. EatStreet.

bluejetty:00161706:ios.description:
Disclaimer!
Don't use this App for medical decisions. It comes with absolutely no warranty. Use it at your own risk!
You can use nightguard to submit your bg values to the Apple HealthKit. This is disabled by default but can
be enabled in the nightguard app.
Nightguard is an app that displays your blood glucose values from the Nightscout backend.
It is a native iOS App with support for the Apple Watch.
Features are:
- Define a range of acceptable blood glucose values.
- Whenever your values are out of range you will be alerted.
- You can snooze the alerts all the time and for a defined time period.
- You can reactivate the alerts all the time.
- You can activate alerts if the values are rising or falling too fast.
- The app displays yesterdays values as an overlay chart. This way you have a hint about how your values could behave in the future.
- Tune your basal rates with the statistics function to overlay different days
- Sync your bg values to HealthKit (optional)
For the alarms to work the app has to be active. So you can enable a screen lock that keeps the app running all night long.
Have a look at www.nightscout.info for more information about how to setup your own Nightscout backend.

bluejetty:00077888:ios.description:
Help your little one to learn, grow and discover with a variety of simple yet engaging games, perfectly designed for their educational needs. With a bright and colourful design, each activity captures your child’s imagination and enables interactive learning at home – or on the go.
Perfect for preschoolers, Brain Learning Games makes education fun! Each game aims to develop a core skill such as recognising colours, matching shapes, counting items, or learning words. Play along with your child and enjoy quality time together, while boosting their cognitive and motor skills. With simple menus and screens, enjoyable gameplay, and simple inputs, your child will be fully entertained while they study.
FEATURES:
- Numerous games to encourage learning and development
- Match items and shapes to help learn pattern recognition
- Discover a variety of puzzles and develop problem solving skills
- Help your child to count and learn their numbers
- Encourage empathy in your kids with games about sharing and helping
- Family fun time can be found in the word and language games
- Fun sounds and animations help to keep your toddler engaged 
- Celebrate each win with in-game rewards 
- Discreet menus and options make sure you can carefully manage their play and learning
- Gorgeous graphics and exciting gameplay stops boredom and makes learning fun
Played and tested by kindergarten and playschool children, this app is perfectly designed for your little one. Learn together by engaging as a family, then as your child grows in confidence and knowledge, they will quickly be able to play on their own. With locked sections and menu items, which can only be activated by an adult, you can rest assured that your child can play and learn independently and still be safe.

bluejetty:00118915:ios.description:
CoolWallet – The Decentralized Crypto Wallet
【Experience the Power of Decentralized Web3 Wallets】
Take full control of your private keys and manage your crypto assets securely without relying on third parties.
【Seamless Cold + Hot Wallet Experience at Your Fingertips】
COLD + HOT = Cool
CoolWallet App combines both cold and hot wallets in one sleek app.
All users can enjoy a smooth and intuitive hot wallet experience, while CoolWallet Pro/S/Go holders also benefit from industry-leading cold storage security and seamless integration within the app.
【Smart Contract Security Scanner – Smart Scan】
Before confirming any transaction, CoolWallet App scans both the DApp and the smart contract itself to detect suspicious behavior. It provides detailed transaction info and warns you of potential risks to ensure a safer Web3 experience.
【Multi-Chain & Token Support for a Smooth Onboarding Experience】
- Supports fast addition of multiple major blockchains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Sui, Dogecoin, Gram, Polygon, Avalanche-C, Optimism, Arbitrum, OKX, Cronos, zkSync Era, Flare, ThunderCore, and more.
- Allows custom network and token integration, including EVM-compatible chains like Fantom and Aurora. Supported token formats include ERC-20, BEP-20, TRC-20, SPL, Jetton, and multi-chain stablecoins like USDT, USDC, and BUSD.
- CoolWallet Pro / Go users can access even more blockchains like Tron, Solana, Cardano, Polkadot, XRP Ledger, and additional token formats—offering a comprehensive and flexible crypto management experience.
【CoolWallet – The Best Web3 Cold Wallet for Everyday Use】
CoolWallet is more than just a physical crypto card—it’s a secure, portable solution that fits right in your real wallet. Effortlessly manage your digital assets anytime, anywhere with confidence.
Trusted by over 200,000 users worldwide since 2016, CoolWallet enables you to securely send, receive, buy, and store cryptocurrencies, and interact with millions of individuals and institutions across the globe.
【About CoolBitX】
Founded in 2014, CoolBitX is a Taiwan-based fintech innovator steeped in blockchain technology. Led by a team of hardware security experts, CoolBitX not only offers world-leading blockchain security solutions but has also fostered a robust software team. With significant achievements in virtual asset hardware wallets, regulatory technology, and other blockchain application software, CoolBitX continues to push the boundaries of blockchain application innovation.
【Contact Us】
Email: support@coolbitx.com

bluejetty:00068991:ios.description:
Read the Quran in English and in the original Arabic, side by side. Quran Majeed brings you the complete Holy Quran with a clear English translation, beautiful recitations and the daily tools every Muslim needs – prayer times, Azan, Qibla and more.
READ THE QURAN IN ENGLISH
• All 114 Surahs and 30 Juz in Arabic with English translation
• Translations in more languages available to download
• Mushaf mode: turn the pages just like a printed Quran
• Adjustable font size for comfortable reading
• Pick up where you left off with "Continue reading"
LISTEN AND LEARN
• Recitations by world-famous Qaris: Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdul Basit (Murattal & Mujawwad), Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, Muhammad Siddiq Al-Minshawi, Abdur-Rahman As-Sudais, Saud Ash-Shuraim, Abu Bakr Al-Shatri, Hani Ar-Rifai and Mohamed Al-Tablawi
• Husary Muallim – a slow teaching recitation, ideal for learning correct pronunciation
• Memorization: mark the verses you know and follow your progress
• Immerse mode: calm, full-screen reading while you listen
• Audio keeps playing in the background, even with the screen locked
NEVER MISS A PRAYER
• Accurate Salah times for your location, with many calculation methods
• Azan notifications for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha with a choice of Azan sounds
• Optional reminder before each prayer
• Friday (Jumu'ah) reminder to read Surah Al-Kahf
• Monthly prayer timetable, and track the prayers you have prayed
QIBLA & MOSQUES
• Qibla compass that points you to the Kaaba
• Find mosques nearby
MORE FOR YOUR DAY
• Tasbih counter for your Dhikr
• 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna) with meanings and explanations
• Duas for daily life
• Hijri calendar and Hijri ↔ Gregorian date converter
• Shahada
• Live Quran TV & Radio
Available in more than 20 languages and free to download.
PREMIUM – NO ADS
Enjoy Quran Majeed without any ads and support our work:
• Premium Monthly and Premium Yearly (auto-renewable subscriptions)
• Premium Lifetime (one-time purchase)
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: http://erinalisafaqe.atwebpages.com

bluejetty:00170036:ios.description:
AllpFit Home: Seu Passaporte para uma Vida Mais Saudável e Feliz!
Cansado de dietas mirabolantes e treinos exaustivos que não trazem resultados? O AllpFit Home é a revolução que você esperava para democratizar o acesso à saúde e ao bem-estar, com soluções práticas, eficazes e acessíveis para todos. Imagine ter um universo de possibilidades na palma da sua mão, adaptado à sua realidade, sem radicalismos e com resultados que você pode ver e sentir!
O Que Esperar da AllpFit Home?
Descubra um ecossistema completo de bem-estar, onde cada detalhe foi pensado para você:
• Aulas ao Vivo Todos os Dias: Nossos treinos de até 20 minutos podem ser feitos em qualquer lugar, sem equipamentos. Escolha entre programas de emagrecimento, musculação em casa, ativação metabólica, saúde 40+, pilates funcional e até fisioterapia para alívio de dores e melhoria da mobilidade.
• Nutrição descomplicada com IA: Tenha um suporte alimentar completo! Com a Calculadora Inteligente de Calorias, basta uma foto do seu prato para saber a quantidade exata de carboidratos, proteínas, calorias e gorduras. Além disso, tire dúvidas em tempo real e adapte tudo à sua rotina, com dietas para emagrecimento, definição, ganho de massa, opções para veganos e vegetarianos, protocolos detox e mais de 200 receitas deliciosas.
• Mente Sã, Corpo São: Cuide da sua saúde mental com encontros semanais ao vivo com psicólogos e nutricionistas. Temos programas específicos para compulsão alimentar, saúde emocional em relacionamentos e até terapia sonora profunda para um sono reparador de adultos e crianças.
• Allp Kids - Saúde para os Pequenos: Programas exclusivos para as crianças! Com oficinas criativas, atividades físicas, brincadeiras educativas e conteúdo que estimulam o respeito, a criatividade e o desenvolvimento saudável.
• Mães no Foco: Se você passou por gestações recentes ou antigas, temos um protocolo completo para você! Com alimentação direcionada, treinos que respeitam cada fase do corpo e um programa específico para tratar a diástase, recuperar a autoestima e melhorar a qualidade de vida.
Mais do que um App, uma Comunidade!
O AllpFit Home é a melhor atmosfera fitness digital do mundo! Aqui, você não está sozinho. É guiado por profissionais que entendem suas necessidades e te ajudam a evoluir com leveza, resultado e consistência. Sinta-se acolhido, motivado e acompanhado em cada etapa da sua jornada.
Pronto para revolucionar sua saúde e bem-estar? Baixe agora a AllpFit Home e comece sua transformação!

Third-grade students are at a pi
bluejetty:00140831:ios.description:
Introducing the reading app designed specifically for grade 3 kids to expand their reading skills and knowledge, spark their curiosity, and foster a love for reading while covering a wide range of subjects! 
Third-grade students are at a pivotal stage in their learning journey, and reading books across various subjects helps them develop a broad range of skills. Here’s a breakdown of the skills they will gain from reading books in different areas that are available all in one interactive platform. 
Science
Curiosity and Inquiry: Develop a sense of curiosity about the natural world.
Basic Concepts: Understand fundamental scientific concepts.
Vocabulary: Build a science-specific vocabulary.
Critical Thinking: Begin to think critically about how things work and why.
Health
Healthy Habits: Learn about the body, systems, nutrition, and exercise.
Body Awareness: Understand the basic functions of the human body and the importance of taking care of it.
Physics
Basic Principles: Grasp simple principles of motion, force, and energy.
Experimentation: Engage in basic experiments to see physics concepts in action.
Problem-Solving: Develop problem-solving skills through understanding cause and effect.
Critical Thinking: Enhance critical thinking by making predictions and testing hypotheses.
Social Sciences
Landforms: Learn about twenty-four different landforms of the earth.
Environmental Awareness: Develop an understanding of natural resources and environmental conservation.
Stories (Literature)
Reading Comprehension: Improve comprehension through engaging narratives.
Imagination: Stimulate imagination and creativity.
Moral Understanding: Learn about morals, ethics, and values through characters and plots.
Vocabulary: Expand vocabulary and language skills.
Empathy: Develop empathy by understanding different characters’ perspectives and emotions.
English Language Arts
Reading Skills: Enhance reading fluency and comprehension.
Writing Skills: Practice writing through stories, essays, and reports.
Grammar and Punctuation: Learn the rules of grammar and punctuation.
Listening and Speaking: Improve listening skills through read-aloud and develop speaking skills through presentations and discussions.
Critical Thinking: Analyze texts and think critically about content, structure, and themes.
Reading books in these areas helps third graders build a strong foundation of knowledge and skills that are essential for their academic growth and overall development.
App Features:
Vast Library: Access a diverse collection of books covering stories, science, physics, health, space, famous explorers, famous People, English language arts, vocabulary building, holidays and festivals, and geography.
Human Narration: Each book has two modes—'Read Myself' and 'Read To Me' modes. Read To Me mode is where the book is read aloud in a human expressive voice to maximize engagement and retention.
Educational Content: Explore topics like ecosystems, social interactions, health habits, and more, presented in a child-friendly and age-appropriate manner.
Offline Reading: Download books to read offline, enabling uninterrupted learning anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.
Immersive Audio-Visual Experience: Enjoy vibrant illustrations, enchanting narrations, and captivating animations that bring stories to life and make learning a joyous experience.
Whether your child is exploring the wonders of science, delving into imaginative stories, or learning about important life skills, this app provides a fun, and educational platform that nurtures a lifelong love for reading and learning in grade 3 children. Download the app today and embark on an exciting literary adventure!

bluejetty:00127370:ios.description:
Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them.
 Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close.
Features:
- Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells 
- Choose between loose, normal or tight setting
- Loudness boost option

bluejetty:00070545:ios.description:
Padel Fast is the easiest way to run padel tournaments and leagues. Pick a format, add your players, and Padel Fast takes care of the rest.
TOURNAMENTS IN UNDER A MINUTE
Choose your format, how many points you play to, and who’s playing. Padel Fast creates every match and every round automatically, based on how many players and courts you have.
After each round, enter the results and the scoreboard updates instantly. By the time the last point is played, the winner is already on screen.
10+ TOURNAMENT FORMATS
Americano: everyone plays with everyone once.
Team Americano: every team plays every other team once.
Mexicano: matches are balanced by current standings, so games stay close.
Team Mexicano: Mexicano balancing with fixed partners.
Mixicano: every man plays with every woman.
Ladder: challenge your way to the top spot.
Beat the Box: group play with promotion and relegation between courts.
King of the court: win and stay on the winner’s court.
And more, including a Tournament Builder for designing your own structure.
LEAGUES THAT RUN THEMSELVES
Set up a league in any format and let it run all season.
Divisions with clear, always-current standings
Players enter their own match scores
Substitutes for injured players
Separate join requests for each division
LIVE SCOREBOARDS
Share a link to your scoreboard and anyone can follow the scores live, on their phone or on the TV at your venue. See tournaments being played right now at https://padelfast.com
BUILT FOR REAL PADEL
Odd or even numbers of players, both fully supported
Play by time or to a set number of points, or assign points freely each round
Any group size, from a handful of players to as many as you like
Host and admin roles, change logs and corrections to past results
Fairer first rounds, with players seeded by level
Tablet-optimised layout
Export your data at any time. It’s yours.
Padel Fast exists to cut the admin around padel and give you the time back for playing.

bluejetty:00071692:ios.description:
Welcome to Fade Master 3D where you have to create the best hairstyles!
In this incredibly satisfying hair-cutting game you will experience a great barbershop experience.
Numerous customers will demand different hair models.
All of these customers are real-life simulations and will want you to transform them into their most beautiful state!
Meet with a homeless guy and make him tidier or give the best hairstyle you can to a soon-to-be-wed groom.
Find the models in the catalog and proceed with cutting their hair, mustache, and beard. There are more than 20 hair models: Mid fade, box fade, military high fade, curly fade, high fade, etc.
You will learn and apply different techniques & tools: 
- Trim the hair of a homeless guy with a trimmer
- Cut the military personnel's hair with bright scissors
- Scratch the rapper's hair with a trimmer
- Prepare a jobless guy for his interview by combing his hair
- Burn phobia guy's hair with a torch - Be careful!
- Implant hair to a special agent for his mission
- Paint the baller's hair with a spray
Perm 80's disco guy's hair and go on with the vibe!
Wax eyebrows and feather make them look perfect!
See how good a barber you are along with a realistic game experience. Make the transformations while applying the hairstyles they want to people of different styles. Trust your talent to be the best barber in town and get the best haircuts. All these are free to play.
Game Features:
- Real-life mechanics
- Impressive hair models
- a wide variety of hair-cut tools
- Different fade styles
- Sounds that reflect reality
- Smooth camera experience
- Character change screen

bluejetty:00124025:ios.description:
Join your friends in playing an online twist to the classic social/card game, Mafia!
Mafia is a game about a village where every night after the townsfolk goes to sleep, a death occurs! The following day there are trials and a guilty person is decided. The goal is to figure out who is guilty through a series of investigations. If too many regular townspeople are killed, then the mafia will win. The game is full of interesting characters like the Cop, Doctor, Granny, Sniper, Framer, Kamikaze, Godfather, and many more. Custom avatars can be made in the app, as well as the freedom to create games and invite your friends.
With Mafia Mystery there’s no need for a narrator, so jump in and start playing games! You can create games with up to 24 players, private mode, 20 unique roles, and a customizable game length.

bluejetty:00090727:ios.description:
Mahjong Harmony: Relax is a calming Mahjong Solitaire puzzle game designed especially for seniors. It’s the perfect way to unwind with a relaxing puzzle that also keeps your mind sharp. Match identical tiles at your own pace in a stress-free, zen-like experience that blends relaxation and brain training. Enjoy an easy-to-use interface with large, clear tiles and simple controls. The game is senior-friendly – whether you’re new to Mahjong or a seasoned player, you’ll find it intuitive and comfortable to play. No timers, no pressure, and no complicated menus: just pure, relaxing gameplay where you can focus on the fun of matching tiles and clearing the board. Mahjong Harmony: Relax features hundreds of levels and tile layouts to explore, offering endless hours of soothing entertainment. Each level is carefully crafted to provide the right balance of challenge and tranquility. As you progress, you’ll gently exercise your memory and concentration, making this game a great choice for daily brain training and mental stimulation. One of the best parts is you can play offline. Offline play means Mahjong Harmony is ready whenever and wherever you are – no Wi-Fi or internet needed. Whether you’re on a long flight, relaxing at home, or anywhere in between, your Mahjong tile-matching escape is always at your fingertips. Key Features:
Easy for Seniors: Intuitive interface with big tiles and simple tap controls.
Relaxing Gameplay: Soothing sounds and visuals create a Zen Mahjong atmosphere.
Many Puzzles: Hundreds of unique Mahjong Solitaire levels and layouts.
Brain Training: Improves memory and focus with gentle puzzle-solving.
Offline Play: Enjoy the full game anytime, online or offline, no internet required.
If you’re looking for a stress-free way to unwind and keep your mind sharp, Mahjong Harmony: Relax is the perfect puzzle game for you. Discover the joy of a classic Mahjong Solitaire adapted for relaxation and start your tranquil tile-matching journey today! Download now and find your harmony.

bluejetty:00146244:ios.summary:
One English word a day, on your Home Screen. Word of the Day gives you a clear definition, the pronunciation, an example sentence and synonyms. Tap the speaker to hear the word, and tap again to hear it slowly.
A WORD AT YOUR LEVEL
- 9,111
bluejetty:00146244:ios.description:
One English word a day, on your Home Screen. Word of the Day gives you a clear definition, the pronunciation, an example sentence and synonyms. Tap the speaker to hear the word, and tap again to hear it slowly.
A WORD AT YOUR LEVEL
- 9,111 words of general English, from A1 to C2 on the CEFR scale. Choose the levels you want to see.
- Definitions and examples written for learners.
- Origins: over 4,000 words show where they come from.
- Not today's word for you? Get a new one, once a day.
PRACTICE, A FEW MINUTES A DAY
- Daily Review: the words you practice come back just before you'd forget them. Up to 3 new words a day free; 5, 7 or 10 with Premium.
- Daily Climb: a word puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Find five words from their definitions, from B1 to C2, and share your score.
- Keep a streak, and see the words you've learned.
ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
- Small and medium Home Screen widgets, and Lock Screen widgets.
- Hear the word without opening the app: tap the speaker on the medium widget, add it to Control Center, or ask Siri to "speak today's word".
- The widget shows the same word as the app and changes after midnight.
- A daily reminder at the time you choose.
HEAR IT IN CONTEXT
- Videos: short clips of people saying the word in real speech, at normal or slower speed, with the accent you choose.
- Look the word up in a learner's dictionary, translate it, or find it in the news.
MAKE IT YOURS
- Read your word on paper, or on a photo theme, some of them moving. A few photo themes are free.
- Light and dark, following your iPhone.
- Choose the voice and accent that read the word aloud.
PREMIUM (OPTIONAL: YEARLY, MONTHLY OR LIFETIME)
- Six more word lists, each with Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced words: Business (438), Travel (264), Phrasal Verbs (882), Idioms (158), Feelings & Personality (183) and Food & Cooking (171).
- Uncommon Words (365): rare words, each with a short note on its origin.
- Every photo theme, and your own photo behind the word, in the app and in the widgets.
- Ask AI: ask anything about the word, or tap for an example, a short story, synonyms, the meaning in simpler words, or a mini quiz. Ask AI needs an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on. It runs on your device.
- A new word without watching an ad.
- No ads.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00022171:ios.description:
Card.Note：小某书数万博主私藏推荐的手账类App 
这是一款集照片、文字、语音于一体的全能笔记App ，让您以更自由的方式记录生活。
你可以用它来写诗、短文、随想； 
也可以使用它的丰富照片模式，记录生活瞬间；
也可以用它来记要事、记清单、记规划、设置要事提醒；
还可以直接用语音输入来记录每个瞬间的念头。
「Card.Note」三大笔记类型：
1、照片笔记
- 拥有单幅六幅九幅自由和日历模式
- 支持票根照片，一票一城CityWalk
- 支持自定义布局，设计杂志感版式
- 琉璃色盘模式，支持液态玻璃效果
- 智能配色、配文，让照片讲述故事
- 支持自定义配色、配文，更加随心
2、文字笔记
- 简洁优雅的文字编辑界面
- 支持更换100余种背景色
- 支持更换10余种文青字体
- 支持根据色卡集归档笔记
- 支持添加题图让笔记更丰富
- 每份笔记均可生成精致卡片
3、语音笔记
- 一键录制，解放双手
- 支持语音转化成文本
- 支持暂停/继续播放
- 随时记录灵感、会议和故事
「Card.Note」几大特点：
1.极简设计
循着极简的设计理念，结合图标及手势操作，轻松上手。
2.文青定制
精选了 10 款文青字体及 9 种文青主题色卡、多达 100 种不同颜色的色卡，可根据喜好定制各种卡片。
3.丰富照片样式
支持单幅照片、六幅照片、九幅照片、琉璃色盘等照片模式，可智能识别配色和配文，也可自定义配色、配文及字体样式。
3.全局卡片化
充分融入了卡片设计理念，可根据喜好随意切换横版或竖版两种卡片笔记显示样式。
4.语音录入
可直接语音输入，随时记录每个灵光显现的想法。你可以把它当作成iOS文艺版“闪念胶囊”。
5.要事提醒
可设置提醒闹种，重要事情和计划不再错失。
6.小组件功能
支持Widget小组件功能，可直接在应用图标或Widget快速打开应用或直接进入创建笔记界面，让你随时高效地记录每个念头。
7.iCloud云同步
支持iCloud云同步，多台设备间数据可任意同步。
8.深色模式
全局适配深色模式，视觉舒适不刺眼。
Card.Note 将实用性与美学完美结合。无论是简单的待办清单、长篇的生活随笔、珍贵的语音记录，还是精彩的照片故事，都能在这里找到最适合的呈现方式。
感谢下载，生活愉快。
如有问题或建议，请联系开发者
小红书/微博：土味文艺开发者
邮箱：yande18@126.com

- Email readings to friends
- Browse the entire deck of cards
- Flip cards over to read each card's meaning
- Get the most out of your deck with the complete guidebook

Official Blue Angel Publishing licensed app

bluejetty:00035053:ios.description:
War Troops 1917 - Trench Warfare: WW1 Strategy Game
War Troops 1917 is a fast-paced military strategy world war 1 game, a perfectly designed pixel game prequel to the War Troops war game.
Become the commander of troops and assault the enemies in trenches in World War 1 game! Climb up the levels to unlock new military units including Assault soldiers, Officers, Flamethrowers, Snipers, Artillery, Machine gunners, Gas Masks, Mark V tanks, Fighter Jets and military equipments. Devise a trench military war strategy that will bring your enemies to their knees!
This 1917 trench assault warfare offers you epic defense gameplay with awesome pixel game graphics and sound effects, giving you an immersive experience of real world war trenches of British, German, and French Regimes.
The World War 1 warfare 1917 game is all about trench warfare. If you are a military enthusiast, this game is for you. You will enjoy this game equally as pro gamer or a casual player looking for a good game for time pass.
Remember to use gas masks and hold the last trenches until the enemies quit. Captain, the troops are waiting for you!
Contact us at gameskoco@gmail.com
Please leave great feedback - it helps us keep going!

三國殺10周年新作，熱血動作策略卡牌手遊《三國殺名將傳》來啦！經典三國武將任你自由搭配，酷炫合擊大招給你華麗視覺饗宴、輕策略戰鬥擺脫無聊枯燥、軍團BOSS廝殺帶來豐富社交，五年傳承 再續三國霸業！

 
 ◆經典三國武將 自由搭配上陣
不管是劉備、關羽、張飛，抑或是曹操、孫權、趙雲，經典的三國武將皆在你的手中，魏蜀吳群漢晉任你選，策略佈陣自由配，譜寫自己的三國霸業。

◆炫酷合擊熱血戰鬥 華麗視覺饗宴
炸裂逆天的合擊大招，華麗酷炫的技能特效，帶給你彭湃熱血的視覺饗宴，這樣打才夠殺！

 
◆玩法多樣輕策略 擺脫枯燥無聊
南蠻入侵，遊歷奇遇，過關斬將，割須棄袍⋯⋯ 豐富多樣的玩法，擺脫枯燥無聊，陣容搭配輕策略，戰鬥有趣又動腦，輕輕鬆鬆殺出重圍一統江山！

 
◆加入軍團打BOSS，熱血廝殺大亂鬥！
稱霸三國的路上絕不孤單，與盟友一起殺出重圍，成為最強軍團，橫掃千軍盪平亂世你我有責！

 ◆福利滿滿一直送 助你稱霸殺三國
每日登入領豪禮，不怕你拿完，就怕你不拿！橙將任選、橙裝任拿，福利滿滿稱霸三國指日可待。


【溫馨提示】 
■卓悅網路有限公司為本遊戲台灣代理商
■本遊戲內容涉及性、暴力、菸酒、遊戲角色穿著凸顯性特徵之服飾或裝扮但不涉及性暗示，依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔15級。
■本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。 
■長時間進行遊戲時，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷於遊戲。

bluejetty:00139999:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting math adventure with AdaptedMind, where learning becomes an immersive journey! Students in grades PreK and beyond can learn math with educational games. Engaging puzzles, and challenges that adapt to each child's learning pace help any child learn math. Whether you’re looking for overall math practice or help with math homework, AdaptedMind Math believes that every achievement unlocks new levels of excitement. 
Download today to learn math with educational games!
WHY CHOOSE ADAPTEDMIND'S MATH PROGRAM?
PRETEST ASSESSMENT: 
- Math support for 1st, 2nd, or 3rd grade math and beyond.
- Pretest evaluates your child’s math skills in order to create their customized learning plan. 
PERSONALIZED LEARNING: 
- Adaptive technology that crafts a unique learning path.
- The perfect opportunity for each child who needs math practice. 
- Learn math at your own pace with our learning plan and educational games.
FUN & ENGAGING MATH GAMES: 
- Math practice and interactive lessons for 1st, 2nd, or 3rd grade math. 
- Math concepts brought to life through educational games
LEARN MATH WITH INSTRUCTIONAL VIDEOS: 
- More than just educational games. 
- Access instructional videos led by experienced educators to help you with your math homework. 
- Visual explanations that enhance your understanding as you learn math.
PROGRESS TRACKING: 
- Monitor your child’s progress as they work through math homework and educational games. 
- Access detailed reports and analytics that keep you informed about their strengths and areas needing improvement. 
PROVEN RESULTS: 
Join the 95% of our members who experience increased confidence in their math skills thanks to our interactive math games. Whether your child is starting their math journey or mastering advanced concepts, we’re here to support them as they learn math.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Enjoy a 30-day free trial upon signup. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID after the trial period ends. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of Service: https://www.adaptedmind.com/info/legal
Privacy Policy: https://www.adaptedmind.com/info/privacy

TrulySmall Invoices is the fastest and simplest invoice maker for small business owners, freelancers, designers, contractors, and consultants to invoice clients in seconds. Start creating and sending professional invoices for free from anywhere in the world—from any mobile device. Easily manage your billing, invoicing, and finances on the go with our mobile app, and never miss an opportunity to get paid fast!
Include as much or as little detail by entering anything from payment information, due dates, logos, discounts, shipping details, sales tax, and more. Send your invoice as a PDF by email quickly and seamlessly from within the app. 
Features: 
* Create free invoices from anywhere—send them before you leave the customer
* Send an estimate with your project quote before your project starts
* Personalize with your company logo for a professional and branded invoice
* Save client contacts and tax settings for faster invoicing 
* Easily customize invoice fields: quantity, rate, shipping, sales tax, discounts, and more 
* Include payment terms: 15 days, 30 days, 60 days, etc.
* Discount a flat amount or percentage on your invoice subtotal 
* Charge Sales Tax on items or on subtotal
* Send PDF invoice by email 
* Select currency before sending 
* Record payment in one click
* Accept digital payments with our Stripe Integration 
* Automatically sync across all your devices—phone, tablet, and computer
* No setup or credit card required
Why small business owners love TrulySmall Invoices:
1. EASY AND QUICK TO USE
The simplest invoice maker for any type of small business owner
2. PROFESSIONAL AND CUSTOMIZABLE
Upload your logo and generate professional and branded invoices. 
3. INVOICE ANYWHERE
As long as you have a device with you, you can invoice your client. Automatically syncs across your phone, tablet, and computer. 
4. GET PAID QUICKER
Email your invoice immediately after you finish your job. 
5. INVOICE WITH CONFIDENCE
Expert-designed invoices that are professional, beautiful, and easy-to-use. 
6. MORE CONVENIENCE FOR YOUR CLIENTS
Your clients can pay via Apple Pay, credit card, Ali Pay, and more! Digital Payment acceptance is powered by Stripe.

Between Carpools delivers the content that’s relevant to your daily life as an Orthodox Jewish woman. Enjoy entertaining, inspiring, and useful content covering topics such as parenting, work/life balance, maintaining a household, fashion, beauty, entertaining, food & recipes, organizing, and Jewish topics. 
Between Carpools is also the first app that speaks to the sophistication of the Jewish woman, with a seamlessly designed experience, professional and creatively styled photography, videos, and personable content.
The Content That’s Tailor Made for You:
*Find invaluable information related to your mommy experience, no matter if you’re parenting a baby, kids, or teens.
*Receive tips on the easiest ways to keep your household in shape, from our favorite conveniences to organizing how-tos.

bluejetty:00033071:ios.description:
Snap Pro Camera is the most advanced photo and video app that transforms your iPhone into a powerful DSLR camera. With full manual controls, AI-powered features, instant color grading, and professional filters, Snap Pro Camera+ lets you capture stunning photos and cinematic videos effortlessly.
PRO CAMERA FEATURES
● Manual Controls: Adjust ISO, shutter speed, and white balance for perfect shots.
● RAW Mode: Capture in RAW to fine-tune every detail with professional editing.
● Advanced Effects: Enhance your photos with precise focus and white balance adjustments.
● Multiple Formats: Shoot in ProRAW, RAW, JPG, and TIFF for flexible editing options.
LONG EXPOSURE & SLOW SHUTTER
● Motion Blur: Capture motion blur for smooth, dreamy effects.
● Light Trails: Create stunning light streaks in nighttime photography.
● Low Light: Capture clear, vibrant photos in dim settings without unwanted grain.
INSTANT COLOR GRADING & FILTERS
● Pro Color Presets: Apply cinematic, film-like color to your photos and videos with one tap.
● Instant Grade: Use live LUTs and color grading during capture, no need for post-editing.
● Digital Filters: Enhance your photos with professional camera-style filters.
PRO VIDEO FEATURES
● Cinematic Stabilization: Record smooth, professional-quality videos with advanced stabilization.
● Instant Color Grading: Apply live cinematic color grades while recording.
● FPS Control: Adjust frame rates from 24, 30, and 60 fps and more.
PORTRAIT & BOKEH EFFECTS
● Depth Control: Achieve DSLR-like bokeh with automatic depth adjustments.
● Aperture Simulation: Get stunning background blur from F1.4 to F22.0.
● Automatic Bokeh: Add beautiful background blur to any portrait effortlessly.
CREATIVE TIMELAPSE MODES
● Timelapse: Capture dynamic sequences at intervals for stunning time-lapse videos.
● Zoom Timelapse: Add a zoom effect during your time-lapse to enhance the visual impact.
● Tilt-Shift: Create miniature world effects with tilt-shift photography.
PHOTO EDITOR
● Advanced Adjustments: Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and more.
● Preset Filters: Instantly apply professional-grade preset filters to your photos.
● Constant Updates: Regularly updated filters keep your edits fresh.
AI STUDIO – CREATE PRO & FUN HEADSHOTS
Snap Pro Camera's AI Studio enables you to create professional or fun headshots in just a few taps:
● Background Removal: Remove backgrounds from photos or product shots, or replace them with solid black or white backdrops.
● Background Replacement: Choose from preset backgrounds or upload your own image for a custom look.
● AI Bokeh Effect: Apply background blur even to non-portrait photos.
● Face Transformations: Create unique images with your face across hundreds of creative themes.
CAMERA+ FEATURES
● Auto & Manual Modes: Switch between auto and manual control for perfect shots.
● Focus Assist: Easily achieve sharp focus with focus peaking.
● Zebra Stripes: Identify overexposed areas for better exposure.
● Multiple Formats: Shoot in RAW, ProRAW, TIFF, JPG, and HEIF.
● White Balance: Manually adjust color accuracy for perfect lighting.
● Histogram: Monitor exposure with real-time feedback.

bluejetty:00151797:ios.description:
In this vibrant block-shooting puzzle game, a squad of fun monster shooters fires colorful blocks to create explosive chain reactions and clear tricky jammed boards.
Every tap launches a burst of color, smashing cubes with smooth effects, relaxing ASMR sounds, and satisfying pixel blasts. Use smart moves, trigger boosters, and enjoy big boom moments as you progress through creative, brain-teasing levels.
How to Play:
Tap to shoot matching color blocks and enjoy their explosive pixel art effects.
Clear all colorful blocks to finish each puzzle stage and unlock new, exciting challenges.
Use powerful boosters to trigger massive cube blasts across the board. Think carefully — every tap is a small brain exercise that sharpens focus and decision-making.
Key Features:
Play through hundreds of handcrafted block levels, each with vibrant designs and creative logic puzzles that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
Experience smooth block-shooting animations and eye-catching pixel effects that deliver a relaxing and satisfying blast experience.
Enjoy calming ASMR audio and soothing visuals that help melt away stress. It’s a true offline game, ready to play anytime and anywhere.

bluejetty:00016259:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”

bluejetty:00040929:ios.description:
Trustd Mobile Security Basic is FREE and includes:
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+ Link Checker: Use Safari + Trustd Mobile Security to protect against phishing attacks and scams. If you open a link from a message or email with Safari, Trustd Mobile Security will check the URL and block any malicious websites.
+ WiFi Scanner: Whenever you connect to a WiFi network, the Trustd Mobile Security app will scan it to see if anyone is snooping on your web browsing and stealing your private data.
+ Device Checker: To make sure you're always up to date, Trustd Mobile Security alerts you when there's a new version of iOS out, protecting you against device vulnerabilities.
Trustd Plus [By subscription]:
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
All of the above Basic protection, PLUS
+ Safe Browsing: Browse the web from any app or browser, and get instant alerts if you visit a spoof or malicious website that wants to steal your data or drop malware. Add websites to your safe list if you trust them. 
Why is Trustd Mobile Security different?
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+ All core features are free, with NO ads
+ Trustd Mobile Security can spot phishing threats before other security vendors know about them.
+ We don't track individual users and you don’t need an account.
+ Transparency and integrity is our battlecry! We’re committed to your privacy and security
Stay Safe with Trustd Mobile Security
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Privacy Policy
++++++++++
Trustd Mobile Security respects your privacy and promises to safeguard your personal data. For more information: https://traced.app/traced-privacy-policy/
Trustd Plus Subscription
+++++++++++++++++++
If you choose to purchase a Trustd Plus monthly subscription:
– Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account.
– Your subscription will automatically renew and your iTunes Account will be charged for the next period, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
– To turn off auto-renewal follow the guidance outlined in our auto-renew policy (https://traced.app/auto-renew-policy/).
- Trustd Terms and Conditions: https://traced.app/trustd-app-end-user-license-agreement-eula/

bluejetty:00056691:android.name: EA SPORTS™ NBA LIVE Mobile
bluejetty:00056691:android.summary: NBA Live Mobile, where the NBA is powered by you. Whether you want to pick up and play a quick basketball game or settle in for a long session of completing challenges and dominating the court, you’re in total control of your NBA Live Mobil
bluejetty:00056691:android.description:
NBA Live Mobile, where the NBA is powered by you. Whether you want to pick up and play a quick basketball game or settle in for a long session of completing challenges and dominating the court, you’re in total control of your NBA Live Mobile experience.
Dominate the court with a brand-new gameplay engine, stunning graphics, realistic basketball simulation gameplay, and the authenticity of live mobile NBA games right at your fingertips. Take on the NBA Tour and Limited-Time Live Events to polish your skills and earn new player items on your way to becoming the ultimate GM. Ready for a more competitive mode? Head to Rise to Fame, where you’ll take on harder and harder challenges and climb the leaderboards. And if you want to play with friends, unlock Leagues mode to create or join a League and take on special challenges.
EA SPORTS™ NBA LIVE Mobile Basketball Game Features:
Basketball Games Meet Authentic Sports Games Simulation
- Mobile basketball gaming at its finest with real chemistry and total control
- Live out your wildest basketball dreams. Create dream team combinations and pit your skills against top NBA basketball stars
Iconic NBA Players & Teams
- Draft over 30 of your favorite NBA teams like the New York Knicks or Dallas Mavericks
- Play as the Los Angeles Lakers, Miami Heat, Golden State Warriors and more
- Collect and play with over 230 of your favorite basketball stars
- Pick the reigning champion Oklahoma City Thunder for your team and compete for dominance!
Basketball Manager Gameplay
- Unlock and collect basketball stars with their unique attributes and skills
- Manage your dream team and upgrade them to their full potential
- Improve your OVR to unlock the Chemistry, Heat Up, and Captain abilities to boost your team’s performance and synergy
- Refine your team with Learn: The Fundamentals, have your players run drills, practice skills, and master plays
Competitive Sports Games & NBA Live Basketball Events
- Rise to Fame Tournaments - PvE matches where you earn points and promotions as you race to rank on the leaderboard
- 5v5 and 3v3 basketball scenarios have you mixing up your teams and playstyles to be victorious
Authenticity & On-Court Realism
- All-new gameplay engine: Smoother moves, sharper visuals, and higher framerates bring the NBA closer to real life.
- Real playcalling: Make strategic plays and get tactical with quick calls
- Real-time Total Control: Intuitive controls matched with seamless passing have you setting up offense and defenses like a pro
- NBA mobile experience: Play in iconic NBA arenas recreated for mobile
Authentic NBA Mobile Game Content & Non-stop Action
- Daily and weekly goals: Keep your basketball team ahead of the curve
- Leagues: Join and challenge events together with friends to unlock unique players and upgrades
- NBA Tour: Challenge yourself in a massive single-player experience with 40+ Campaigns, 300+ Stages, and over 2000+ events all themed to real NBA stories
Create your Legacy
- Take on the challenge of Rivals as you help top NBA basketball stars overcome their fiercest opponents
- If you can claim victory, unlock these basketball superstars and draft them for your own team to reach even higher heights
- Fan HYPE: Earn fans to unlock game modes and events in the game
Take to the court and dominate the hoops. Download EA SPORTS™ NBA LIVE Mobile now and get ready to shoot, dribble, and slam dunk your way to victory!
Requires acceptance of EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy and User Agreement. Requires an Internet connection (network fees may apply). Contains direct links to the Internet. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
User Agreement: terms.ea.com
Privacy and Cookie Policy: privacy.ea.com
Visit help.ea.com for assistance or inquiries.
EA may retire online features after 30 days’ notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.

SECURE & PRIVATE BACKUP

bluejetty:00144817:ios.description:
Automatically back up all your photos and videos to your Synology NAS. DSPhoto Backup is the complete solution to secure your memories on your DiskStation while managing and freeing up local storage.
SECURE & PRIVATE BACKUP
• End-to-end encryption for your credentials
• Your data never leaves your device
• No tracking, no ads, complete privacy guaranteed
• Works on local network & remotely via QuickConnect
• SSL/TLS encryption & 2FA authentication support
AUTOMATIC PHOTO & VIDEO BACKUP
• Smart background backup without user action
• Compatible with DSM 6.0 & DSM 7.0+
• All formats supported: HEIC, RAW, JPEG, MP4, MOV
• Preserves EXIF metadata & GPS location data
• Keeps original file names and capture dates
• Intelligent duplicate detection
• Advanced filtering by date, size, and album
• Detailed backup history with task tracking
BROWSE & MANAGE NAS FILES
• Navigate through your Synology DiskStation files
• Preview photos, videos, and documents directly
• Download files from your NAS to iPhone
• Upload any files from your device
• Multi-selection and batch operations
• Search and organize your NAS content
ON-DEVICE CLEANER
• Identify large photos and videos consuming space
• Detect and remove similar and duplicate photos
• Find screenshots and optimize library
• Clean contacts, events, and reminders
• Battery optimization tips and guides
• Free up iPhone storage after backup
• "Already backed up" section to free up space safely
EASY TO USE
• Quick setup in minutes — no technical knowledge required
• Monitor backups with iOS widgets & Live Activities
• Dark mode support for comfortable viewing
• Background notifications for status updates
• Intuitive interface for all features
FLEXIBLE CONNECTIVITY
• QuickConnect: connect from anywhere
• Direct IP/Host connection
• Custom DDNS support
• Automatic reconnection after network issues
Perfect alternative to Google Photos or iCloud if you own a Synology NAS or DiskStation. Keep full control of your photo library and manage your device storage efficiently.
Works seamlessly with DS File, DS Photo, and other Synology mobile apps.
Made by the Synology community for Synology users.
Need help? Any suggestion or feature request for the app? Email me at contact@dsphotobackup.app!
---
Some features require DSPhoto Backup Pro: monthly or yearly subscription, or lifetime purchase. Free trial available. Family Sharing included.
DSPhoto Backup is not affiliated with Synology Inc.
Terms: https://dsphotobackup.app/resources/terms.html

bluejetty:00100458:ios.description:
Transform your fitness journey with HealthMeter, a powerful fitness and nutrition platform designed to help you reach your health and wellness goals.
Track workouts, log meals, and visualize your progress with a suite of AI-powered tools. Whether you are looking to lose weight or build muscle, HealthMeter adapts to your unique metabolism and performance.
Download to start your 3-day free trial of this premium, ad-free experience.
THE BEST FITNESS & NUTRITION TOOLS
- AI Food Scanning: Snap a photo of your meal for an instant nutritional breakdown.
- AI Workout Plans: Get personalized programs tailored to your specific goals.
- Body Scanning: Track your physique and body composition progress with AI.
- 3D Nutrition Graphs: Visualize your macro and micronutrient data in rich detail.
- Unlimited Routines: Create, save, and manage as many custom workouts as you need.
- AI Voice logging
- AI Food scan
AN EMPOWERING, DATA-DRIVEN APPROACH
HealthMeter uses advanced algorithms to provide a personalized experience without the clutter of traditional apps. Every feature is designed to provide actionable insights, helping you stay consistent and motivated on your journey.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
- HealthMeter is a premium app that requires a subscription for access to its tools and features.
- We offer flexible Monthly and Yearly subscription options.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- A free trial is available for new users. After the trial period ends, the subscription will automatically renew unless canceled 
at least 24 hours before the end of the trial. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings at any time.
Medical Disclaimer: HealthMeter is not a medical app. Please consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new diet or exercise program.
Terms of Service: https://healthmeter.ca/terms
Privacy Policy: https://healthmeter.ca/privacy

bluejetty:00015402:ios.summary:

LetraKid is an educational game addressed to children (4-8 years old) that can help them to learn pre-cursive and print block handwriting correctly, while having fun when doing so!
WHAT KIDS C
bluejetty:00015402:ios.description:
***** 5/5 stars EducationalAppStore.com *****
LetraKid is an educational game addressed to children (4-8 years old) that can help them to learn pre-cursive and print block handwriting correctly, while having fun when doing so!
WHAT KIDS CAN LEARN FROM THIS GAME
• Recognize letter shapes and perfect alphabet pronunciation
• The correct letter formation: start, checkpoints, strokes direction, order etc. Difficulty Levels 1 and 2 with assisted writing are designed to focus on the letter formation.
• Develop fine motor skills for handwriting activity. Difficulty Levels 3 to 5 with freehand writing activities will focus on this improvement to help maximize confidence and form when writing.
• Playing with a stylus pen will also help to improve standard pencil grasp. Any stylus compatible with the device will work.
MAIN FEATURES
• 16 languages with full support for interface, human native voices for letter/numbers pronunciation and full official alphabets. (ENGLISH, ESPAÑOL, FRANÇAIS, DEUTSCH, ITALIANO, PORTUGUÊS, NEDERLANDS, SVENSKA, NORSK, DANSK, SUOMI, ROMÂNĂ, JĘZYK POLSKI, TÜRKÇE, BAHASA INDONESIA and BAHASA MELAYU)
• 3 popular letter formation rules that will provide flexibility for picking the right stroke order and direction for the child. Vital for improving grasp on key terms and rulings within handwriting.
• Makes use of the 10 most used fonts in classes all over the world for learning pre cursive and print block handwriting: ZB style, HWT style, DN style, German(Hamburg) style and Euro Latino.
• Full support for both Left and Right handwriting rules.
• 5 difficulty levels with AUTO and LOCK settings, ranging from assisted writing for beginners, up to real freehand writing with minimal support and strict evaluation.
• 4 set of glyphs: ABC (full alphabet for upper case letters), abc (full alphabet for lower case letters), 123 (numbers from 0 to 9) and a special set of signs for funny exercises.
• 5 progression levels, color coded for each glyph that allows parents and teachers an instant evaluation of the progression and most exercised letters at the alphabet level.
• 16 funny sticker rewards that will unlock after progression milestones are reached. Also, their drawing rules after each completed progression at Alphabet/glyph list level.
• 3 profile slots with 50 funny avatars and name customization that will save independently the settings and the progression.
• Full support for both Landscape and Portrait orientations.
GREAT IN THE CLASSROOM!
With a unique and real-time feedback feature as well as complex tracing evaluation algorithms, LetraKid is not just another tracing app.
This is a new approach, focused on creating a fun game by utilizing handwriting mechanics itself. This avoids using distracting random rewards or secondary game mechanics that can break and confuse the learning process, optimizing learning progress and educational appeal to children.
The real time feedback will give both audio and graphic clues about the quality of the tracing and will adjust with difficulty level.
Our tracing evaluation algorithms allow for an accurate and fun reward, using a 5 star rating for each exercise. This engages and motivates the kids to progress and to strive for more.
DESIGNED for KIDS
• No ads or irritating pop-ups.
• No collection of personal data
• Game settings are by default behind a parental gate. This can be disabled, but ensures a child to work with a certain font, formation rule, difficulty level and various other features for total specification to their needs.
• External links are protected by a permanent parental gate and includes upgrade to full version, feedback and social media usage to help follow the latest news and changes with regards to the platform.
Got any ideas for improving LetraKid? Then please send us your feedback and requests.

bluejetty:00090409:ios.description:
Master of Clues: Mystery Files – Step Into the Mind of a Detective and Uncover the Truth
Welcome to Master of Clues: Mystery Files, the ultimate mystery-solving experience where your logic, intuition, and keen eye for detail will determine the outcome of complex cases. Each crime scene holds hidden truths, and it’s up to you to uncover them. Analyze clues, question suspects, and piece together intricate puzzles to expose criminals, protect the innocent, and reveal shocking betrayals.
This immersive game combines brain teasers, detective challenges, and engaging storylines to create a compelling experience for mystery lovers and puzzle enthusiasts. If you enjoy crime-solving adventures, logic-based games, or investigative storytelling, Master of Clues: Mystery Files will put your skills to the test.
Key Features:
Engaging Crime-Solving Puzzles
Every case presents a unique set of clues that require critical thinking and sharp deduction. Examine evidence, read between the lines, and connect the dots to uncover the real culprit. Will you make the right call, or will a clever suspect slip away?
Complex Mysteries with Twists and Turns
Each case goes beyond the surface, revealing deeper layers of secrets, deception, and intrigue. From hidden motives to unexpected betrayals, every mystery keeps you on edge.
Betrayal, Loyalty, and Emotional Dilemmas
Not every mystery is just about crime—some are personal. Family bonds, friendships, and romantic relationships are tangled with lies and secrets. Can you tell who is truly trustworthy?
Diverse Puzzle Challenges
The game offers a variety of challenges, from cryptic crosswords and brain teasers to logic puzzles and IQ tests. Every level pushes your problem-solving skills further, ensuring an engaging experience for those who love a good mental challenge.
Realistic Investigation Mechanics
Pick up on subtle details in conversations, body language, and written clues. Scrutinize inconsistencies, analyze motives, and use your instincts to crack the case. Your choices shape the investigation’s outcome.
Challenging Ethical Decisions
Some cases require more than just logic—they require moral judgment. Will you expose a painful truth that could ruin a family? Will you let a suspect go based on a gut feeling? Every decision carries weight, influencing the story’s progression.
Immersive Storylines with Rich Characters
Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own secrets and motivations. Unravel their hidden agendas and uncover surprising connections between them. The deeper you dig, the more the truth reveals itself.
Strategic Clue-Gathering System
Every detail matters. Read between the lines, take note of contradictions, and carefully piece together information. Whether it’s a misplaced item, a suspicious alibi, or an overlooked document, the right clue can crack the case wide open.
An Ever-Evolving Challenge
With cases that increase in complexity, each level offers new twists and deeper mysteries. As you progress, you’ll need sharper reasoning and a greater ability to filter truth from deception.
For True Crime and Puzzle Fans
If you enjoy detective novels, murder mysteries, and escape room-style challenges, this game offers a thrilling and intellectually stimulating experience. Whether you love classic whodunits or modern crime investigations, Master of Clues: Mystery Files is designed to challenge and entertain.
Are You Ready to Become the Ultimate Detective?
The world of crime is full of hidden stories, secret betrayals, and unexpected twists. Only those with the sharpest minds can uncover the truth. Will you prove yourself as a master detective, or will the clues lead you astray?
Download Master of Clues: Mystery Files now and start your journey into the world of crime-solving, logic puzzles, and thrilling mysteries.

Betrayal, Loyalty, and Emotional Dilemmas
Not every mystery is just about crime—some are personal. Family bonds, friendships, and romantic relationships are tangled with lies and secrets. Can you tell who is truly trustworthy?

Diverse Puzzle Challenges
The game offers a variety of challenges, from cryptic crosswords and brain teasers to logic puzzles and IQ tests. Every level pushes your problem-solving skills further, ensuring an engaging experience for those who love a good mental challenge.

Realistic Investigation Mechanics
Pick up on subtle details in conversations, body language, and written clues. Scrutinize inconsistencies, analyze motives, and use your instincts to crack the case. Your choices shape the investigation’s outcome.

Challenging Ethical Decisions
Some cases require more than just logic—they require moral judgment. Will you expose a painful truth that could ruin a family? Will you let a suspect go based on a gut feeling? Every decision carries weight, influencing the story’s progression.

Immersive Storylines with Rich Characters
Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with their own secrets and motivations. Unravel their hidden agendas and uncover surprising connections between them. The deeper you dig, the more the truth reveals itself.

Strategic Clue-Gathering System
Every detail matters. Read between the lines, take note of contradictions, and carefully piece together information. Whether it’s a misplaced item, a suspicious alibi, or an overlooked document, the right clue can crack the case wide open.

An Ever-Evolving Challenge
With cases that increase in complexity, each level offers new twists and deeper mysteries. As you progress, you’ll need sharper reasoning and a greater ability to filter truth from deception.

For True Crime and Puzzle Fans
If you enjoy detective novels, murder mysteries, and escape room-style challenges, this game offers a thrilling and intellectually stimulating experience. Whether you love classic whodunits or modern crime investigations, Master of Clues: Mystery Files is designed to challenge and entertain.

Are You Ready to Become the Ultimate Detective?
The world of crime is full of hidden stories, secret betrayals, and unexpected twists. Only those with the sharpest minds can uncover the truth. Will you prove yourself as a master detective, or will the clues lead you astray?

Download Master of Clues: Mystery Files now and start your journey into the world of crime-solving, logic puzzles, and thrilling mysteries.

bluejetty:00124293:ios.name: Tap Tap Trillionaire : Money!
bluejetty:00124293:ios.summary: Ever dreamed of being your own boss and becoming filthy rich? Now you can live the luxury 8-bit life you’ve always wanted! Crush your competition, become a Door Street tycoon and tap your way to mega riches on Tap Tap Trillionaire – the fas
bluejetty:00124293:ios.description:
Ever dreamed of being your own boss and becoming filthy rich? Now you can live the luxury 8-bit life you’ve always wanted! Crush your competition, become a Door Street tycoon and tap your way to mega riches on Tap Tap Trillionaire – the fast paced business simulator! 
Starting out with nothing but your furiously fast fingers and a capitalist state of mind, your trillionaire journey begins with a simple tap. Earn coins by tapping and start expanding your business by hiring new traders, decorating your office, trading the markets and making smart investments. 
Build a team of ruthless traders
Using the profits from your business, you’ll be able to hire traders to support your venture. Not all traders are created equal, though!
From one star intern Dexter to five star, legendary trader Indiana Ford, better traders will generate more money and have a higher success rate with their investments! Upgrade your traders to boost their success rate, increase the money they make and – that’s it. 
Buy low. Sell high. Get rich! 
There are many ways to tap your way to a trillion dollars and become a tycoon! Your team of Door Street traders will give you investment opportunities you can accept or decline. Depending on their success rate, you could win or lose. We probably wouldn’t trust Dexter with large investments, by the way. 
While your team works to make you filthy rich, you can use your money to trade stocks, artifacts and bonds. Take a look at market trends and invest wisely to make huge profits. With over 45 different assets to invest in, you’ll have hours of fun mastering the markets in this insanely fun business simulator! 
Expand your office. Move to a castle. Do whatever you want – you’re rich! 
Plain office? Boring! Upgrade the furnishings and decorate your office with your hard tapped coins. Add comfy chairs, buy state of the art computers and decorate your office for the holiday season! When you become so rich that a simple office simply won’t do, you can expand to house a larger team – and even move to a castle!
That’s right, a castle! 
--------------------------------
In Tap Tap Trillionaire you can…
--------------------------------
• Start a company from nothing and grow it into a multi trillion dollar business
• Collect, hire and upgrade traders
• … Or fire them!
• Make huge profits by trading over 45 assets
• … Or have your employees invest for you!
• Decorate your office with a huge range of cool stuff
• Expand your office or move to a ridiculously cool castle
• Purchase upgrades to increase business profits and attract investors
• Accumulate riches and make trillions of coins. Sweet, gold coins.
-------------------------------
Tap Tap Trillionaire – In The Press
-------------------------------
• Featured in US, UK, and 126 other countries on the top App Store's Best New Games!
• Touch Arcade: “It's like kairosoft graphics meets Bitcoin billionaire. With a stock trading aspect for extra money.”
Tap Tap Trillionaire is an excessively fun, strangely addictive business simulator game for the passionate capitalist. If you’re a fan of getting rich – and let’s face it, who isn’t? – then you’ll love this game! 
Pssst… Here’s a little tip for reading all the way to the end. You can tap much faster if you use more fingers. Happy tapping! 
THE JOURNEY TO RICHES STARTS WITH A SINGLE TAP – BECOME A TRILLIONAIRE TYCOON TODAY!

Screen time is taking over your day.

minimalist phone is a screen time control app built to help you stop doomscrolling, block distractions, and boost productivity.
Create a calmer, more focused phone experience with tools that help you:
- Block time-wasting apps
- Reduce screen time
- Get gentle in-app reminders
- Manage your time before mindless scrolling takes over your day
▶ FEATURES
- TEXT-BASED INTERFACE
Replace your icon-filled home screen with a clean, text-based layout—no visual clutter, no dopamine triggers. Organize apps using widgets.
- APP BLOCKER
Block apps that don’t just steal from your time but also your focus and goals.
- WEBSITE BLOCKER
Block websites alongside distracting apps to create a more productive routine.
- IN-APP REMINDERS
Set a time limit each time you open an app and get pushed out when your time is up. Turn it on for games, social media, or any app
…this automatically filters notifications that trigger addictive habits.
- MINDFUL LAUNCH DELAY
a 15 second pause—just enough to help you breathe and decide mindfully whether you want to open an app. 
- BLOCKING SCHEDULES
Coming soon.

- Join 10M+ satisfied users
- 83% of users reported less screen time
- Save 2+ hours daily

Research links excessive screen time, social media, and gaming with:
- Poorer sleep
- Lower focus
- Increased anxiety or distress
The real issue isn’t just phone use — it’s when your phone starts controlling your time, attention, and rest.
We’re not here to disconnect you from your phone. We’re here to help make it a tool that works in your favor again.
▶ WHY MINIMALIST PHONE
Most screen time apps focus on timers or usage limits.
minimalist phone goes deeper — tackling the psychological hooks of modern tech through a calmer, more intentional phone experience.
We believe in change that is holistic, long-term, and sustainable. And honestly, deleting Instagram for one month does not cut it.

- Sleep better
- Improve focus
- Control screen time
- Organize your time routine
- Track digital habits
- Schedule screen-free hours

Find more information about in-app purchases inside the app.

Screen time is taking over your day.
Here’s how minimalist phone helps you take it back 

minimalist phone is a screen time control app built to help you stop doomscrolling, block distractions, and boost productivity.

- Block time-wasting apps
- Reduce screen time
- Get gentle in-app reminders
- Manage your time before mindless scrolling takes over your day

▶ FEATURES

- TEXT-BASED INTERFACE
Replace your icon-filled home screen with a clean, text-based layout—no visual clutter, no dopamine triggers. Organize apps using widgets.

- APP BLOCKER
Block apps that don’t just steal from your time but also your focus and goals.

- WEBSITE BLOCKER
Block websites alongside distracting apps to create a more productive routine.

- IN-APP REMINDERS
Set a time limit each time you open an app and get pushed out when your time is up. Turn it on for games, social media, or any app
…this automatically filters notifications that trigger addictive habits.

- MINDFUL LAUNCH DELAY
a 15 second pause—just enough to help you breathe and decide mindfully whether you want to open an app. 

- BLOCKING SCHEDULES
Coming soon.

▶ TRUSTED BY MILLIONS

- Join 10M+ satisfied users
- 83% of users reported less screen time
- Save 2+ hours daily

Whether you want to boost focus for work and studying, or unplug to create mental space when it matters, minimalist phone helps you track and reduce the time you spend on your phone.

▶ IMPACT OF HIGH SCREEN TIME

Research links excessive screen time, social media, and gaming with:
- Poorer sleep
- Lower focus
- Increased anxiety or distress

The real issue isn’t just phone use — it’s when your phone starts controlling your time, attention, and rest.
We’re not here to disconnect you from your phone. We’re here to help make it a tool that works in your favor again.

▶ WHY MINIMALIST PHONE

Most screen time apps focus on timers or usage limits.
minimalist phone goes deeper — tackling the psychological hooks of modern tech through a calmer, more intentional phone experience.
We believe in change that is holistic, long-term, and sustainable. And honestly, deleting Instagram for one month does not cut it.

▶ IMPROVE YOUR DAILY LIFE WITH MINIMALIST PHONE

- Sleep better
- Improve focus
- Control screen time
- Organize your time routine

- Schedule screen-free hours

- Task management

Download minimalist phone for free on iPhone and start with a 7-day free trial.

- Monthly

Find more information about in-app purchases inside the app.

▶ CONTACT AND SUPPORT
