bluejetty:00062139:ios.description:
*** Connect the Dots - with Dino and Friends ***
Connect the dots is Tiltan Games newest game for kids and toddlers in the loved Dinosaurs theme!
Play 144 different scenes in 3 difficulty levels
More than 90 unique images to discover
Your kids will just love these wonderfully drawn pictures and will improve their skills while having fun! 
Our educational games are specifically tailored to fit preschool-aged kids, and encourage them to learn from each activity. We specialize in fun educational games.
Aimed for kids in the ages 1-6
*** What's in the game? ***
* 144 connect the dot scenes, from 4 dots for the first one up to 35 dots
* Over 90 unique pictures to discover
* 3 Difficulty levels - Each containing 48 scenes. 
 Easy - Connect 4-10 Dots 
 Medium - Connect 11-20 Dots 
 Hard - Connect 21-35 Dots
*** What's New ***
* 20 Downloadable Puzzle Packs, over 1000 predefined puzzles.
* Variable puzzle size starting from 2 pieces up to 30 pieces for preschool kids and first graders!
* Play a new daily puzzle each day in 4 play variants - jigsaw puzzle, swipe puzzle, scratch card and color scratch
* Paint your own puzzles - paint by hand or import your pictures to create infinite new puzzles! 
* New Stories section - Dozen first stories
* Create your own stories activity! 
* Dozens of games and learning activities including:
 +Learning numbers, 
 + Counting, 
 + Addition, 
 + Subtraction, 
 + Shapes, 
 + Colors, 
 + Order by size,
 + Order Numbers, 
 + Number line, 
 + Patterns, 
 + Tell Time, 
 + Matrix matching, 
 + More & Less, 
 + Great & Small, 
 + Big & Small, 
 + Long & Short, 
 + Tall & Short.
 + Bubbles shoot, 
 + Match, 
 + Memory, 
 + Domino, 
 + Maze, 
 + Cookies, 
 + Whack a bunny, 
 + Connect the Dots, 
 + Raining shapes
 + Animals Flow (New - 5 animal packs. 5x5-10x10 boards. 600 levels!)
 + Balloon Pop (New - learn colors, shapes, numbers and english ABC)
 + Animal Flow (New)
 + Letter Tracing (New)
+ The game Does Not contain ads nor social links.
+ The game contains In App Purchases to unlock the base pack or subscribe to Tiltan Games entire educational library. 
+ The first 4 levels are open for free. You can unlock the rest from the parents section.
Important things to know about the subscription:
• Subscription can be canceled anytime 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the app purchase.
• Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period at the subscribed price
• You can manage your subscriptions from your account on the AppStore 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
LEAVE US A REVIEW!
If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.

bluejetty:00123078:ios.description:
Master your poker journey.
Track your poker life with the most intuitive tracking app and identify your most profitable games to build lasting success. 
Trusted by thousands of winning players worldwide, Poker Analytics delivers the most comprehensive tracking capabilities in the industry.
From bankroll management to advanced performance metrics, every feature is designed to transform your data into profitable decisions.
* Statistics:
Track all the essential numbers that matter to your game. Monitor your exact profits, hourly rate, BB/100...Access a comprehensive range of metrics to help you understand and improve your performance.
* Automatic reports:
Poker Analytics notifies you each time your overperform in a game area, helping you choose the most profitable games you can for long-term performance.
* Bets, casino, investments:
Track your casino sessions, bets and investments directly into the app with the same amazing capabilities than our renowned poker tools.
* Hands recording:
Record all your hands for later review with the super fast hand recorder. Share your hand histories to discuss your moves and improve.
* Cash game stop notifications:
Based on your game history, the app notifies you when you’re getting tired and tells you to stop! The app keeps you fresh and away from tilt for the long run.
* Staking
Manage your tournament staking, sell action on individual tournaments or packages in just a few taps. Staking made super easy.
* Bankroll management:
Precisely track all your expenses, bonuses and tips, or create your own types of transaction to match your own needs. Define bankrolls with specific currencies and rates for your sessions abroad. Discover what’s your risk of ruin and never get broke again!

Track what matters to you beyond the standard metrics. Add custom fields like mental state to your sessions, and get detailed stats and visualizations for any parameter you choose.
* There is more:
- Poker Analytics has great performance and won’t let you down when you’ll have lots of data.

bluejetty:00115595:ios.description:
PlantMelo – Smarter Plant Care, Happier Plants
Whether you're a passionate plant parent or just starting your green journey, PlantMelo is the all-in-one app designed to help your plants flourish. With intelligent tools, personalized care tips, and even music for your plants, PlantMelo turns plant care into a joyful and effortless experience.
Smarter Features to Help Your Plants Thrive
Plant Recognition Made Simple
 Take a photo and instantly identify any plant — from houseplants and flowers to shrubs and rare species. Learn its name, origin, growth habits, and detailed care instructions, so you always know how to give it the attention it needs.
Plant Health Diagnosis
 Noticing yellow leaves, spots, or drooping stems? Use PlantMelo’s AI-powered diagnosis to detect issues such as pests, diseases, or stress factors. Get clear guidance and expert tips to restore your plant’s health quickly.
Music for Plants
 Yes, your plants can enjoy music too. Play scientifically curated sounds and melodies that encourage growth and vitality. Create a soothing atmosphere not just for your plants, but for your own home environment as well.
Personal Plant Journal
 Track every stage of your plant’s journey with photos, notes, and milestones. Keep a history of its progress and celebrate every new leaf, bloom, or growth spurt.
Smart Care Reminders
 Never forget to water, fertilize, or prune again. Set customized reminders so each plant receives the care it needs at the right time.
Weather-Based Plant Tips
 Get plant care suggestions that adapt to the local weather. Whether it’s hot, rainy, or dry, PlantMelo helps you adjust your routine to protect your plants.
Why Choose PlantMelo?
 All-in-one plant care assistant in your pocket
 Expert-level guidance made easy for beginners
 Unique plant music feature to boost growth
 Keep your plants healthy, organized, and thriving
 A greener home and a more enjoyable plant-care journey
With PlantMelo, caring for your plants is no longer guesswork — it’s a rewarding experience. Build your own thriving indoor jungle or garden with confidence.
Subscription & Terms
Unlock unlimited access with:
 • Weekly Subscription
 • Yearly Subscription
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
By using this app, you agree to our terms:
 Privacy Policy: https://www.plantmelo.com/PrivacyPolicy.htm
 Terms of Use: https://www.plantmelo.com/TermsofUse.htm

bluejetty:00022013:ios.name: PVP IV
bluejetty:00022013:ios.summary:
PVP IV is the must-have companion app for Pokemon Go PVP battles, created and tested by Rank 24 players. Use it on your own climb to Rank 24 in the Go Battle League!
- An IV Analyzer to find the best IVs for each Pokemon/league
- Pokemon r
bluejetty:00022013:ios.description:
PVP IV is the must-have companion app for Pokemon Go PVP battles, created and tested by Rank 24 players. Use it on your own climb to Rank 24 in the Go Battle League!
- An IV Analyzer to find the best IVs for each Pokemon/league
- Pokemon rankings to help you pick the strongest Pokemon in each league
- A battle simulator to learn how to play each matchup
- A team builder to help you build the best team
- Customizable metas for advanced analysis
--- BATTLE SIMULATOR ---
Simulate a 1 vs 1 battle between any two Pokemon! Unlike other simulators, this app:
- Shows multiple possible outcomes to account for baits, random effects of moves, and CMP ties
- Has the smartest move selection algorithm, always picking the moves that do the most damage against the current opponent
- Has a charge move timing algorithm to show how to avoid giving your opponent free fast moves by using charged moves at the end of their fast move
- Shows how many turns of lag it would take to change the outcome of the match
- Shows how many times a Pokemon can safely bait without risking a loss
- Works offline
--- RANKINGS ---
View rankings for Great League, Ultra League, Master League, and some cups for the current Go Battle League season! Tap on a ranked Pokemon to see its matchups in even shielding scenarios against all other ranked Pokemon!
Unlike other rankings, these rankings treat each moveset for each Pokemon separately, rather than combining all possible movesets into one ranking. The movesets and Pokemon ranked are hand-picked by Rank 24 players!
These rankings are generated based on an advanced algorithm that incorporates battles from the 1 vs 1 battle simulator. The algorithm is described in detail at pvpiv.com.
--- IV RANKER ---
Enter your Pokemon's name and IVs to see how strong it is compared to other Pokemon of the same species in Great League, Ultra League, Master League, or any other format you want!
This app offers many advantages over other IV analyzers:
- See how many matchups are different between your IVs and the Rank 1 IVs.
- Fastest option available because it does all computation on-device; no need to wait for results, press go to refresh, or even be online!
- Save favorites for easy access later.
- Direct link to simulate a battle with the Pokemon and see how it matches up against the meta.
- Shows CP for pre-evolutions to make sure you're under the cap before you evolve.
- Fully customizable CP cap, level cap, and IV floor for all formats you play in, including level 41/51 for Best Buddy Pokemon.
- Advanced settings to only rank Pokemon that meet a specific break point, and/or rank by CP, Level, etc. (instead of stat product).
- Shows all possible IV combinations instead of just the top ones.
--- TEAM BUILDER ---
PVP IV's team builder lets you enter up to 3 Pokemon, then see which opponents are the most threatening, and which are least threatening. It also suggests alternative Pokemon you can use instead!
Unlike other team builders, it will show the impact each alternative will have on your team's score and recommend the Pokemon to replace in order to improve the team's score the most.
--- CUSTOM METAS ---
Custom metas allow you to change which Pokemon and opponents are used when computing rankings and building teams. You can record which Pokemon you see in your battles to automatically generate rankings of which of your Pokemon or teams are strongest against them!
--- COMPARISON BATTLES/PVP IV PRO ---
PVP IV Pro is a subscription service that removes ads, unlocks comparison battles, and allows you to have more than one custom meta at a time. These battles allow you to see all matchups that are different between two Pokemon. For example, you can see which matchups you win/lose by giving Play Rough to Azumarill instead of Ice Beam. Or, see which matchups are different between your IVs and the Rank 1 IVs.

bluejetty:00096195:ios.description:
Meet Stylio — your AI-powered stylist that provides thoughtful, personalized fashion guidance every day, helping you look polished with ease.
Whether you're returning to work, starting a new chapter, or simply want to refresh your wardrobe, Stylio helps you dress with confidence — without spending hours or hiring a consultant.
Daily Outfit Formulas
Receive 3 fresh outfits every day, created using proven outfit formulas. Stylio selects looks for different occasions — from work to casual to evening — and adds shopping suggestions to help you bring each outfit to life. 
Try On Me
Take personalization even further. Upload your full-body photo and instantly visualize how any outfit formula looks on your own silhouette — not on a model, but on you. See how proportions, layering, and styling combinations come together before you shop or get dressed — and choose your next look with total confidence.
Saved Outfits
Keep your favorite looks in one place and return to them anytime — build your personal style library and never lose the outfits that inspire you.
Smart Shopping Lists
Every outfit comes with a curated shopping list showing you exactly which pieces to look for — from tops and bottoms to shoes and accessories. Say goodbye to endless browsing and impulse purchases — Stylio makes shopping faster, smarter, and stress-free.
Body Type Analysis
Stylio’s AI-powered Body Type Scanner helps you define your unique silhouette with just one full-body photo. The app then provides:
- Detailed style tips: discover which cuts, fabrics, and necklines flatter your figure.
- Do’s & Don’ts: understand what to avoid and what to embrace for the best fit.
- Lookalike inspirations: explore outfit ideas from women with a similar body type.
This way, Stylio works not only as your AI stylist, but also as a smart closet organizer that makes every clothing choice easier.
Color Type Analysis
Unlock your personal color palette and style guidance with AI-powered Color Type Analysis. Stylio identifies your season through face and color analysis, instantly revealing your best colors with our smart color identifier and color palette generator. You’ll also receive tailored recommendations for makeup shades, accessories, and full color palettes to highlight your natural beauty every day.
Stylio is not just about clothes — it’s about how you feel in them.
By blending AI intelligence with real fashion logic, Stylio becomes more than just another fashion app: it’s your personal path to effortless style, smarter shopping, and everyday confidence. Think of it as a stylist in your pocket — professional, practical, and always on your side.

- Weekly with a 3-day free trial at $ 9.99; yearly at $ 59.99;

- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00131366:ios.description:
CVS photo printing with Genuine Kodak Moments paper! Print to CVS Pharmacy or order photo prints & gifts home delivered.
Send photos to print at any CVS location or for home delivery:
1 Select pictures from your phone 
2 Choose print sizes 
3 Order photo prints at CVS or home delivered.
High quality photo prints ready for 1 hour pick up or delivered to your door. 
Make Lasting Memories with CVS Photo Prints & Photo Gifts: 
Use Photo Prints Now to print your memories at CVS locations. Transform treasured moments into wall decorations with large print sizes. Print photos and pick up in 1 hour at your nearest CVS store. Print Instagram, Facebook, Flickr, Dropbox & Print Google+ pictures.
Order Prints Home Delivered:
Enjoy fast delivery of photo prints & photo gifts. Order photo prints home delivered from your phone. Get your photos delivered to your home with speedy shipping. Surprise someone you love with photo gifts and prints ordered from your phone! 
The Best CVS Photo Printing App: 
Faster than kiosks and simple to use. We use high quality Kodak paper to make a lasting archive of your life’s memories. Perfect for scrapbooking or to make a greeting card extra special. Transform your memories into the perfect printed photo masterpieces.
CVS Photo Print Sizes: 
• 4x6” Photo Prints 
• 5x7” Photo Prints 
• 8x10” Photo Prints
• 6x6” and 8x8” Square Instagram Prints 
• Canvas Prints
• Print Panels • Poster Prints
• Magnets
• Wallet Prints
• Panoramic Prints
• Bamboo Ornaments
• Photo Cards 
Print Pictures at CVS:
Trust your memories to the best photo paper, genuine Kodak moments photo paper at your favorite local CVS. After selecting your favorite memories for printing, select your size and quantity and then, simply send them to CVS to print within one hour. Use our CVS store locator to easily find your nearest CVS store. 
No subscriptions or other gimmicks. Get your phone’s pictures into print quickly and easily. 
Order photo gifts:
Surprise someone you love with photo gifts and photo products home delivered or at CVS. 
Print Panels: Print panel sizes range from 4x6 to 8x10. Options include acrylic, bamboo and wood print panels.
Photo Magnets: Add fun to any fridge with photo magnets. Create 4x6 and 5x5 magnets.
Photo Posters: Large format poster prints and photo posters are perfect college room decor or business signage. Print your design or photo on a poster. 
Wallet Prints: Create wallet prints easily. Wallet prints are perfect at gift giving time. 
Panoramic prints: Choose panoramic print for an extra long photo print.
Bamboo Ornaments: Fun sized bamboo ornaments are ready same day at CVS.
Photo Cards: Add your photo to a card design. Ideal for Christmas, Birthdays, Invitations and Save the Date. Photo cards are ready same day at CVS.
Canvas Prints: Decorate your living area with personalized canvas wall art. Print your photo on a canvas. Create canvas prints as large as 20x24 or 24x36.
Home Décor, Wall Art and Designer Prints:
Make a statement in home with wall art and designer prints. Select a design and leave the rest to us. Pick up at CVS Pharmacy. Designer prints and wall art are available on posters, print panels and canvas prints. 
Application partnership with CVS:
By partnering with CVS we’ve made it possible to print photos at CSV without using Kodak photo kiosk. Over 9600 CVS stores are available nationwide to print 4x6, 4x4, 6x6, 8x8 & 8x10 prints in 1 hour. Displaying pictures on your wall or sharing pictures with your family could never be easier.
If you have questions about Photo Prints Now or CVS photo we’d love to hear from you: support@photoprintsnow.com

bluejetty:00019508:ios.description:
This time the mystic mask and your passion for adventure led you into a new kind of maze. 
Moving from wall to wall, you need to paint over every corner of the labyrinth to make your way to the next one. But beware: some of them are not as safe as they seem to be...
We Love You! Enjoy!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription options
In our game we have the following subscription length:
1. Weekly Premium for $7.99 offers a weekly subscription after a 3-day free trial. The subscription includes 15 unique masks, 5 revives + 2 level skips on a daily basis and non-optional ads removal.
2. Monthly Premium for $19.99 offers a monthly subscription. The subscription includes 15 unique masks, 5 revives + 2 level skips on a daily basis and non-optional ads removal.
3. Yearly Premium for $99.99 offers a yearly subscription. The subscription includes 15 unique masks, 5 revives + 2 level skips on a daily basis and non-optional ads removal.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use sticker packs marked as Premium.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at support@newplg.dev
Privacy Policy: https://newplg.dev/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://newplg.dev/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00184422:ios.name: 20 Minuten - Nachrichten
bluejetty:00184422:ios.summary: Die 20 Minuten App ist dein täglicher Begleiter für aktuelle News, spannende Storys und ein kompaktes Update zu allen wichtigen Themen aus der Schweiz und der Welt. Ob News Schweiz, Schlagzeilen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Kultur –
bluejetty:00184422:ios.description:
Die 20 Minuten App ist dein täglicher Begleiter für aktuelle News, spannende Storys und ein kompaktes Update zu allen wichtigen Themen aus der Schweiz und der Welt. Ob News Schweiz, Schlagzeilen aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport oder Kultur – hier findest du alles in Echtzeit. Neutral berichtet und von Menschen verfasst, die alle Informationen doppelt und dreifach prüfen, damit sie wirklich vertrauenswürdig sind. 
So bleibst du immer informiert über die News von heute, Good News, erhältst zuverlässige Infos zum Wetter und entdeckst Hintergrundberichte, die dich durch den Tag begleiten.
 News, Unterhaltung, Inspiration:
Unser Ziel ist es, Nachrichten jederzeit schnell, verständlich und unabhängig verfügbar zu machen. Mit nur einem Klick bleibst du auf dem Laufenden – egal, ob morgens auf dem Weg zur Arbeit, während einer kurzen Pause oder abends gemütlich auf dem Sofa.
Die App liefert dir ausserdem regionale Informationen, Verkehrsupdates und natürlich den täglichen Wetterbericht, ideal für die Planung deines Tages. Auch Push-Nachrichten für Breaking News gehören dazu, sodass du keine wichtige Entwicklung verpasst.
Damit bietet die 20 Minuten App dir den schnellsten Zugang zu Nachrichten, ohne umständlich suchen zu müssen. Einfach App öffnen – und schon hast du alle relevanten News von heute auf einen Blick.
Warum die 20 Minuten App downloaden?
Es gibt viele News-Apps – doch die 20 Minuten App ist speziell auf die Anforderungen von Leserinnen und Lesern in der Schweiz zugeschnitten:
- Schnelle Updates: Erhalte Breaking News Schweiz und internationale Topstorys direkt aufs Handy.
- Alles an einem Ort: Politik, Wirtschaft, Lifestyle, Unterhaltung, Sport und das aktuelle Wetter – kompakt in einer einzigen App.
- Push-Mitteilungen: Sei sofort informiert, wenn wichtige Ereignisse passieren.
- Multimedial: Neben klassischen Nachrichten gibt es Videos, Bildergalerien und Liveticker.
- Videos & Live-TV – exklusive Reportagen, Short Form Video, Events & Interviews auf Abruf
- Radio & Podcasts – jetzt neu: GOAT Radio mit Pop-Rock der 80er & beliebte Formate wie «Anderi Liga»
- Leserfreundlich: intuitives Design, einfache Navigation und viele Personalisierungsmöglichkeiten.
- Profil: Merke dir Artikel, bleibe über deine Kommentare auf dem Laufenden und finde das wieder, was du zuletzt gelesen hast.
- Gratis & unabhängig: Die App ist kostenlos und unabhängig von politischen oder wirtschaftlichen Interessen.
- Multilingual lesen – Artikel auch in Englisch, Französisch, Portugiesisch u.v.m. verfügbar
- Dark Mode & One-Thumb-UX – augenschonend, intuitiv & für Linkshänder optimiert
Benötigst du Hilfe? Kontaktiere uns!
Falls du beim Nutzen der 20 Minuten App Fragen hast oder Unterstützung benötigst, stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung. Unser Support-Team hilft dir bei allen Anliegen rund um die App – egal, ob technische Fragen, Feedback oder Verbesserungsvorschläge.
Darüber hinaus kannst du dich auch über unsere Social-Media-Kanäle mit uns verbinden und auf dem Laufenden bleiben. Dort findest du ebenfalls spannende Inhalte, Videos und weitere Nachrichten aus der Schweiz und der Welt.
Jetzt downloaden!

bluejetty:00151615:ios.summary:
Golf Peaks is a chill puzzle game about climbing misty mountains by playing golf. Choose cards to move the ball around, avoid hazards or use them to your advantage, solve over 120 handcrafted levels and become the master of Golf Peaks!
UNI
bluejetty:00151615:ios.description:
Golf Peaks is a chill puzzle game about climbing misty mountains by playing golf. Choose cards to move the ball around, avoid hazards or use them to your advantage, solve over 120 handcrafted levels and become the master of Golf Peaks!
UNIQUE GOLF PUZZLES
You start each stage with a selection of cards (strokes) - pick the right one, choose a direction and launch your ball towards the hole!
ZERO UNDERSTANDING OF GOLF REQUIRED
Golf Peaks offers a fun experience even if you don’t know your eagles from bogeys - the game’s textless tutorial introduces everything you need at a relaxed pace.
120+ HOLES TO CONQUER
Each location offers a half-course with 9 holes to solve, along with a bonus short course (3 holes) for players seeking an additional challenge!
BUNKERS, PITS & MORE

bluejetty:00041127:ios.name: Vetster – Online Vets 24/7
bluejetty:00041127:ios.summary:
Vetster connects you with trusted veterinarians available 24/7 to provide online care for your pet from the comfort of your own home. Get ongoing care for $10/month or book a single appointment.
Download the Vetster app to find a trusted v
bluejetty:00041127:ios.description:
Vetster connects you with trusted veterinarians available 24/7 to provide online care for your pet from the comfort of your own home. Get ongoing care for $10/month or book a single appointment.
Download the Vetster app to find a trusted vet for your pet. Book an appointment at a time convenient to you. Vetster vets answer your questions and concerns through secure online video appointments. Where available, our virtual veterinarians can also provide prescriptions for medication. Vetster is here to help from initial concern to diagnosis to prescription delivery.
Don’t wait! Get the care for your pet when you need it.
Vetster’s online veterinary doctors can help with:
- Itchy skin, excessive scratching, or fleas
- Irritated ears: shaking head, scratching, discharge, or odor
- Vomiting, diarrhea, or straining to poop
- Urinary problems: urinating more than normal, straining to urinate, or bloody urine.
- Eye problems
- Breathing issues: coughing, sneezing, or nasal congestion
- Limping, pain, or injury
- Ingestion of something potentially harmful.
Is your Dutch Terrier experiencing fatigue? Does your pet choke on their chewy toy?
Ask a vet your questions and receive peace of mind as well as pet health treatment. Whether you need an emergency vet, pet drugs or medicine from a pharmacy or veterinarian care for an animal species that's not common, the Vetster app can provide professional telehealth help right away.
When your vet clinic is closed, but you need answers—and quickly—Vetster has got you covered 24/7. Take out the stress and worry by getting the answers you need to take care of your pet from the comfort of your own home.
Using Vetster is simple and convenient:
- Download the Vetster App
- Create your free Vetster account
- Find a veterinarian based on your pet’s needs
- Choose your preferred time/date for an appointment
- Your Vetster Vet will confirm your appointment
- Change of plans? No worries! Reschedule for a credit or refund
What to expect during your appointment?
After booking your appointment, you’ll be connected to a licensed veterinarian or veterinary technician via video chat.
Similar to an in-person appointment, the licensed veterinarian or technician will ask you questions about your pet and their health history. They may also want to see your pet up-close to better examine them and gather more information about a tentative diagnosis.
The vet will let you know what the next steps are (such as booking an in-person appointment, sending you a prescription, how to treat at home, etc.)
That’s it!
Why choose Vetster?
Thousands of pet owners trust Vetster and our five-star rated virtual vets. Pets love it too because fewer trips to the vet mean less stress for them! Best of all, creating an account is 100% free!

bluejetty:00018359:ios.summary:
After helping over 13,000,000 people in the UK find their perfect room or roommate, we've come to help in the US. With our apps, you can do it all while on-the-go. 
Repeatedly featured by Apple in the categories of Your New Home, Apps for
bluejetty:00018359:ios.description:
After helping over 13,000,000 people in the UK find their perfect room or roommate, we've come to help in the US. With our apps, you can do it all while on-the-go. 
Repeatedly featured by Apple in the categories of Your New Home, Apps for the Weekend, What's Hot, and Popular Apps and Games. Covered by The New York Times, Time magazine, The Wall Street Journal and the Los Angeles Times.
SUITABLE FOR EVERYONE
Whether you're starting college, relocating within or to the US, tired of living alone, weighing up what to do with an empty room, or, quite simply, searching for another roommate or roomshare, we’re the service for you.
YOUR PERFECT ROOMIE
We understand that finding your perfect roommate, housemate or roomshare can be a daunting task, but it really doesn’t have to be. Using the SpareRoom app you can filter potential roommates via a range of attributes ensuring you find a perfect new housemate or roomshare! Pick from whether you want your roommate to be a professional, student or other to make sure you're both on the same page when it comes to living together. We'll even allow you to go even more granular by filtering roommates on things like 'are they vegetarian' and 'do they allow pets'.
UNRIVALLED CHOICE
With thousands of room-sharing opportunities to choose from right across the US, you'll be able to find your perfect roommate or roomshare. We're all across the US so you can find a roommate or roomshare from NYC all the way to San Francisco.
OUR PHILOSOPHY
Experience has taught us that finding a great roomshare is as much about the people as it is about the property. To help you find the best of both, we provide unparalleled tools, choice, and support. As a result, on average, every 3 minutes someone finds a roommate through SpareRoom.
HELP & SUPPORT 
Our award-winning customer support team are here to help you with your search. If you require support, come across a problem, or want to provide feedback, you can get in touch by email (support@spareroom.com) or phone (1 877 834 2909).

bluejetty:00095821:ios.name: GORAG - Physics Sandbox
bluejetty:00095821:ios.summary:
GORAG is a single-player physics sandbox built for pure experimentation and creative destruction. This is not a game about winning - it's a playful playground where the goal is to explore, break, and mess with everything.
GORAG is a sandbo
bluejetty:00095821:ios.description:
GORAG is a single-player physics sandbox built for pure experimentation and creative destruction. This is not a game about winning - it's a playful playground where the goal is to explore, break, and mess with everything.
GORAG is a sandbox made for experimentation: launch your character off ramps, bounce them off trampolines, throw them into contraptions, or activate superhero mode to fly across the playground. Every move is powered by physics - no fake animations, just raw reactions and unexpected results.
There’s no story, no objectives - just a sandbox built for destruction, testing, and endless playground fun. Jump, crawl, crash, or fly: every outcome depends on how you use the sandbox.
Features: 
A fully interactive sandbox built for ragdoll experiments
Powerful superhero mode with flying, high-speed crashes
Full reactive sound system with unique impact sounds
Unique ragdoll physics with stumbling, falling, impacts, and funny reactions
Interactive objects like glass, saws, water blocks, trampolines, and many other
Stumbling system that makes the character lose balance, recover, or fall
Admin Eye mode with free camera movement and object manipulation 
Spawner mode with many objects, hazards, tools, vehicles, and props 
Dummy NPC for testing ragdoll physics 
Vehicle made for crashes, movement
First-person view for closer interaction with the playground 
Stylized visuals focused on clear, readable ragdoll reactions 
Whether you're building a chain reaction or triggering total chaos, GORAG offers a sandbox playground where physics is everything, and destruction is just part of the fun.

OutdoorClass educates and inspires veteran & aspiring hunters through the expertise of the world’s best. With professionally produced courses taught by the world's leading outdoor experts, OutdoorClass is the only place you can get unlimited access to top-level hunting knowledge. Access your courses wherever you need them thanks to mobile downloading options, or watch at home on your favorite device. Whatever your skill level, there’s always more to learn—grow your skills and explore the unknown with OutdoorClass.
Learn from the world's best hunters
With OutdoorClass you’ll learn from the best as they impart their knowledge, experience, and inspiration to get you ready for your next adventure.
Lessons for every step of the journey
A successful hunt requires a combination of multiple disciplines. OutdoorClass covers all these disciplines and more. You’ll have access to the cumulative experience of multiple lifetimes of hunting and outdoor expertise. With new courses in the works, there’s always more to learn.
Unlimited access with your annual membership
Members get access to every class in our library and new classes are added regularly.
Stream anywhere and anytime
Watch at home or on-the-go on with any device.
Get inspired, 10 minutes at a time 
Each class features video lessons that fit into any part of your day. Learn on your own terms: in bite-sized pieces or binged all at once.
An immersive learning experience
Cinematic visuals and close-up, hands-on demonstrations help you experience one-on-one instruction with our experts.
Instructors
Remi Warren, Randy Newberg, Corey Jacobsen, Jaime Teigen, with more coming soon.

bluejetty:00017060:ios.description:
A retro computing / pixel art camera app.
Retrospecs lets you convert images and video clips so they appear as they would on a wide variety of home computers and consoles from the 70's, 80's and 90's.
Simply take a picture (or select one from your photo library) and you can display it as it would appear on over forty systems including the Commodore 64, IBM PC (DOS, CGA, EGA and VGA), Sinclair ZX Spectrum, Commodore Amiga, Atari ST, Sega Mega Drive, Nintendo Game Boy and even the original 1984 model Apple Macintosh. If that's not enough you can also create your own custom modes based around four different graphics engines and a wide variety of color palettes and character fonts. (The free version only contains a limited number of systems/dither modes and the custom editors, video clip processing and animation options aren't available.)

bluejetty:00035613:ios.description:
VoiceCalc - Your AI Voice Calculator
Skip the keyboard—just say your calculation and get instant results. VoiceCalc combines voice recognition with ChatGPT/Gemini to solve math problems faster than ever.
Simply say "3.99 times 21 times 0.7" and get your answer immediately.
■ Smart Problem Solving
- "Which is better: 10 items for $3.99 or 12 for $4.99?"
- "Split an $85 dinner bill among 4 people with a 15% tip—how much each?"
- "What's 20% off $129.99?"
■ Instant Conversions
- "It's 10:08 PM in New York—what time is it in Tokyo?"
- "Convert 72°F to Celsius"
- "How many kilometers in 8.5 miles?"
■ Handle Any Calculation

Voice Input – Speak naturally, no special commands needed

Calculation History – Keep track of your results and revisit them anytime
Multilingual – Supports major world languages
Perfect for shopping, cooking, studying, or any time you need a quick calculation without fumbling for a calculator.

bluejetty:00026562:ios.name: Word Yatzy - Fun Word Puzzler
bluejetty:00026562:ios.summary:
Word Yatzy is your new favorite word game. What happens when you combine classic scrabble board and add the amazing gameplay of Yahtzee? Meet Word Yatzy - the best new game to train your brain.
Word Yatzy is more than just a scrabble game
bluejetty:00026562:ios.description:
Word Yatzy is your new favorite word game. What happens when you combine classic scrabble board and add the amazing gameplay of Yahtzee? Meet Word Yatzy - the best new game to train your brain.
Word Yatzy is more than just a scrabble game with friends. How good are you at spotting words from a random set of letters? Do you have the Yahtzee skills to fill all 5 slots and score big?! Get ready to test your word and strategy skills on this new addictive word game!
In this game, you have unlimited games and unlimited boards. Play as much as you want, as long as you want, against as many people as you want. No limits on your play at all! That’s because we believe in the power of play!
Word Yatzy is a turn-based game where two players compete for the highest score.
- Start with 7 letters and use those letters to create words and play them on the gameboard for a ton of points.
- Roll your letters like dice to see if you can build those high-scoring words.
- Place high scoring letters (hello Z and Q) on tile bonuses for huge rounds!
- If you can fill all 5 slots, you’re guaranteed a huge +100 bonus!
- No time limit on moves means you can play at your own pace
- Games are 5 rounds and quick! Finish a game in minutes and start another one!
Play with a friend or other Word Yatzy players - people are always ready to play!
CLASSIC GAMEPLAY WITH A TWIST
PLAY WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
FIND YOUR MATCH
This free puzzle word game will be a new anchor in your phone. With quick turns, Word Yatzy is the perfect word game to fill those “waiting for the bus” moments. It’s a great way to sharpen your mind and train your brain. Use all those letter tiles and get them on the board for the highest points. Do you have the skills to compete? We hope you enjoy and relax with Word Yatzy like millions of other players. This game continues to grow - we hope you join our fans and help us keep growing the word community! Come join us!
Word Yatzy is the most addictive and enjoyable way to train your brain. Yatzy!
FunCraft proudly made Word Yatzy. We make daily ritual word games and hope you enjoy your experience!

bluejetty:00159945:ios.description:
"Alien Hunter" is a top-down, real-time, stealth-action, multiplayer game that pits you against friends or foes in adrenaline-pumping 1v1 and 2v2 battles. Choose your side: be the cunning, evolving Alien sneaking in the shadows, or the relentless Hunter tracking down your alien prey, in this tactical multiplayer horror.
KEY FEATURES:
Stealth Mechanics: Utilize lights and shadows to your advantage. As an Alien, blend into darkness to evade the Hunter. As a Hunter, use light and powerful abilities to reveal hidden foes.
Light & Shadow System: An innovative light and shadow system adds depth to the gameplay. Shadows are not just visual; they’re an integral part of your strategy.
Diverse Characters: Select from an array of unique evolving characters, each with distinct abilities and traits. Whether you prefer stealth, speed, or brute force, there's a character for you! You can play either as an Alien lurk in the shadows and evolve to the stage 2 to defeat the hunters. Or play as a hunter and use your flashlight do reveal and defeat the Alien.
Real-Time Action: Engage in fast-paced, real-time combat. Outwit and outmaneuver your opponent, as every second counts in this high-octane battleground.
Competitive Gameplay: Climb the ranks and showcase your prowess in the leaderboards. Engage in tournaments and special events for awesome rewards and ultimate glory.
Regular Updates: Stay engaged with regular content updates, including new characters, maps, and game modes.
Fair Play: Skill is king. No pay-to-win mechanics, just pure competitive balance.
Join the hunt now! Alien Hunter is the ultimate test of strategy, reflexes, and cunning. Gather your wits and prepare for battle in this thrilling 1v1 multiplayer experience.
Download Alien Hunter today and prove you’re the ultimate hunter in the galaxy!
Note: A network connection is required to play.

bluejetty:00024624:ios.summary: SunOnTrack transforms your device into a professional tool for planning sunlight, the sun’s position, path and shadows for every place in the world (and at every time) accurately, on the map or in AR. Whether for photography, real estate, y
bluejetty:00024624:ios.description:
SunOnTrack transforms your device into a professional tool for planning sunlight, the sun’s position, path and shadows for every place in the world (and at every time) accurately, on the map or in AR. Whether for photography, real estate, your new flat or house, gardening, photovoltaics or all outdoor activities: sunlight, sun position and shadows play a major role. See sun’s elevation, its direction, exact sun movement over day and year, objects’ shadows, shadow lengths, shadow differences between seasons, and more.
RECOMMENDED BY PROFESSIONALS:
„This app is awesome! It has helped me to align the PV modules (solar panels) optimally.“ – Jürgen
„For me as a photographer SunOnTrack is an extremely practical tool. Always knowing the sun’s position in real time brings enormous relief. Planning photo shootings becomes significantly easier.“ – Aki from Akigrafie Live
„I am absolutely thrilled. I work in the real estate industry and can now use AR to check with my clients when the sun is shining on the balcony. Amazed customers guaranteed.“ – Toni K.
„It's very useful and professional. It helps me coordinate my trips.“ – Dino
PHILOSOPHY: No ads. Pay once, get full access forever. No user tracking. SunOnTrack tracks the sun, but only the sun, not the user! For sure. This app is a professional product. It can be bought for a one-time price to get all the high quality features it offers at once, without distracting ads or the need for further in app purchases.
• CREATORS (in photography/filming) all over the world love SunOnTrack not only for its easy usage but also for the extensive functionality it offers. With it you're guaranteed to not miss a perfect scene and optimal light – during the day, Golden Hour or Blue Hour, for instance. Precise, location-dependent planning of the sun’s position and natural lighting of your subjects are extremely relevant in photography – whether capturing landscapes, objects or humans.
• You would like to know the effective AMOUNT OF SUNLIGHT a flat or house/property offers? During Winter, when days are shorter? Get a general picture in advance on Maps or impress at site visits and property tours with showing the sun’s path at the kitchen window for the whole year, live in 3D in your camera image using Augmented Reality (AR)! It’s an insiders’ tip for real estate agents, house builders or interested individuals in general.
• PHOTOVOLTAICS: SunOnTrack provides professional support in placing, adjusting and optimizing your solar modules. Where does sun rise, where does it set? See the differences between the seasons at your location.
• We love green! We love GARDENS. Plan your garden with SunOnTrack. Simulate the exact shadows of multiple objects in Shadow Simulation mode, by adding them on the map defining their heights. For example, you can see the length and impact of shadows casted by objects like houses or a trees when the sun follows its path.
• SAVE all planned scenes, sun paths, shadow simulations and your places for later use.
• As you can see in the screenshots, DAY VIEW provides precise, location-dependent information on the sun like day length, solar noon, sunrise, sunset and twilight times (like Blue Hour, Golden Hour, Astronomical Twilight, …)
• For all OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES SunOnTrack wants to be your faithful companion as a sun tracker and planner. Whether in cities, in the mountains or when touring through valleys, meadows and fields, the app develops its full potential: on Maps, live in AR or even in advance when planning.
NOTE:
Ideas and feedback are very welcome. Please use the provided feedback function in the app.
AR 3D functionality: SunOnTrack shows the sun’s position and path based on the orientation of your device with high precision. For identifying its orientation, your devices’ internal sensors are used. In order to achieve exact results, a calibration can be required by moving your device in a figure-eight-pattern and keeping it away of metallic objects.

bluejetty:00039832:ios.description:
Sell what you no longer need. Buy what you love. Give great items a new life.
Vendora is the European marketplace where people discover unique finds, sell pre-owned treasures, and turn things their passions into extra income. From collectibles and vintage fashion to retro electronics, designer furniture, games, art and more, Vendora connects buyers and sellers across the EU in one simple marketplace.
Why Vendora?
Because great things deserve a second chance—and selling shouldn’t be complicated.
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE
Discover thousands of unique, handmade, pre-owned and new items from sellers across Europe.
With "Buy via Vendora", your payment is securely collected, held and released through the platform. You can track your shipment and, if your order doesn’t arrive or the item is significantly different from its description, you’re covered by our money-back guarantee.
SELL AND MAKE EXTRA MONEY
Turn unused belongings, collections and hobbies into income. List your items, reach buyers across the EU and grow your side hustle beyond your local area.
Enable international shipping and Vendora helps guide you through the process, including generating the required shipping label or voucher when supported by the courier.

bluejetty:00154978:ios.description:
Two sisters dressing you for whatever life brings you!
My older sister, Cristina, has been dressing women in gorgeous formalwear for nearly 10 years as the owner of The Platinum Zipper in Tampa, FL. After working for 10 years in law enforcement and missing out on my sweet boys (Valentino & Cristiano...hence the name Valiano) she talked me into joining her to offer trendy, boutiquewear to her customers...and finally have a normal work schedule! Did we dwell on it for months and months and overthink it all? NOPE! We jumped to it on July 4th, 2018 and have never looked back. (Come to think of it...not even sure we had mentioned it to our husbands.) We were spontaneous and ran with the idea, knowing our families would support us no matter what.
Here we are a few years later and the momentum hasn't slowed down a bit. We continue to grow, thanks to our loyal customers, and are more excited than ever to dress you, both at our storefront and from home!

bluejetty:00047090:ios.description:
Ohai – Powering Your Day, Every Day
Ohai! I’m O, your personal assistant here to help your whole household run smoothly—from syncing schedules to managing everyday to-dos and reminders—so you can do less juggling and spend more time living.
Here’s how I help you get it all done:
- Master the School Year
I keep your family’s calendar organized—from the first day of school to Maycember madness—so you never miss a thing.
- New! Instantly Sync School Calendars
Enter your zip code to find official school calendars near you and add events—like holidays and early dismissals—right to your calendar. Got a flyer or PDF? Just send it to me, and I’ll scan it for key dates and add them for you. No typing, no missed events.
- Shareable Calendars = Less Work for Everyone
Once you’ve scanned or synced a school calendar or sports schedule, you can share it with other parents via a simple link so they can add it to their calendars too. Be the hero of your group chat—scan it once, and everyone stays in sync. 
- Meal Plans for Hectic School Days
I can suggest easy weeknight dinners and allergen-free school snacks, build your grocery list, and even send it to Instacart for you.
- Delegate Tasks Like a Pro
From drop-off and pickup to snack duty, I help you coordinate tasks and send reminders—so nothing slips through the cracks.
- Make Time for You (Yes, You!)
I block time for workouts, focus sessions, or even just a quiet coffee—because back-to-school doesn’t have to mean back to burnout.
- Inbox to Calendar, Instantly
Forward me those school newsletters, PTA updates, and “pls read!” emails. I’ll scan them for key info—like pajama day and permission slips—and add it all to your calendar and to-do list.
-One Family Calendar
From soccer games and science fairs to playdates and PTA meetings, I keep your whole family in sync with one smart, shareable calendar.
- Just Say It Out Loud
Now with voice and video, I let you brain dump while packing lunches or sitting in the pickup line. I’ll turn your thoughts into events, reminders, and to-dos—no typing needed.
Message me anytime. I’m here to help you stay ahead, stress less, and get more done.
Download Ohai.ai and meet O today.
https://www.ohai.ai/terms-of-service
https://www.ohai.ai/privacy-policy
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00179115:ios.description:
The Calgary Sun is your trusted source for local news, politics, sports and entertainment. Create your custom feed so you don’t miss the latest from your favourite writers. Stay up to date throughout the day with breaking news in Calgary, Alberta and around the world. Plus get the latest on the Calgary Flames, Calgary Stampeders, Calgary Roughnecks and the Calgary Hitmen with the best sports coverage in Canada including scores, standings, highlights and commentary.
Features include:
• Stay connected to the best local news, sports, entertainment, commentary and beyond.
• Browse the Toronto Sun, Ottawa Sun, Edmonton Sun, Calgary Sun, The Province and Canoe brands seamlessly.
• You will be prompted to choose your preferred publications when you first open the new app, ensuring a curated news feed that aligns with your interests.
• Use the Discover tab to explore trending stories from Postmedia newsrooms across Canada
• Personalize your news experience by selecting topics, journalists and columnists you care about, so your feed will be filled with the content and perspectives you enjoy.
• As a registered user, you are recognized consistently across web and app platforms for a more cohesive experience.
Register to sample the wide variety of breaking news and special features — plus extensive photo and video coverage. Home delivery print subscribers receive unlimited access, included as part of their print subscription and can gain access by simply signing in with their existing account when prompted. If you’re not an existing print subscriber, you can easily subscribe to the app through the App Store for iOS devices.
Subscription details
• Monthly subscription cost: $5.99 plus applicable taxes
• Complete your subscription at the App Store for iOS devices. Payment will be charged to your account upon confirmation of purchase. 
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
• Account will be charged $5.99 each month within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
Privacy policy: https://www.postmedia.com/privacy-statement/
Terms of use: https://www.postmedia.com/terms-and-conditions/
We appreciate and value your feedback. Please send any comments, suggestions or questions to: appfeedback@postmedia.com

bluejetty:00100428:ios.description:
Interval surfaces the headlines that matter, especially the ones that are being censored and suppressed.
In a world of legacy media companies, chaotic social media influencers, and ever conflicting narratives, our team of journalists curate the most important stories of the day and gives you the context to understand them clearly.
We surface critical reporting from independent journalists and major media outlets alike, bringing together perspectives that are often scattered across platforms, or missed entirely.
Free access includes:
- Five free articles to read in full
- All headlines and subheaders for a quick overview
- Exclusive, daily video updates on topics that tend to get filtered out on social media
A subscription is required to unlock:
- All daily headlines
- Summaries and key takeaways
- Evidence and original sources
- Coverage and visibility indicators
- The misinformation section
Mainstream media loves to bury their sources. We surface all the evidence so you can verify, understand, and think critically. From firsthand footage, court docs, UN docs, Tweets, Truth Social posts and more, we dig deep to find all the evidence you need.
Subscriptions are auto-renewable and managed through your Apple ID.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026963:ios.description:
Autio - Audio for Travel
*** Apple App of the Day, Apps We Love, & New & Noteworthy
*** Webby Award Winner for Best Travel App
Ready to take travel to the next level? Autio has 20,000+ location-based audio stories in America and around the world. Try your first 5 stories free - no strings attached - then choose a plan for 30 Days, 1 Year, or 3 Years.
Ever curious about the deeper story behind that bronze historical marker you passed on the highway? Autio is an invitation to discover — a hands-free experience that delights, informs, & entertains by fostering a deeper connection with the people, places, & histories of the land you are traveling through.
With rave reviews from Forbes, Travel & Leisure, The New York Times, Outside, TechCrunch, & more!
FEATURES:
NARRATED BY YOUR FAVORITE VOICES — Many of our stories are narrated by voices you know and love like Kevin Costner, Phil Jackson, John Lithgow, and more.
DISCOVER INTERESTING STORIES — Autio notifies you when you’re in range of new stories you haven’t heard yet.
ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW — New stories are released weekly, so no two trips are ever the same.
GROWING COVERAGE — Unique stories from across America and beyond.
FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS — Audio stories keep your eyes off your phone and on your beautiful surroundings.
HOW IT WORKS
As you travel, Autio serves up stories based on your geographic location & interests. The audio vignettes, generally 2-3 minutes in length, tell the history around you, painting a multi-dimensional picture you’re unlikely to get from a history book or visitor's guide. Autio answers the questions we all ask as the odometer turns.
ABOUT AUTIO
Humans are moved by stories. Stories that make us laugh and cry. They move us to come together and do amazing things. Since the dawn of time, stories have been the way in which values and knowledge are passed from one generation to the next — each adding their wisdom and experience along the way.
It’s time to connect with the sum of our experience, to enrich our lives with the stories of today, and to inspire the great storytellers yet to come.

bluejetty:00140254:ios.description:
mPassport brings you trusted medical care around the world.
mPassport is for subscribers and insured members only.
• Current mPassport subscribers – please log in using the username and password you chose at the mPassport site.
• Current HTH Worldwide insurance members – access this app with the username and password you chose at the hthstudents, hthbusiness or hthtravelinsurance site.
If you haven’t registered for access yet, you may directly register through the app.
mPassport brings you destination-specific information and expert assistance to prepare and protect you while traveling.
For all users:
• Find a provider - locate the right doctor, dentist, mental health professional, hospital or clinic
• Find your medications – brand names vary around the world, know what yours is called and whether it is available; then find a pharmacy 
• Translate medical phrases and terms – it even lets you play them for others to hear • View country and city security profiles and receive daily health and safety alerts 
For most insured members (some features are not available for certain insurance products): 
• Request direct billing and view or share your issued Guarantees of Payment 
• View or share your issued Guarantees of Payment 
• File an eClaim for reimbursement using the iPhone or iPad camera 
• View claims history and see claims in process and completed claims 
You can save your favorite items and share important information with others. 
HTH Worldwide, the company behind mPassport, is a leader in helping world travelers gain access to quality healthcare services around the world. HTH combines ongoing research, a contracted global community of physicians and hospitals and wide experience in international health insurance to ensure customers' health, safety and peace of mind. To learn more, visit HTH Worldwide. 
If you have questions about mPassport, please write to customerservice@hthworldwide.com.

bluejetty:00157193:ios.name: RIDE Longmont
bluejetty:00157193:ios.summary:
RIDE Longmont is your go-to app for getting around Longmont. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be a RIDE Longmont shuttle ride or a bus trip.
How
bluejetty:00157193:ios.description:
RIDE Longmont is your go-to app for getting around Longmont. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be a RIDE Longmont shuttle ride or a bus trip.
How it works:
-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you the best journey available at that time. 
-Book RIDE Longmont rides directly in the app for you and any additional passengers
-Never miss your ride with live arrival times for your bus and ride tracking for your on demand journey.
-If you’re riding on demand, there may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best public transit journey available at that time. In the RIDE Longmont service, you’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- ACCESSIBLE: The app allows you to travel with a support person or be matched with a vehicle that meets your mobility needs. 
- SUSTAINABLE: Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Longmont a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00122573:ios.description:
CashBox is a secure savings platform that helps you save money seamlessly all from the comfort of your mobile phone, tablet or computer. CashBox is basically an online "savings box". It is FREE, secure and any amount can be saved anytime you want, while earning interest on your savings.
From any location, you can securely save on CashBox and do the following:
● KidsBox: Our KidsBox feature is curated for kids of all ages. It’s a fun and educative way to introduce kids & teens to money. Parents can also use this feature to save for their kids. Jump right in and start saving for the future.
● Target: This plan lets you save consistently (daily/weekly/monthly) towards a set goal while earning cool interest on your savings. Withdrawal is done on plan maturity.
● Regular: Auto save regularly (daily/weekly/monthly) and also earn interest on savings. Withdrawal is easily done on your set free withdrawal days which is once in a quarter and any other one time within the quarter.
● Vault: This plan is a personalised fixed deposit account. Savers can lock funds for a period of 90 days or more, and earn interest upfront immediately. Upon maturity of plan, withdrawal can be easily done.
● Swift: Save any amount, any time without necessarily creating an automated savings plan. For users without an ATM card, saving is possible via bank transfer.
● Cliques: Save together with family & friends to achieve a set goal. Even though savings is done together, no one has access to your funds but you alone.
Security guaranteed- We use bank grade security and the highest levels of Internet Security, secured by 256 bits SSL security encryption. All personal and bank details are secure on CashBox.
We are a customer-centric company and always put our users first. We provide 24-7 customer support and also provide transparency in all transactions. Customers are able to easily monitor their savings and earned interest all from the app.
* Free to signup, No monthly charges or deposit fees, Secure platform.

bluejetty:00032460:ios.description:
Welcome to the Screw pin: Nuts and Bolts Puzzle, where you'll encounter truly challenging brain puzzle! Experience the thrill of the new unscrew pin game and aim to become a master of screws.
As an experienced technician, adeptly unblock screws and disentangle each twisted iron piece from the intricate array of obstacles. Progress through carefully designed levels, encountering a tangle of metal plates, rings, and ropes at every twist and turn.
Exciting Features of Screw Pin: Nuts Bolts Puzzle
• Skillfully manipulate and repair iron pieces, unscrew and screw pins to solve the puzzle
• No time constraints - play at your convenience
• Unlimited levels! Numerous screw pin jam strategies await you.
Certain levels showcase metal art crafted from metal plates, while others require the use of a handsaw to cut through these plates, revealing additional holes to secure your bolts and nuts.
Do you possess the vision and mental prowess to unravel these screw puzzles in the township of nuts and bolts games? Prepare to test your intelligence and become a legend in bridge construction.
Unscrew Brain Puzzle Game is ideal for those who:
• Enjoy puzzle games such as screw pin puzzles, screws jam, screw nut puzzles, screw mastery, bolts, and nuts
• Seek challenges with new obstacles
• Appreciate challenging puzzle levels and metal materials
• Enjoy the ASMR sound of metals
While the screw puzzle levels of nuts and bolts may appear straightforward initially, don't underestimate the complexity of the pin brain puzzle! Dive into the world of bolts and nuts games and enjoy the challenge!

bluejetty:00047252:android.description:
🤔 What is Pix? How does it work? What is a Pix key? How do I register? What is the Pix app? How do I organize my Pix?
If you have these or other questions, this app is for you. mPix is an app that gathers information about this new type of bank transfer, where you can send money and receive transfers quickly to your bank account, in addition to paying bills.
📙 This app aims to help you clear up all your doubts about the new instant payment method and thus be able to use this new service in the best way, sending money or receiving payments.
📲 This is a new payment method in which money is transferred between bank accounts in a few seconds, at any time. You don't need to download the Pix app or open a Pix account! At mPix we explain everything you need to know to learn how to transfer money from one account to another.
🤑 Need to transfer money? In our app, you can organize the codes for payment via cell phone. It's a Pix agenda to help you organize yourself better!
🔑 Now you can save the keys you use most frequently. In addition, make charges with Pix by copying and pasting and sharing the code on your cell phone or showing the QR Code to whoever will make the payment.
✅ Main features:
- Guide and answers to the main questions: Learn what Pix is and how to transfer money from one account to another;
- Organize and register your keys in the app: Don't know what Pix keys are? Don't worry, with our app you will not only learn what the key is, but you will also be able to organize all of them. It's a Pix key manager in the palm of your hand!
- Create a Pix copy and paste to make charges: Charging people has become much easier! Just create a Pix copy and paste and send it to the person who should transfer money to you;
- Save recurring charges: Do you need to receive money from someone on a recurring basis? You can save charges in mPix! - Generation of QR Codes for charges: In our app, you can also generate QR Codes for sending charges;
- Complete guide to help you register your keys.
This type of money transfer is offered by banks, payment methods and fintechs. Therefore, it is important to understand how to register your Pix key in your digital account, and here at mPix we explain how to start making money transfers.
Make money transfers in seconds! This is the world of Pix! Where you receive and make payments via your cell phone with instant transfers. Remember that Pix is free! You do not pay any bank fees to transfer money or receive payments, regardless of the amount, whether it is a high-value bank transfer, or even a Pix of 1 real, it is all without secrets. Pix is free!
Get all the information you need to join this new payment and financial transaction method. With it, you can make and receive instant transfers, pay bills and everyday purchases at any time, making payments via your cell phone.
mPix is a Pix key manager that organizes your payment codes, QR Codes, making it easier to organize your money and make payments. Paying bills has become even easier with this new payment method via cell phone.
*ATTENTION: This application is in the form of a GUIDE and has a public utility function. Its developers have no connection with any government entities or institutions that may be mentioned. All data is in the public domain. It is not possible to make bank transfers here, and it is not an app to earn Pix or make Pix, nor are we a Pix robot. Our app is for you to learn about this new modality and organize your keys.
**We do not store or share any data.
Read our privacy policy:
https://mobapps.app/politica-privacidade-pix/

bluejetty:00068407:ios.summary:
Start new musical ideas with a curated selection of sounds and effects. Create beats and melodic parts, sample your world, and continue your tracks in Ableton Live.
Note is a place to form ideas, explore new sounds and find direction. Get y
bluejetty:00068407:ios.description:
Start new musical ideas with a curated selection of sounds and effects. Create beats and melodic parts, sample your world, and continue your tracks in Ableton Live.
Note is a place to form ideas, explore new sounds and find direction. Get your ideas out or just experiment until inspiration hits, using a selection of Ableton Live’s drum kits, synths and melodic instruments. Create your own sound palette by sampling with your phone’s built-in microphone. And use Note’s built-in MIDI Editor to sequence notes, beats and chords or make tweaks as you listen back
Follow your ideas wherever they lead by sending your projects to Live without leaving the app with the help of Ableton Cloud. Open projects from Live’s browser and keep working – you can edit all your MIDI notes, and all your samples and sounds from Note are exactly the same. Ableton Note users get a free license for Ableton Live Lite – simple, intuitive software used by musicians, producers and DJs around the world to write, record, and perform. For Ableton Move users, Note also offers the chance to keep working on a Set from your phone.
Begin with a beat:
• Choose from 76 Drum Sampler kits
• Tap out a beat using the 16-pad grid, or sequence one with the MIDI Editor
• Play each drum hit melodically using 16 Pitches mode
• Quantize your beat or nudge notes to fix loose timing or mistakes
• Add more layers of rhythm
• Create beat repetitions with Note Repeat
• Change parameters to shape your sound
• Experiment with effects or apply swing for variations
Start with a melody:
• Choose from 317 synth sounds and 60 Melodic Sampler instruments
• Play or program your melody or chord progression with the 25-pad grid, piano roll or MIDI Editor
• Set a key and scale to get instantly harmonic results
• Add more layers of harmony
• Change parameters to shape your sound
• Add effects to experiment with sound design
Sample your environment:
• Create your own kits by recording percussive sounds into Note’s Drum Sampler
• Record tonal sounds to create your own Melodic Sampler instruments
• Manipulate your samples by cutting, filtering or repitching them
• Sequence samples into beats, melodies and chords using the MIDI Editor
• Shape or transform your sounds with effects
• Import your own samples or audio directly from videos
Work with Audio
• Add audio clips from the library
• Warp tempo or adjust pitch of your clips
• Record audio directly using your phone’s built-in microphone
• Connect an audio interface to record external sources
• Combine recorded and imported audio with your beats and melodies
Capture improvisations:
• Play something, then tap the Capture button to keep it
• Play at a tempo that feels comfortable and Note will detect it
• Note will recognize the length of the phrase and create a loop
• Quantize it, add to it, or change the sound
• Connect MIDI hardware to play keys and change the sound of your instruments
Create variations:
• Note features a grid-based Session View layout
• Double your loops to create variation within clips
• Duplicate your clips and create different versions of your ideas
• Add, delete or adjust multiple notes at once with the MIDI Editor
• Create eight tracks with up to eight clips on eight scenes
• Try different clip combinations and song structures
• Export your work as an audio file to listen and share

bluejetty:00146289:ios.description:
Get ready to build, upgrade, and manage your very own border checkpoint between United States of America and Mexico, in this addictive idle game! 
Can you keep the traffic flowing, catch smugglers, and turn your humble post into a bustling border hub? 
- Build & Upgrade: 
Start with a small checkpoint and expand it into a high-tech border facility. Add lanes on either sides for cars, trucks and trailers!
- Manage Traffic: 
Keep the lines moving as cars, trucks, and even trailers pass through. Balance speed with security to keep everyone happy!
- Catch Criminals: 
Spot smugglers, uncover hidden contraband, and deal with shady characters. Use scanners, and your wits!
- Earn & Expand: 
Collect fees for every car that passes through. The better you manage, the more you earn!

Your checkpoint works for you even when you're offline. Check back to collect rewards and make upgrades.

bluejetty:00100120:ios.description:
Step into a new era of paranormal communication with Ghost Detector EMF Necrometer, a powerful fusion of EMF detection and spirit box technology.
Designed for both enthusiasts and experienced investigators, Necrometer delivers professional-grade EVP, EMF, and ITC tools for authentic and immersive spirit communication.
EMF Magnetic Energy Detection
• Uses your device’s built-in magnetometer sensor to measure fluctuations in the electromagnetic field (EMF)
• Displays real-time readings and energy spikes for accurate environmental monitoring
• Ideal for investigations in historical locations such as the Queen Mary, Waverly Hills Sanatorium, or Eastern State Penitentiary
• Perfect for both professional researchers and hobby investigators
DR60 Spirit Box Sound Bank
• Inspired by the legendary Panasonic DR60 EVP recorder, used by investigators worldwide
• Generates authentic white noise and randomized phoneme fragments for genuine spirit communication
• Delivers clear, realistic voice manifestations similar to those captured during field sessions at Gettysburg, the Myrtles Plantation, and the Stanley Hotel
Phoneme-Based Audio
• Uses reversed, fragmented, and multilingual phonemes for accurate ITC interaction
• Each vocal element is created from minimal raw sounds such as “na,” “no,” “di,” “ma,” and “may”
• Ensures that no responses are pre-recorded every sound is generated in real time during sessions
9 Sound Banks and White Noise
• 9 professional sound banks provide variety and depth for EVP experiments
• Includes a White Noise Bank modeled after the DR60’s unique EVP tone
• Layer multiple banks to enhance clarity and resonance in different environments, from old asylums to open field investigations
Spoken Response System (Text-to-Speech Integration)
• Detected or generated words are spoken aloud in real time using built-in text-to-speech technology
• Each response is voiced automatically, creating clear and audible spirit communication
• Customize playback voices such as Necro, human, or robotic tones for different session atmospheres
• Delivers an immersive, lifelike experience that combines visual words with audible speech
Built-In Audio Effects
• Echo – repeats sounds in real time to highlight responses
• Reverb – creates an atmospheric and spacious tone for better clarity
• Adjustable levels to suit both quiet indoor and high-energy outdoor investigations
Advanced Paranormal Tools
• EMF tracking overlay for visual energy monitoring
• Real-time waveform display for live EVP observation
• Mute switch detection ensures uninterrupted audio capture
• Reliable for both on-site fieldwork and controlled research environments
Subscriptions
• Weekly Plan – unlocks all premium features for seven days of unlimited investigation
• Monthly Plan – unlocks all premium features for thirty days of unlimited investigation
• Lifetime Plan – one-time purchase for complete, lifetime access to all features
All purchases are securely processed through the Apple App Store. Cancel anytime.
Subscriptions are managed and billed through Apple’s App Store and renew automatically unless cancelled in your Apple ID settings.
Legal

bluejetty:00183217:ios.description:
Workouts planned. Meals sorted. A community doing it with you.
Tammy Fit is the fitness app built by Tammy Hembrow for women who want real results without the guesswork. Everything is already done for you. You just show up.
WORKOUTS
Step-by-step gym and home workouts across every training style: booty, full body, HIIT, boxing, upper body, abs, yoga, pilates, and more. Every session is planned, every weight is tracked, and every workout builds on the last. No wandering, no guessing.
8-WEEK PROGRAMS
Choose from structured 8-week programs across gym and home, including options for pregnancy, post-pregnancy, powerbuilding, yoga, and pilates. Pick what fits your life and follow it through.
CHALLENGES
Want extra accountability? Join a time-limited challenge and train alongside thousands of women working toward the same goal at the same time. A community moment inside the app, available throughout the year.
NUTRITION
Meal plans designed by leading nutritionists, tailored to your goal, including healthy treats and family-friendly meals. You get step-by-step recipes, weekly grocery lists, and daily macro tracking. SOCIAL
Connect with the Tammy Fit community inside the app. Share your progress, see what other members are doing, and train alongside women who get it. This is what keeps people coming back.
MINDFULNESS
Guided breathwork and mindfulness sessions from 5 to 20 minutes, designed to help with stress, anxiety, and overwhelm. Because results aren't just physical.
PROGRESS TRACKING
Weight, steps, water, workouts, and food, all tracked in one place. Your diary maps out each day so you always know where you're at and how far you've come.
Connect with Apple Health to display your step count and report your progress including workouts, nutrition and hydration.

bluejetty:00065051:ios.summary: The Legend Bank mobile app features options to allow you to conduct almost all of your banking with your smartphone, tablet or watch. With our new app you can manage your account, monitor your transactions, manage your money, receive accoun
bluejetty:00065051:ios.description:
The Legend Bank mobile app features options to allow you to conduct almost all of your banking with your smartphone, tablet or watch. With our new app you can manage your account, monitor your transactions, manage your money, receive account alerts, control your debit card, pay your bills, pay others, deposit checks, transfer money between your accounts and more!
You’ll enjoy a unified experience so that it’s familiar whether you are on your phone, tablet or laptop. The app is now compatible with the Apple Watch® to provide you with additional convenient banking options. 
Debit Card Convenience
• Card Control allows you to easily control, manage and protect your debit card. You can even turn your card off if you suspect fraud or if your card is lost or stolen.
• Cardswap allows you to keep all of your accounts on the right card. You’ll have a single spot to update your card on file for your subscription and streaming services, eCommerce merchants and more!
Transfer Money 
• Legend Pay is the quick and easy way to send money to other Legend Bank customers!
• Funds Transfer allows you to do one-time transfers or recurring transfers between your accounts with a few clicks. 
Manage Your Account
• Activity Center is your one stop spot for viewing your account activity. You can view single transactions, your recurring transactions and deposited checks all in one spot.
• Go Paperless with e-statements, account notices and documents!
• Easily add a new account to your mobile app or update your contact information and address information.
• Stop Payments on single checks or multiple checks by easily making a few selections.
• Order Checks with just a few taps in the app!
Pay Bills
• Bill Payment allows you to quickly enroll your accounts and start paying your bills all within the app, making it easy to manage all of your bills and payments. You can add your billers by searching for e-bills as well.
• Biller Direct is a new feature that allows you to easily stay on top of your payments and receive real-time updates on balances and payments. You can link your accounts and sync your data so all of your bills are in one place.
• Loan Payments can be made easily in the app.
Security
• Set up Touch ID® / Face ID®
• Enroll in text banking and receive security and other account alerts 
• Sign up for account alerts
Deposit Checks
• Deposit Checks is as easy as taking a picture! It’s quick and secure!
Budgeting
• Financial Tools help you stay on top of your finances. Add all of your accounts from all of your financial institutions so you can see your full financial picture and simplify budgeting!
Find Us
• Branch & ATM locator 
• Branch hours
Just download the app and have your existing online username and password ready or you can enroll in online banking using our app. Thank you for banking with Legend Bank. It’s our privilege to serve you. 
Member FDIC. Wireless carrier charges may apply. Terms and conditions apply. Equal Housing Lender. All loans subject to credit approval.
