Black Friday 2026 makes it easy to discover and track Black Friday deals from popular retailers including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Macy’s, and JCPenney.
When is Black Friday 2026?
Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, November 27, 2026. Use this app to keep up with Black Friday ad scans, promotions, price drops, announcements, and new deals throughout the season.
Browse Black Friday ad scans and promotions from your favorite retailers, with new ads added as soon as they become available. Check back regularly to discover newly released offers and plan your shopping.
You can also save deals and ad scans for later. Saved deals automatically update when prices change, making it easier to keep track of offers you’re interested in.
Some features:
– Find and track deals
– Browse the latest Black Friday ad scans
– Save deals and ad scans to favorites
– Get notifications about new deals
– Monitor saved deals for price changes

Whether you’re shopping for TVs, laptops, smartphones, headphones, gaming consoles, appliances, toys, clothing, shoes, beauty products, home goods, or holiday gifts, the Black Friday app helps you discover deals across a wide range of categories. Browse Black Friday sales, store ads, early Black Friday deals, holiday promotions, doorbuster offers, and limited-time discounts in one convenient place. bluejetty:00095745:ios.description:
Hole Collect is the ultimate 3D black hole puzzle game that combines collecting, strategy, and brain games into one addictive experience. Control your hole, collect everything in sight, and grow bigger with every move. The more you collect, the stronger your black hole becomes.
Hole Collect is designed for players who love 3D puzzle games, brain games, and addictive black hole challenges. The goal is simple: move your hole across the 3D map, collect objects, and solve puzzles. But do not underestimate the challenge – every level brings new obstacles, new puzzles, and smarter ways to test your skills.
The Black Hole Adventure
Take control of a black hole with the power to collect and swallow anything. From small objects to massive structures, nothing can escape. The bigger the hole grows, the more addictive the gameplay becomes. Hole Collect offers satisfying collecting mechanics combined with the challenge of brain games.
Key Features
- 3D Collecting Gameplay: Move your hole and collect objects in dynamic 3D environments.
- Addictive Black Hole Action: Watch your hole consume everything as you grow bigger.
- Brain Games Challenge: Outsmart puzzles, traps, and obstacles that block your black hole.
- Progressive Levels: Collect more, unlock harder puzzles, and prove your brainpower.
- Smooth Controls: Easy to play, but hard to master.
- Endless Fun: Quick play sessions or long puzzle challenges – Hole Collect fits any time.
Why Hole Collect is Addictive
- The combination of hole mechanics, collecting gameplay, and brain games is endlessly fun.
- The 3D black hole visuals make every collect session exciting and satisfying.
- Watching a hole collect and swallow everything is pure stress relief and entertainment.
- Perfect for players who enjoy puzzle games, arcade challenges, and brain games in 3D.
How to Play Hole Collect
1. Move your hole across the 3D map.
2. Collect objects to grow your black hole.
3. Solve puzzles by collecting the right objects in the right order.
4. Avoid obstacles that shrink or block your hole.
5. Complete levels, unlock new 3D maps, and face harder brain games.
Why Choose Hole Collect Over Other Games
Unlike other black hole games, Hole Collect is not just about swallowing everything. It is about strategy, puzzle solving, and brain games that keep you challenged. Every hole movement, every collect action, and every black hole puzzle pushes your skills further.
Highlights
- Free to play black hole puzzle game.
- Regular updates with new 3D maps and collecting challenges.
- Suitable for kids, adults, and anyone who loves brain games.
- Play offline or online – collect anytime, anywhere.
Hole Collect is more than a game – it is a brain training tool disguised as a black hole puzzle adventure. Whether you want quick fun or deep strategy, Hole Collect delivers. It is the perfect mix of collect mechanics, 3D action, and brain games.
Do you enjoy puzzle games, collecting mechanics, or the thrill of a growing black hole? Hole Collect is designed for you. Start small, collect everything, grow your hole, and dominate the 3D map.
Download Hole Collect today and join millions of players who cannot stop collecting, solving puzzles, and growing their black hole.
Hole Collect is waiting. Can your hole collect it all?

bluejetty:00189705:android.description:
Highway Traffic Driving -> Endless Racing Experience
Drive your car through an endless highway traffic in a realistic environment.
Earn cash, purchase new cars, and strive to become one of the fastest drivers on the global leaderboards.
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed racing adventure!
Gameplay
* Tilt or Touch to Steer: Choose your preferred control method.
* Touch Gas Button to Accelerate: Speed up and leave your rivals behind.
* Touch Brake Button to Slow Down: Navigate tight corners and avoid collisions.
Tips for Success
* Speed Matters: The faster you drive, the higher your scores.
* Close Overtakes: When driving over 100 km/h, overtake other cars closely to earn bonus points.
* Two-Way Mode Bonus: Driving in the opposite direction in two-way mode rewards you with extra cash.
Key Features
* 3D Realistic Car Cockpit View: Immerse yourself in the driving experience.
* Endless and Time Attack Game Modes: Choose your challenge.
* Explore Different Locations and Cars: Discover diverse environments and unlock new vehicles.
Follow Us
* Please rate our game and provide feedback to help us improve further.
* Your input is valuable to us!
Developed by Pudlus Games.

bluejetty:00098126:ios.name: Blood Pressure: Health Checker
bluejetty:00098126:ios.summary:
Pay attention to heart health, starting from every heartbeat
Blood pressure and heart rate are health signals sent by the body and are always worth listening to. Blood pressure: Specifically designed for daily health monitoring, it helps yo
bluejetty:00098126:ios.description:
Pay attention to heart health, starting from every heartbeat
Blood pressure and heart rate are health signals sent by the body and are always worth listening to. Blood pressure: Specifically designed for daily health monitoring, it helps you easily record blood pressure and heart rate data, track long-term changing trends, develop scientific management habits, and make every beat clearly visible.
Simple and easy to use, ensuring health anytime and anywhere
Heart rate measurement and recording: Smart recording: Use smart sensors and optical technology to track health data to measure heart rate. The results are presented in the form of charts and statistical data, allowing you to track heart rate trends and understand your body's responses to different activities and emotional states.
Principle: By capturing the red pixels in the field of view through the mobile phone's camera, the peak values are calculated based on the color fluctuations of these pixels, thereby determining the heart rate fluctuations. Then, a unique algorithm is used to calculate a relatively accurate value to help you simply determine the changes in the current heart rate.
Reference: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/7565547
- Ultra-fast recording: No complex operations required. Manually and quickly complete the entry of blood pressure (systolic blood pressure/diastolic blood pressure) and blood sugar, and support historical data query.
- Healthy Living: Supports adding water intake records and weight records. Regular record-keeping is more worry-free and helps develop good daily living habits.
Data recording and trend insights
Manually record blood pressure and heart rate during the measurement process, automatically generate charts, and abnormal fluctuations are clear at a glance.
Support viewing multiple recent trend changes to promptly detect any changes in your physical condition.
2. Data sharing and integration
One-click export of CSV files for convenient sharing with doctors or family members, and support for custom time range export.
Integrate with Apple Health to uniformly manage multi-dimensional health data.
Application scenario: Integrating health management into daily life
Daily monitoring: Record blood pressure and heart rate in the morning and evening, observe fluctuations in physical condition, and prevent potential risks.
Health Review: Regularly generate data reports to review the impact of lifestyle habits on blood pressure and heart rate, and optimize the health management plan.
- Data Synchronization: The APP can connect to HealthKit, synchronize health data through HealthKit, visualize the data, and better manage one's own health status.
This application features a paid subscription-based membership service system. For detailed information on specific service contents, subscription methods, and benefits, please refer to the actual display within the application.
Disclaimer
This application is a health management assistant tool, dedicated to helping users enhance their health awareness. It cannot replace professional medical diagnosis. For specific medical decisions, please follow the advice of professional institutions. Heart rate measurement results are affected by device sensors, the environment and personal conditions. If you experience persistent data anomalies or discomfort symptoms, please seek medical attention immediately and follow your doctor's instructions. This application is not responsible for any health problems or consequences arising from its use.

Service Agreement: http://dolphin-clean-kit.com/1/term
To subscribe: http://dolphin-clean-kit.com/1/subscription

bluejetty:00094788:ios.description:
Subo is a beautifully simple subscription tracker for iPhone that helps you see what you pay for, what renews next, and what needs your attention.
Track and manage subscriptions, free trials, memberships, prepaid plans, app subscriptions, and recurring bills in one private place, without connecting your bank account.
See what’s coming up
• See what’s next in a clear chronological timeline
• Explore renewals, recurring charges, trial endings, and plan endings in a month calendar
• Get a Heads up for important events, including annual renewals and larger charges
• Get reminders before renewals, charges, trial endings, and plan endings
Keep everything organized
• Find and manage every subscription in one dedicated place
• Search by name, brand, or category
• See monthly and yearly subscription totals
• Add popular services quickly with ready-made templates
• Track subscriptions in different currencies
• Organize everything with categories and payment methods
• Track active, inactive, prepaid, and fixed-term plans
• Keep what’s next in view with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
Subo is designed to feel clean, focused, and native to iOS. No clutter. No ads. Just a calm place to keep your recurring costs under control.
Private by design
Your subscription details stay on your device, or securely in iCloud if you choose to sync. Automatic local backups give you another way to restore your data. Subo does not sell your data.
Track subscriptions without adding another one
Start free with up to six subscriptions. Unlock unlimited tracking with a one-time Forever Pass, or choose 12 months of non-renewing access. Neither option renews automatically.
Built independently
Subo is made independently and shaped by real user feedback. Questions, suggestions, or feedback? Email niclas@getsubo.app.
Subo is not affiliated with any brands shown. Logos are for identification only.

bluejetty:00126603:ios.name: Texter: Audio & Video to Text
bluejetty:00126603:ios.summary:
Are you spending countless hours transcribing meetings, interviews or lectures
Texter is an AI transcription app that turns audio, images and video into editable text with a single tap. From meeting minutes and interview notes to subtitles
bluejetty:00126603:ios.description:
Are you spending countless hours transcribing meetings, interviews or lectures
Texter is an AI transcription app that turns audio, images and video into editable text with a single tap. From meeting minutes and interview notes to subtitles and SRT files, you can handle your entire workflow in one place.
Key new features
・Action items from your summary
Automatically pull out action items from meetings and lectures, then add a reminder with one tap. Due dates and assignees carry over automatically.
・Import from cloud sharing links
Paste a Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Zoom sharing link and transcribe directly, no download needed.
・Share with a public link
Share a transcript as a page anyone can view, no app install required.
・Speaker Identification
Automatically splits multi person conversations by speaker, so it is instantly clear who said what in a meeting or interview.
・Synced subtitles on video import
Generate subtitles with timestamps when you import a video. Subtitles stay in sync as you play, which makes reviewing and editing much easier for lectures, interviews and recorded meetings.
Why people choose Texter
・Ask Your Note: ask AI questions about any transcript and get just the answer you need
・Picture in Picture: keep recording and transcribing in a small window while using other apps
・Speaker Identification: automatically separates multi person conversations by speaker
・Silence cut: automatically detects and removes silent sections from meeting recordings and lecture videos to cut transcription time
・Highly accurate transcription with the latest AI and on device technology
・Extract audio from video, auto create subtitles and edit by sentence with time jump
・Summarize and translate transcripts to turn them into clean meeting minutes (20 summary templates available)
・Real time translation using DeepL and Google, both online and offline
・Turn images, photos, PDFs and screenshots into text with multi page PDF support
・Real time transcription that can also support people with hearing difficulties
・Apple Watch recording: capture the moment without taking out your iPhone, then read the transcript later on iPhone
Use cases
・Meetings
Import recordings, review subtitles and the sentence list, then share only the important parts. When it's over, just ask your note what was decided.
・Online meetings
Turn on Picture in Picture and keep transcribing while you check documents or use other apps in the main window.
・Interviews and journalism
Speaker Identification splits the conversation automatically, and sentence based editing dramatically cuts down editing time. Easily organize interviews with Q&A templates.
・Classes and lectures
Pull out key points from lecture videos and make searchable, summarized notes. Missed something? Just ask your note.
・Creators
Convert video to text, edit subtitles and export clips for social media, all in one app.
・Export
Export transcripts as PDF or SRT subtitle files and use them directly in documents or video editing.
Texter Premium
・Sync notes between iPhone and iPad
・Unlimited use of Ask Your Note (AI Chat)
・Unlimited access to 20 summary templates
・Remove limits on real time transcription (including Picture in Picture) and image text recognition
・Increase maximum length for imported audio
・Remove ads for a smoother experience
Notes
・Some advanced features work even better on newer iOS devices and OS versions.
・Transcription and subtitle accuracy depends on recording quality, such as noise level and clarity of speech. You can always edit the text later.
We will keep improving Texter based on your feedback. Please give it a try.
Terms of Use
https://texter.work/en/terms-of-service/
Personal Information Protection Policy
https://texter.work/en/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00185718:ios.description:
Easily catalog your collection of DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs. Just scan their barcodes or search our CLZ Core online movie database by title. Automatic movie details like cast, crew, plot, episode lists, IMDb Ratings and cover art.
Note: CLZ Movies is the only movie manager app with an official IMDb data license!
CLZ Movies is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
== 3 easy ways to catalog your movies ==
1. Scan barcodes with the built-in camera scanner. Guaranteed 98% success rate.
2. Search by movie title
3. Search by IMDb Number or IMDb URL
Get full movie info straight from IMDb, like cast, crew, plot, episode lists, IMDb Ratings & Votes (updated daily!), audience ratings (like MPAA, BBFC, etc..). 
Our own Core movie database also gives you cover art, trailer videos, backdrop art, etc...
All movie formats are supported, including 4K UHD, Blu-ray, DVD, HD-DVD, LaserDisc, VHS, UMD video, etc.. 
== Edit all fields == 
Edit all automatically provided details from CLZ Core, like titles, formats, studios, release dates, plot descriptions, cast and crew listings etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like location, ratings, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc.. 
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate physical releases from your digital movies, to keep track of movies you sold or have for sale, etc... 
== Full customizable ==
Browse your film database as a list with small thumbnails or as cards with big images.
Sort any way you want, e.g. by title, year, runtime, IMDb rating, date added etc.. Group your movies into folders by format, direct, genre, year, etc... 
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
Sync your data to the CLZ Cloud, to:
* Always have an online backup of your movie database.
* Sync your movie collection between multiple devices
* View and share your movie inventory online
== Got a question or need help? ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "CLZ Club forum" from the menu.
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. We're always working to bring you regular updates for the apps and software, and to keep our Core online databases up-to-date with all weekly releases.
Our other CLZ apps:
* CLZ Books, for organizing your book collection by ISBN
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Comics, for your collection of US comic books.
* CLZ Games, for cataloging your video game collection
== What our users say ==
* "Fantastic app. with a very efficient and fast support available."
* "does a very good job at it for a really reasonable price."
* "I like how quickly I can scan UPCs to enter my movie inventory. "
* "Barcode scanning works great, and searching by movie title is quick."
* "I was impressed with the speed of the barcode scanner"
== About auto-renewable subscriptions ==
* The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
* The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
* You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
End User License Agreement:

bluejetty:00182499:ios.name: EverMerge: Merge Games & Story
bluejetty:00182499:ios.summary:
Welcome to EverMerge: The Ultimate Sandbox Adventure!
◼ Step into a world where your imagination is the only limit! EverMerge isn’t just another matching game, it’s a massive, living sandbox where every choice is yours. Are you tired of re
bluejetty:00182499:ios.description:
Welcome to EverMerge: The Ultimate Sandbox Adventure!
◼ Step into a world where your imagination is the only limit! EverMerge isn’t just another matching game, it’s a massive, living sandbox where every choice is yours. Are you tired of restrictive puzzle games that tell you exactly where to move? Here, you are the architect of a magical kingdom.
◼ Lift the cursed fog and transform a shrouded wilderness into a thriving paradise. By matching and combining clusters of identical pieces, you’ll evolve them into bigger, better, and more powerful items. From the tiniest sprout to the grandest castle, every merge reveals a new piece of the story.
Discover the Magic: A World-Class Merge Experience
◼ While other games give you a grid, we give you a world. EverMerge blends the satisfaction of classic puzzles with the depth of a world-building simulation. It’s addictive, it’s strategic, and it’s filled with a cast of characters you already know and love, but with a cheeky, modern twist!
It’s Your World, Your Story!
◼ Forget linear levels! EverMerge offers a wide-open game board where you are the boss. Drag, merge, match, and organize your puzzle pieces exactly how you want. Whether you’re a perfectionist who loves a tidy kingdom or a creative spirit who thrives in organized chaos, the board is your canvas.
Become the Ultimate Merge Master!
◼ The discovery never stops. New items are constantly appearing on your board, each waiting for its perfect match. Combine three of a kind for a boost, or wait until you have five for a massive bonus! The more you merge, the more complex and rewarding the game becomes.
Familiar Faces with a Fresh Twist!
◼ Unlock and collect legendary characters like Cinderella, Peter Pan, and Sleeping Beauty. But don't expect the usual fairy tales—our heroes have big personalities and even bigger requests! Build them stunning mansions and complete their quests to earn their loyalty and incredible rewards.
Unlock a Fantastical Menagerie!
◼ The main kingdom is just the beginning. Complete challenging puzzles to unlock Mystic Isle, a special habitat for fantastical creatures. Merge your way to a collection of majestic dragons, noble griffins, and adorable unicorns. 
Mine, Harvest & Conquer!
◼ Running low on building materials? Take control of your resources! Mine for stone, chop for wood, and harvest magical crops to keep your builders busy. Manage your energy and resources wisely to ensure your kingdom never stops growing.
Magical Treasures & Chests!
◼ Every corner of the map hides a secret. Collect sparkling gems, valuable coins, mystical wands, and enchanting chests. Want a tip? Merge your treasure chests before opening them to find even higher-level loot inside!
There is Always Something New
◼ Daily Quests & Recipes: Help your characters cook up delicious treats! Complete puzzle recipes to earn wands that blast away the fog and expand your territory.
◼ Special Seasonal Events: From holiday-themed islands to unique time-limited challenges, there is always a fresh puzzle waiting. Earn exclusive decorations and creatures you won't find anywhere else!
◼ Endless Combinations: With hundreds of items to discover, the ""just one more merge"" feeling is real. Watch as your humble camp turns into a sprawling empire of mansions, gardens, and mythical sanctuaries.
Are You Ready to Merge?
◼ There is a strange sort of magic in bringing order to chaos. Whether you’re merging dragons, pies, or golden castles, every move you make contributes to a world that is uniquely yours.
Need Help?
◼ We’re only a click away! https://evermerge-jet.zendesk.com/
Find us!
◼ Friend Us on Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/evermerge
By downloading and using this app, you agree to the JetSynthesys Terms of Use at https://evermerge.jetsynthesys.com/terms-of-service and acknowledge the Privacy Policy at https://evermerge.jetsynthesys.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00075702:ios.summary:
Welcome! You are a short helicopter ride away from becoming one of the most celebrated and admired city mayors of all time.
This is Cityscapes: Sim Builder! A brand new, sustainable take on classic city building games, and brought to you b
bluejetty:00075702:ios.description:
Welcome! You are a short helicopter ride away from becoming one of the most celebrated and admired city mayors of all time.
This is Cityscapes: Sim Builder! A brand new, sustainable take on classic city building games, and brought to you by veteran sim builders.
::::: A RICH CITY BUILDING EXPERIENCE 
- Cityscapes will get you thinking. As Mayor you need to make meaningful decisions and build carefully thought out systems, so as to protect the health and happiness of your citizens.
- Citizens have basic needs of course - they need housing, jobs and shops, and a means to travel between them.
- Distance matters - industry and road traffic create pollution. It is important to think sustainably when building transportation networks.
- Citizens need utilities - power, clean water and garbage collection.
- And as their Mayor, you’ll quickly need to start strategizing about policing, education, fire safety and medical care. As your citizens develop more complex needs you’ll have to plan how to provide tranquil green spaces for them to unwind in.
- Have you got what it takes to make the right choices to develop a thriving metropolis?
::::: CITY PASS 
- The City Pass is a monthly event that enables you to earn exclusive parks, buildings, landmarks and other special items. You progress in the pass by completing daily and weekly tasks.
::::: UNLOCKS
- Raise your player level and unlock more cities to build in a variety of rich biomes.
- Get to unlock land parcels and discover natural curiosities hidden in the landscape. You can even build famous architectural landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Statue of Liberty, giving your city indomitable style and instant attractiveness.
::::: IMAGINATION
- Stunning 3D architecture and vistas will captivate your imagination as you watch your city grow. Collect diverse building blueprints approved for your unique city and be awed by the endless design possibilities.
::::: MEET
- Meet Anne Council who runs the city challenges but beware of May Grede CEO whose middle name is ‘Sabotage’. Friendly advisors such as Paula Powers and Frankie Flint are always there to help.
- And check in on your citizens who will keep you in the know with what life is like in your city. They will come to you with problems and make suggestions as to how to solve them. Be sure to listen to them, every citizen wants to feel heard. 
::::: SUSTAINABILITY 
- Choice matters when building a city of the future, one that is profitable, thriving and fully sustainable. Strategize about both environmental and social sustainability; reduce waste and pollution whilst also managing business impacts, both positive and negative on your citizens. Design cities in which your citizens want to live, happy and healthy side by side and feel as proud and fulfilled as they are!

bluejetty:00137681:ios.description:
Calculator With History is a powerful, versatile, and user-friendly calculator app designed to meet all your mathematical and computational needs. Whether you're a student, engineer, scientist, or business professional, Calculator with History provides the tools and functionalities to handle basic arithmetic, complex equations, and everything in between. Modern, clean design with customizable themes. Dark mode for ease of use in low-light conditions. Large buttons and responsive layout for easy navigation.
History and Memory:
- Automatically save calculation history for future reference.
- Easy to review and reuse past calculations.
- Persistent memory storage even after app closure.
Main Features of calculator with history:
Talking Calculator:
- Voice feedback for calculations, aiding visually impaired users and enhancing accessibility.
Unit Converter:
- Easily convert between units in various categories such as length, area, volume, mass, temperature, and energy.
- Simple interface for quick and accurate conversions.
GST Calculator:
- Calculate Goods and Services Tax (GST) for various rates.
- Options for inclusive and exclusive tax calculations.
SIP Calculator:
- Calculate returns on Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs).
- Detailed breakdown of monthly investments, returns, and maturity value.
Currency Converter:
- Convert between multiple currencies with real-time exchange rates.
- Regular updates to ensure accurate conversions.
Age Calculator:
- Calculate exact age in years, months, and days.
Discount Calculator:
- Quickly calculate the final price after applying discounts.
- Supports percentage and flat discount types.
Days Calculator:
- Calculate the number of days between two dates.
Loan Calculator:
- Compute loan details including interest rate, tenure, and total repayment.
- Detailed amortization schedule with monthly breakdown.
EMI Calculator:
- Calculate Equated Monthly Installments (EMI) for various types of loans.
- Breakdown of payments with interest and principal components.
Investment Calculator:
- Evaluate potential returns on various investment options.
- Supports different investment types and compounding methods.
Fuel Cost Calculator:
- Calculate the cost of fuel for trips based on distance and fuel efficiency.
Additional Features:
- Basic Calculator: Simple interface for everyday arithmetic operations.
- Scientific Calculator: Advanced functions including trigonometry, logarithms, and exponents.

bluejetty:00158429:ios.description:
Esta aplicación permite consultar una base de datos con preguntas similares a las que se toman en el trámite de obtención o renovación
de la licencia de conducir en Argentina.
Es una excelente herramienta para estudiar y repasar los conceptos necesarios para aprobar el examen teórico de conducir para la emisión
del carnet correspondiente.
Por cada pregunta se presentan las opciones de respuestas y se indica si la opción seleccionada es correcta o incorrecta.
Las preguntas están ordenadas por temas:
Documentación
Seguridad
Señales de tránsito
Factores de riesgo
Semáforo
Velocidades
Adelantamiento
Estacionamiento
Luces
Giros y rotondas
Conducción segura
Generales
No hay límite de tiempo para consultar las preguntas del examen de conducir.
La base de datos cuenta con preguntas de todas las clases de licencia disponibles:
 Clase A Moto vehículos
 Clase B Automóviles, camionetas y utilitarios particulares.
 Clase C Vehículos de carga.
 Clase D Transporte de pasajeros
 Clase E Camiones y maquinaria especial no agrícola
 Clase F Vehículos agrícolas
Puedes repasar las preguntas la cantidad de veces que quieras.
Te recomendamos realizar la prueba varias veces para maximizar el conocimiento de las posibles preguntas y respuestas correctas.
Las preguntas cubren las temáticas
 Situaciones de manejo.
 Reglas de tránsito
 Normativa de tránsito.
 Señales de tránsito
Las preguntas fueron desarrolladas a partir de manuales, guías y documentos públicos creados por los municipios o las provincias y disponibles en la web como herramienta de capacitación.
El objetivo de la aplicación es ayudar en la preparación del examen de conducir por primera vez (trámite original).
A su vez es una excelente herramienta para repasar las normas de tránsito y las señales de transito, independientemente de contar con la licencia de conducir.
Esta App es útil incluso antes de sacar el turno o la cita para el trámite correspondiente de emisión de licencia de conducir, ya que es una herramienta de estudio y práctica.
Si te gusta nuestra aplicación no dudes en dejarnos una calificación.
¡Muchas gracias!

bluejetty:00077320:ios.description:
This is arguably the BEST FREE Find N Seek: Spy Hidden Object Game for you!
Do you love to find a particular hidden clue in a mysterious city? Are you ready for a Scavenger Hunt? Challenge yourself and relax with this brainy hunting game for adults! Play it offline, anywhere and anytime.
Let's start the FIND AND SEEK JOURNEY!
Addictive Gameplay of Find It Out
Search and find games have never been this Fun! All you have to do is focus on the listed items, spot and tap on the hidden picture, and complete the tasks. Test your skills and earn rewards for each mystery journey!
Become a Spy Detective with Dream Seeking
Imagine yourself as a super spy, and your mission is to hide and seek, find and identify hidden object clues in a few cool places like "The Browns" and "Vintage Women." It's like being a detective for a treasure hunt in your own mystery room & hotel!
Awesome Adventure Game & Hidden Folk
Where is your keys? Keen-eyed detective to spot the difference between the atmosphere of an escape room & horror game. From Colorful Doodles to Kitty Quest, you'll explore different scenarios and find the hidden stuff in each offline level, and you can also take it as a cleaning game out of its unique "Clean Up" theme. Let's highlight hidden pictures in your own Hidden City & Vault!
Free-Game for Adults with Anti-Stress Fun
Are you feeling stressed from your life and work? No worries! This mind game is like a secret hideout that aims to help you relieve your stress significantly. Where is Waldo? Just sit back, relax, and enjoy the joyful adventure. Happy find, happy life!
HAPPY FIND FEATURES, ispy Strategy Game
- Zoom in and out, a little to the left, a little to the right
- Relaxing image search game without timer and pressure
- Completely FREE to play this brain game without wifi
- Engaging & suitable for kids, for girls and for ALL ages
- Use hints to find objects in a hidden garden more easily
- Different levels, designed from easy to hard
- Explore various scenes, for example, a beautiful farm
- Seasonal events, find differences with hidden photo, unpacking more challenges on the way
- Uncover clues, find hidden clothes, complete tasks & earn coins to enhance your gameplay
Ready to become a top spy detective? Join the Fun with Find N Seek: Spy Hidden Object! Embark on a fantastic scavenger hunt to uncover hidden treasures in superb scenes. Play now and discover the secrets hidden within!
Unleash your inner detective, relieve your stress, and discover what hidden objects and exciting surprises await you!

bluejetty:00175238:ios.description:
Down Dog builds a brand-new yoga practice every time you press start — tailored to your level, focus, pace, and time. With over a million possible configurations, no two sessions are the same.
Whether you're brand new to yoga or have been practicing for decades, Down Dog adapts to where you are today.
OVER TEN STYLES OF YOGA 
Vinyasa, Restorative, Yin, Wake-Up Yoga, and more. Easily switch between styles to get the practice that's right for you. 
BEGINNER FRIENDLY 
Start with Beginner 1 and build up at your own pace. Unlock new poses and more variety as you level up.
TARGET WHAT MATTERS TO YOU 
Use the Boost feature to focus your practice on any of 19 body areas - backbends, hip openers, core, shoulders, and more. Select a primary and a secondary boost to customize every practice, or get more variety in your routines by rotating through them all. 
TOTALLY CUSTOMIZABLE PRACTICES 
"Like" poses to see them more often. "Dislike" poses to skip them. 
CHOOSE YOUR VOICE 
Choose from 6 different yoga teachers to be guided by a voice you love.
STAY CONSISTENT 
Set daily, weekly, or monthly goals. Build streaks and develop a practice that works for your schedule. 
YOUR FULL WELLNESS TOOLKIT 
One subscription unlocks our full library of practice types, all in one app:
Meditation - guided sessions for stress, sleep, focus, and mindfulness
Pilates - core, posture, and stability
HIIT - fast, efficient workouts that build strength and cardio fitness
Switch between them anytime. No extra downloads, no extra fees.
SYNCS WITH APPLE HEALTH 
Track your practice alongside the rest of your wellness data.
MULTIPLE LANGUAGES 
All yoga practices are available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, and Ukrainian

bluejetty:00100292:ios.name: RockIn: Gem & Rock Identifier
bluejetty:00100292:ios.summary: Discover the world beneath your feet with RockIn, the rock identifier and stone scanner for rock and mineral enthusiasts. Whether you are a beginner collector, a passionate geologist or a marketplace seller, RockIn brings rock, gem and mine
bluejetty:00100292:ios.description:
Discover the world beneath your feet with RockIn, the rock identifier and stone scanner for rock and mineral enthusiasts. Whether you are a beginner collector, a passionate geologist or a marketplace seller, RockIn brings rock, gem and mineral identification, collection management and a marketplace together in one app.
ROCK, MINERAL, GEM & CRYSTAL IDENTIFIER
Take a photo and get fast, accurate rock ID powered by advanced recognition technology. Learn key details about each specimen: type, structure, rarity, origin, hardness, value ranges and more. Perfect for real-time field exploration or cataloging your home collection.
Multi-photo scan: Add photos from several sides for a more reliable result.
Photo check: RockIn warns you if a photo is too blurry, dark or bright.
Best match: See the best and other possible matches, or send a request if a stone is not found.
Search: Find any rock, mineral or gemstone by name or image in the mineral database.
Properties: See if a mineral is magnetic or radioactive.
BUILD & ORGANIZE YOUR ROCK COLLECTION
Create a digital catalog of your rocks and minerals. Add photos, locations, purchase info, personal notes and rarity levels. Keep your collection structured and beautifully sorted by species, group, class or custom tags.
Total value: See the estimated value of every collection.
Wishlist and history: Save rocks you want and find every scan in your history.
Account: Keep your collection on all your devices.
MARKETPLACE FOR BUYING, SELLING & EXCHANGE
Join a trusted community marketplace designed for collectors. Buy unique specimens from around the world or list your own items for sale. Set prices, manage offers and track interest directly in the app. Great for hobbyists, sellers and dealers who buy, sell and trade rocks, gems and minerals.
Browse: See popular items and new arrivals, sort by price and contact sellers by email.
Alerts: Get notified about new listings, offers and interest in your items.
DISCOVER GLOBAL COLLECTIONS
Explore other users' collections for inspiration, compare specimens and learn from fellow collectors. See how rare minerals look in different environments and discover trending finds. Browse varieties and similar stones.
TRACK GEM VALUE & RARITY
Access rarity indicators, price estimates and popularity data to understand the market value of your items.
Price by weight: Enter the weight to get a total price, per carat, ounce, kilo, pound or piece.
Price alerts: Get notified when an item price or your collection value changes.
Share: Send a card of your find, with or without its value.
METAL DETECTOR & REAL OR FAKE CHECK
Use your phone's magnetic sensor to see whether a rock, mineral or metal reacts to a magnet. Magnetic behavior can reveal metal inclusions and support real-versus-fake checks.
SPIRITUAL INSIGHTS (OPTIONAL)
Follow the moon calendar and read chakra, planet and zodiac meanings next to your stones. Hide it anytime.
GUIDES & BLOG
Practical tips for collectors, from identifying stones to selling them, plus short articles on rocks and gems.
FOR BEGINNERS & EXPERTS
Whether you are just starting or managing a large catalog, RockIn adapts to your level with simple tools and expert insights.
ALWAYS WITH YOU
Use RockIn outdoors, in museums, at gem shows or while traveling. Your collection and identification tools are always at hand.
Unlock a deeper connection with the stones around you. Identify, collect, organize, explore, trade: your entire mineral world in one app.
Please note that terms and conditions, as well as our privacy policy, apply.
Privacy Policy: https://rockln.gitbook.io/rockln/welcome-to-rockln/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://rockln.gitbook.io/rockln/welcome-to-rockln/terms-and-conditions-of-use
Contact us: support@rockinapp.com

bluejetty:00115705:android.summary:
🎧 Audio Insight: Your All-in-One Offline Music Hub 🎧
Take full control of your music library—no internet, no subscriptions, no compromises. Dive into seamless offline playback, robust organization, and premium sound quality, designed for mu
bluejetty:00115705:android.description:
🎧 Audio Insight: Your All-in-One Offline Music Hub 🎧
Take full control of your music library—no internet, no subscriptions, no compromises. Dive into seamless offline playback, robust organization, and premium sound quality, designed for music lovers who value freedom and flexibility.
🌟 Core Features for Uninterrupted Enjoyment
✅ Universal Format Support: Play MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, and 30+ formats with lossless quality—no conversion needed.
✅ Smart Library Organization: Auto-sort your collection by artist, album, genre Search effortlessly with quick filters and instant keyword lookup.
✅ Powerful EQ & Sound Tools: Fine-tune bass, treble, and surround sound. Presets for genres like EDM, jazz, or podcasts make optimization a breeze.
✅ Smooth Background Play: Keep the beats going while texting, gaming, or using other apps.
✅ Instant Lockscreen Controls: Play, pause, skip, or adjust volume without unlocking your phone—perfect for workouts or commutes.
🌍 Built for Every Offline Adventure
Travelers: Download playlists before flights, road trips, or remote adventures—no signal? No problem.
Fitness Enthusiasts: Streamless workouts with offline tracks that match your pace. No buffering, just pure motivation.
Commuters: Enjoy uninterrupted music during subway rides, rural travels, or areas with spotty networks.
Privacy Advocates: All music stays locally on your device. No cloud uploads, no data tracking—your library, your rules.
🔒 Privacy-First & User-Centric Design
No Subscriptions: Pure music experience with zero hidden costs.
Local-Only Storage: We don’t access, store, or share your music files. Your data is yours—always.
Intuitive Interface: a clutter-free layout make navigation effortless for all users.
🚀 Reliable Performance & Regular Updates
Lightning-Fast Scanning: detect new music files added to your device in seconds.
Battery-Efficient: Optimized for long playtimes—enjoy hours of music without draining your battery.
Active Development: We listen to user feedback! Expect monthly updates with new features, bug fixes, and performance enhancements.
📲 Why Audio Insight?
No Strings Attached: No mandatory logins, no premium gates—just a powerful tool for your existing music collection.
Offline First: Every feature is designed to work seamlessly without internet, from EQ to playlist.
Quality Above All: Lossless playback, crystal-clear controls, and a sleek design that puts your music front and center.
⚙️ Required Permissions
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK / FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
This permission enables seamless access to key features like quick notification bar controls for playback (play/pause, song switching, volume adjustment) and uninterrupted background scanning/importing of your local music library, ensuring smooth synchronization and system-optimized performance without interruptions.
Download Audio Insight today and transform the way you experience offline music—wherever life takes you.

bluejetty:00122107:ios.description:
StarChat provides you a wonderful way to communicate with family, friends, and strangers. TOTALLY FREE! 
You just need to create a room and invite your friends, then you can hold an online party anytime anywhere. Not only voice chat, but you can also share your favorite songs and sing karaoke with friends. Online games will make your party more excited.
6 Reasons you’ll love the StarChat app:
1. NO FEES
StarChat is an absolutely free voice chat app! Once your phone connects to the internet (4G/3G/2G or WiFi), you can enjoy a really fluent, high-quality voice chat.
2. Available in 40+ Countries
If you are away from family or friends, a voice chat room will make you closer. Wherever you are, using StarChat to keep in touch with friends, then you will never miss big moments! 
3. Secret Room
Lock the room and set a password, and only your friends could enter, which will be a wonderfully private place for you.
4. Online Party
Can’t find a suitable place for the party? StarChat provides you an awesome chance to hold an online party. Birthday, wedding, Eid, or just real-time comments on football games, TV Series, girls’ gossip, any topic is fine. Suitable presents like cake, rose, ring, etc. are also provided. It’s a great chance to surprise your friends. 
5. More Entertainment
More than voice! Text, pictures are also available. You will have fun with friends by playing games and singing karaoke.
6. Join another Party
There are many public rooms with different topics. Choose the room according to the topic, then you will find friends with the same interests. Meanwhile, you will feel free to talk with anyone without showing your face.
If you have any problems or feedback, you can contact us by：
Facebook: www.facebook.com/StarChatLive/
Website: www.starchat.live
Email: support@starchat.live
StarChat provides a variety of in-app purchases and subscriptions.If you choose to purchase an StarChat subscription,payment will be charged to your iTunes account after purchase confirmation.Your account will be charged the subscription amount within 24-hours prior to the end of the currnent period unless auto-renewal is turned off.Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy：https://www.starchat.live/help/policy/Privacy_Policy.html
Terms of Service：https://www.starchat.live/help/policy/Terms_of_Service.html

bluejetty:00033094:ios.description:
Sudoku Master® is a logic-driven number puzzle designed to improve your thinking, memory, and concentration. Solve thousands of handcrafted puzzles, train your brain daily, and play fully offline whenever you want.
Strengthen analytical skills through a wide range of difficulty levels, advanced solving tools, and multiple grid formats. Whether you’re new to Sudoku or aiming for expert-level mastery, Sudoku Master provides structured, focused training without distractions.
Key Features
- Thousands of unique Sudoku puzzles 
A broad variety of logic challenges to enhance reasoning, focus, and problem-solving consistency.
- Full offline mode 
Play anytime without an internet connection—ideal for travel, commuting, or quick mental workouts.
- Five difficulty levels 
Progress from Easy to Master difficulty and develop stronger analytical thinking step by step.
- Multiple grid formats: 9×9, 6×6, 16×16 
Classic and expanded boards to match different experience levels and training intensity.
- Notes and smart hints 
Use pencil notes for deeper analysis and activate targeted hints only when needed.
- Detailed stats and achievements 
Track performance, improve solving speed, and monitor your cognitive progress over time.
- Daily puzzle 
A new challenge every day to maintain consistency and strengthen long-term focus.
- Light and dark themes 
Comfortable visuals for any environment.
- Regular updates 
New improvements, optimizations, and puzzle enhancements.
Why Players Choose Sudoku Master® 
A clear interface, structured progression, offline access, and a strong focus on logic, memory, and concentration training. Suitable for both beginners and advanced solvers.
Support sudoku.master@malpagames.com Terms of Use: https://malpagames.com/terms-of-service Privacy Policy: https://malpagames.com/privacy-policy
Sudoku Master® is a registered trademark of Malpa Games.

Hold a stone—tap and drag back to aim.

Release to throw—the longer you drag, the more powerful the throw.

Score points—only stones that land inside the пинко circle count.
You have five throws per game—make every one count! Place as many stones as possible in the circle or play aggressively, knocking others out of the zones to score пинко points.
Features
Smooth, intuitive controls
Realistic sliding and collisions
Quick matches (perfect for short breaks)
Skill-based scoring and engaging gameplay

Adjust direction—slightly move your finger left or right.

Release to throw—the longer you drag, the more powerful the throw.

Watch the glide—the stones glide, bounce, and collide, just like in real пинко curling.

Score points—only stones that land inside the пинко circle count.

You have five throws per game—make every one count! Place as many stones as possible in the circle or play aggressively, knocking others out of the zones to score пинко points.

Features
Smooth, intuitive controls

Realistic sliding and collisions

Quick matches (perfect for short breaks)

Skill-based scoring and engaging gameplay

Simply aim, slide, and enjoy the perfect throw.

bluejetty:00029483:ios.name: Scaler 2
bluejetty:00029483:ios.summary: Scaler 2 iOS is a multiple award winning music theory workstation redesigned from the ground up for iPad OS. Scaler 2 is an inspirational and creative music tool that gives you access to a world of new ideas, expressions and melodies. With
bluejetty:00029483:ios.description:
Scaler 2 iOS is a multiple award winning music theory workstation redesigned from the ground up for iPad OS. Scaler 2 is an inspirational and creative music tool that gives you access to a world of new ideas, expressions and melodies. With powerful detection of MIDI and audio, Scaler 2 can determine what key and scale you’re in and suggest chords, melodies and basslines that match your music. Scaler 2 can connect to any keyboard, synth or device using bluetooth audio and midi. Scaler is fully compatible with GarageBand and Audio Mixers to get you writing music on the fly in an environment that suits you. Scaler 2 makes finding chords and progressions intuitive and fun! It’s a comprehensive but easy to use toolbox that will help anyone make better music.
Main Features:
Discover your music’s key with audio and MIDI detection and explore alternative scales, modes and chord sets
Choose from hundreds of keys and modes, quickly build progressions in the sequencer
Play and record one-finger chords and melodies using Scaler 2’s Bind MIDI function
Play melodic expressions, phrases, performances, sequences, basslines, melodies and rhythms written by professional musicians across various time signatures
Generate bass lines and melody lines adapted to your current scale and chords
Chord Charts: displays a guitar chord diagram for any chord and Fretboard Views allows you to explore the neck of your guitar
Export MIDI to your iOS DAW or export session to Scaler Plugin for use across all computer based DAWs 
Compatible with Bluetooth MIDI Keyboards and all MIDI Keyboards via USB/Lightning Adapter
Standalone and AUv3 app that can control your favourite iPAD synths and work alongside thousands of AudioBus and AUM compatible apps including Logic Pro for iPad and Cubasis
Redesigned from the ground up to work with iPad OS with new menu and UI Navigation
Scaler is a free download and comes with 5 integrated sounds and the main features. Unlock all remaining features, content and internal sounds with one time unlock all feature
Content:
Over 200 artist chord sets from the likes of Carl Cox, MJ Cole, The Temper Trap, Mitekiss, CeCe Rogers and Mike Huckaby
Over 500 unique genre, common and mood-based chord sets such as Ambient, Drum & Bass, Jazz, Cinematic, EDM, Rock
Over 600 chord sets and hundreds of unique scales
Over 500 phrases, performances, sequences, basslines, melodies and rhythms by professional musicians across various time signatures
45 internal electronic, acoustic and orchestral instruments created by award winning producers
Over one hundred artist created modulation pathways to get you from one key to another
Over one hundred chord substitutions that lend variety to your progressions
Performing and creating:
Create unique chords by searching & selecting from the circle of fifths or by entering note by note on your keyboard in Chord Edit mode
Keys Lock helps you create emotive melodies by locking keys to your chords
MIDI Capture lets you perform inside Scaler 2 and then export the results as MIDI
Modulation Page gives you new ways to reach musical destinations
Suggest Mode helps you add complexity and artistry to your chord progressions
Edit Modes for adjusting length, velocity, inversion, octave, timing and performances more per chord in a pattern
Pad View helps you to arrange and play through multiple patterns and key switch between them
Voice Grouping can keep your chords within a certain range for voice leading
Chord editing and moving tools include lasso, drag n drop, replace and insert 
Midi Mapping allows you to change, performances, scales and patterns on the fly
Get more natural-sounding melodies and expressions with the humanise and quantise function
Use the arpeggio or strum features to perform in real-time and synced to your DAW
Awards
#1 Music Theory App Future Music 2024
Plugin Boutique 'Best Music Theory Software' Award Winner 2022
Music Tech Magazine 'Gear of the Year' Award Winner 2020

Sleep better – Live better. 
The SleepImage Mobile App makes understanding your sleep effortless. Designed for reliability, simplicity, and accuracy, it pairs seamlessly with SleepImage devices to record, transfer, and analyze sleep quality data using the FDA-cleared CE-marked SleepImage System software (SaMD). 
Built for reliability and ease of use, the SleepImage app provides a modern, intuitive experience across iOS devices. Whether you’re completing a home sleep test or collaborating with your healthcare provider, SleepImage turns complex sleep diagnostics into clear, actionable information. 
Why you’ll love the SleepImage app: 
-- Reliable & Accurate: Built on a secure, medical-grade sleep health platform trusted worldwide. 
-- Simple & Intuitive: Guided setup and pairing makes home sleep testing easy. 
-- Smarter Insights: High-quality, sleep analysis data empowers better clinical decisions. 
-- Cross-Platform Consistency: Enhanced performance and compatibility. 
If you experience poor sleep, snoring, or suspect a sleep disorder, talk to your healthcare provider about a SleepImage evaluation. Reliable data leads to better understanding—and better health. 
Learn more at www.sleepimage.com. 
ABOUT SLEEPIMAGE
SleepImage is a global innovator in clinically validated, non-invasive sleep health technology. Backed by more than 130 peer-reviewed scientific publications, our medical-grade sleep monitoring systems help clinicians bring objective sleep health assessment into everyday care. 
SleepImage — redefining how the world measures sleep.

apple-itunes:1099295160.description:
Trusted by hunters since 1979, Moultrie built a legacy of innovation—from the first spin-cast feeder to today’s connected hunting ecosystem.
With Moultrie, you’re always connected to the hunt.
The Moultrie App is more than just a place to view trail cam photos – it’s a powerful hunt planning tool that gives you an edge. Plan smarter with features that go beyond images, helping you make data-driven decisions in the field. No other app comes close.
Free Hunt Planning Tools
Plan your hunt for free with the Moultrie App - no camera or subscription required.
• Interactive Maps - Plan your approach with satellite and terrain map views. Drop pins for stands, food plots, and more. 
• Photo Library – View and manage all your trail camera photos in one app. Organize by album, mark favorites, and browse all your images in one place.
• Image Intel – Stop manually sorting and tagging. Smart Tags automatically identify and organize images with bucks, does, turkeys, and more—and even sort bucks by age.
• Activity Charts – Spot patterns with activity charts that show sightings by time of day, moon phase, and temperature, so you know when deer and other targets are most likely to appear. 
• Shared Galleries – View images from Moultrie cameras from friends and family on shared properties or leases.
• Weather Forecasts - Check critical hunting conditions like wind direction, moon phase, rainfall, and barometric pressure.
Control Moultrie Connected Devices 
Manage cellular trail cameras and connected feeders from anywhere. 
• Manage Trail Cameras Remotely - Get instant notifications when your camera sends new images or videos. Request on-demand photos and video with sound, and adjust settings from anywhere.
• Control Feeders with Bluetooth or Cellular – Check feed levels, adjust schedules, feed on demand, and get alerts for low battery, low feed, jams, or clogs.
• Monitor Power Status – Check battery life remotely and view solar power reporting.
Advanced Hunt Planning Tools 
Take hunt planning to the next level with Hunt Planning Plus: 
• Topo + Property Lines – Plan optimal stand locations and access points with topo overlays and public/private land boundaries. 
• Ideal Wind Forecast - Stay downwind and undetected. Set ideal wind direction for your stands or blinds, and get real-time and 7-day wind forecasts for smarter planning. 
• Deer Movement Forecasts – Know the best time to hunt. Game Plan predicts high-activity periods using local trail camera sightings and weather data.
Whether you're managing Moultrie connected devices or want smarter scouting tools, the Moultrie App helps you monitor, manage, and maximize your time in the field.

apple-macos:6819975210.name: nemodot - Pixel Art Editor
apple-macos:6819975210.description:
nemodot is a pixel art editor for drawing and animating. From tiny icons to a game character's walk cycle, build it one dot at a time.
Drawing
- Pencil, eraser, paint bucket and eyedropper
- Line, rectangle and ellipse
- Brush size and mirror drawing
- Pixel Perfect cleans up corner pixels so diagonal lines stay one pixel thin
- Undo and redo
Select and move
- Rectangle select, lasso and magic wand
- Painting stays inside the selection
- Drag to move, or nudge with the arrow keys
- Copy, cut and paste (even into another drawing), flip horizontally or vertically
Colors and palettes
- Color picker, recent colors and a secondary color
- Add and remove palette colors
- Import palettes (.gpl, .pal, .hex) and export them
Layers
- Add, duplicate, delete and merge down
- Reorder, show or hide, and set opacity
Animation
- Add, duplicate, delete and reorder frames
- Set the duration of each frame
- Play it back instantly
- Onion skin shows the previous and next frames so you can line up motion
Export and import
- Export PNG, animated GIF or a sprite sheet, scaled 1× to 20× with crisp pixels
- Share straight to Photos, Files or your messaging apps
- Import PNG or GIF and keep drawing (each GIF frame becomes a frame)
- Save project files to move work between devices
Made for touch, pencil and mouse
- Pinch and drag with two fingers to zoom and pan
- Two-finger tap to undo, three-finger tap to redo
- Touch and hold to pick a color
- Apple Pencil: draw only with Pencil, double-tap to switch to the eraser
- Mac: full menus and keyboard shortcuts, right-click for the secondary color, trackpad zoom and pan
Also
- Your drawings save automatically
- Light and dark mode
- Korean and English
- No ads and no account. Your drawings stay on your device and are never sent anywhere
If something feels off or you'd like a feature, let us know through the support page.
